sabotage.definition: n. a deliberate act of destruction or disruption in which equipment is damaged\nv. destroy property or hinder normal operations
sabotage.translation: n. 怠工, 破坏活动, 破坏\nvi. 从事破坏活动\nvt. 妨害, 破坏

examples.en: Damiano revealed that that was an act of sabotage.
Why do you think this could be sabotage?
Why would Ziri want to sabotage Rima's truck?

sack.definition:
n. a bag made of paper or plastic for holding customer's purchases
n. the quantity contained in a sack
n. any of various light dry strong white wine from Spain and Canary Islands (including sherry)
n. a woman's full loose hiplength jacket
sack.translation: n. 麻布袋, 洗劫\nvt. 把...装入袋, 洗劫

examples.en: I need to hit the sack.
examples.zh: 我该去睡觉了。

examples.en: It's time to hit the sack.
examples.zh: 睡觉时间到了。

examples.en: In British English, "to get the sack" means to be fired from your job.
examples.zh: 英式英语的「to get the sack」是被解雇的意思。

sacred.definition: a. concerned with religion or religious purposes\ns. worthy of respect or dedication\ns. (often followed by `to') devoted exclusively to a single use or purpose or person
sacred.translation: a. 神圣的, 献给上帝的, 庄严的, 祭祀的\n[法] 神圣的, 不可侵犯的

examples.en: A sacred ritual took place in the magnificent temple.
examples.zh: 一个神圣的仪式在庄严的庙宇中举行。

examples.en: If anything is to be called sacred, it's the human body.
examples.zh: 如果有任何东西可以称作神圣的，那就是人体。

examples.en: In India, the cow is a sacred animal.
examples.zh: 在印度，牛是一种神圣的动物。

sacrifice.definition:
n. personnel that are sacrificed (e.g., surrendered or lost in order to gain an objective)
n. a loss entailed by giving up or selling something at less than its value
n. the act of killing (an animal or person) in order to propitiate a deity
n. (baseball) an out that advances the base runners
sacrifice.translation: n. 牺牲, 供奉, 祭品\nvt. 牺牲, 祭祀, 贱卖\nvi. 献祭

examples.en: Would it be ethical to sacrifice one person to save many?
examples.zh: 为了救许多人牺牲一个人是否道德？

examples.en: "Intestinal fat" is a kind of sacrifice.
examples.zh: “膟”是一种用牲法。

examples.en: He did not sacrifice his life, nor did he sell out his organization.
examples.zh: 他没有牺牲生命，也没有出卖组织。

sad.definition: a. experiencing or showing sorrow or unhappiness\ns. of things that make you feel sad
sad.translation: a. 忧愁的, 悲哀的

examples.en: If one day you leave, I will be very sad.
examples.zh: 如果有一天你走了，我会很难过的。

examples.en: A home without a mother is a sad, sad place.
examples.zh: 一个没有母亲的家是个伤心，伤心的地方。

examples.en: The death of Ronnie James Dio made me very sad.
examples.zh: Ronnie James Dio的死让我非常难过。

saddle.definition:
n. a seat for the rider of a horse or camel
n. cut of meat (especially mutton or lamb) consisting of part of the backbone and both loins
n. a piece of leather across the instep of a shoe
n. posterior part of the back of a domestic fowl
saddle.translation: n. 鞍, 马鞍, 车座, 鞍状物\nvt. 装以马鞍, 使负担\nvi. 跨上马鞍

examples.en: She saddled him with the work.
examples.zh: 她强迫他做这个工作。

safe.definition:
n. strongbox where valuables can be safely kept
n. a ventilated or refrigerated cupboard for securing provisions from pests
a. free from danger or the risk of harm
s. (of an undertaking) secure from risk
safe.translation: n. 保险箱, 冷藏室\na. 安全的, 可靠的, 平安的, 稳健的, 有把握的

examples.en: It is said that Tokyo is a very safe city.
examples.zh: 人们都说，东京是座很安全的城市。

examples.en: I'd like to put some things in the hotel safe.
examples.zh: 我想在酒店的保险柜里存点东西。

examples.en: The lost fishing boat made a safe return to harbour.
examples.zh: 迷路的渔船安全地返回了港口。

safeguard.translation: n. 保卫, 保护措施, 防护设施\nvt. 保卫, 保护

examples.en: The safeguard of the state shall be the supreme law.
Free flow of information is the only safeguard against tyranny.
We must fight to safeguard our civil rights.

safety.definition: n. the state of being certain that adverse effects will not be caused by some agent under defined conditions\nn. a safe place\nn. a score in American football; a player is tackled behind his own goal line
safety.translation: n. 安全, 保险, 平安, 保安设备\nvt. 保护, 防护

examples.en: You may injure yourself if you don't follow safety procedures.
examples.zh: 如果你不按照安全手续来的话，你可能会受伤的。

examples.en: The captain is responsible for the safety of passengers.
examples.zh: 船长要为乘客安全负责。

examples.en: Parents are responsible for the safety of their children.
examples.zh: 父母要对他们子女的安全负责。

sail.definition:
n. a large piece of fabric (usually canvas fabric) by means of which wind is used to propel a sailing vessel
n. any structure that resembles a sail
v. traverse or travel on (a body of water)
v. travel on water propelled by wind
sail.translation: n. 帆, 篷, 帆船, 航程, 帆状物\nvi. 航行, 启航, 张帆而行\nvt. 航行于, 驾船

examples.en: Tom is teaching me to how to sail.
examples.zh: 汤姆正在教我怎么开帆船。

examples.en: Columbus sailed farther west to look for a new continent.
examples.zh: 哥伦布航行至遥远的西方，去寻找一个新大陆。

examples.en: The ship is about to set sail.
examples.zh: 船快要开了。

saint.definition: n. a person who has died and has been declared a saint by canonization\nn. person of exceptional holiness
saint.translation: n. 圣徒, 圣人\na. 神圣的\n[计] 自动积分程序符号

examples.en: I'd rather laugh with the sinners than cry with the saints.
examples.zh: 我宁愿跟罪人笑也不愿跟圣人哭。

sake.definition: n. a reason for wanting something done\nn. Japanese alcoholic beverage made from fermented rice; usually served hot\nn. the purpose of achieving or obtaining
sake.translation: n. 目的, 缘故, 理由

examples.en: I gave up smoking for the sake of my health.
examples.zh: 为健康戒了烟。

examples.en: He quit smoking for the sake of his health.
examples.zh: 他为了健康，戒烟了。

examples.en: I stopped smoking for the sake of my health.
examples.zh: 为了健康，我不再抽烟。

examples.en: Because his salary is low, he can't buy that house.
examples.zh: 因为他的薪水太低，他买不起那栋房子。

examples.en: I will ensure that your salary increases after one year.
examples.zh: 我保证你一年后加薪。

examples.en: How much do you want in terms of salary?
examples.zh: 您想要多少工资？

salute.definition:
n. an act of honor or courteous recognition
n. a formal military gesture of respect
n. an act of greeting with friendly words and gestures like bowing or lifting the hat
v. greet in a friendly way
salute.translation: vi. 行礼, 致意, 问候, 放礼炮\nvt. 向...致意, 迎接, 赞扬\nn. 招呼, 敬礼, 礼炮

examples.en: He saluted the lady.
examples.zh: 他向那位女士问好。

salvation.definition: n. a means of preserving from harm or unpleasantness\nn. the state of being saved or preserved from harm\nn. saving someone or something from harm or from an unpleasant situation
salvation.translation: n. 拯救, 救助, 救世

examples.en: "God is our salvation," said the priest.
examples.zh: “天主是我们的救援。”，牧师说。

examples.en: First Contact became humanity's salvation as it was at the brink of self-destruction.
examples.zh: 在人类自我毁灭的边缘，第一次接触成了福音。

sample.definition: n. a small part of something intended as representative of the whole\nn. all or part of a natural object that is collected and preserved as an example of its class\nv. take a sample of
sample.translation: n. 样品, 范例, 样本\nvt. 抽样, 尝试\n[计] 示例, 字样

examples.en: Would you show us some samples of your work?
examples.zh: 可以给我们看看你的一些作品样本吗？

examples.en: The sample is not pure enough.
examples.zh: 样本不够纯净。

examples.en: The sample isn't pure enough.
examples.zh: 样本不够纯净。

sanction.definition:
n. formal and explicit approval
n. a mechanism of social control for enforcing a society's standards
n. the act of final authorization
v. give authority or permission to
sanction.translation: n. 核准, 制裁, 处罚, 约束力\nvt. 制定制裁规则, 认可, 核准, 同意

examples.en: It is necessary to obtain the sanction of the authorities to enter this building.
examples.zh: 必须获得有关当局的批准才能进入这座建筑物。

sand.definition: n. a loose material consisting of grains of rock or coral\nn. French writer known for works concerning women's rights and independence (1804-1876)
sand.translation: n. 沙, 沙子, 沙滩, 光阴, 生涯\nvt. 撒沙, 以沙掩盖

examples.en: Tom wrote his name in the sand with a stick.
examples.zh: 汤姆用棍子在沙上写了他的名字。

examples.en: Tom bent down and picked up a handful of sand.
examples.zh: 汤姆弯下腰，捧起了一把沙子。

examples.en: There is sand at the bottom of the ocean.
examples.zh: 海洋底部有沙子。

sane.definition: a. mentally healthy; free from mental disorder
sane.translation: a. 神智健全的, 稳健的, 没病的, 合理的\n[医] 精神健全的

examples.en: Rousseau was mad but influential; Hume was sane but had no followers.
examples.zh: 卢梭是疯狂的, 但有影响力; 休谟是理智的, 但没有追随者。

sanitary.definition: a. free from filth and pathogens
sanitary.translation: a. 卫生的\nn. 公共厕所

examples.en: Menstrual cups are an alternative to tampons and sanitary pads.
How many sanitary towels do you need every day?
All our sanitary facilities are heated by solar energy.

sap.definition: n. a watery solution of sugars, salts, and minerals that circulates through the vascular system of a plant\nv. excavate the earth beneath
sap.translation:
n. 树液, 体液, 活力, 坑道, 消弱, 警棍
vt. 使排出体液, 使伤元气, 使衰竭, 挖坑道逼近, 逐渐侵蚀
vi. 挖坑道, 消弱
[计] 共享汇编程序, 结构分析程序, 符号汇编程序, 服务器广告协议

examples.en: Rubber is made from the sap of the rubber tree.
In spring, sap is extracted from the birch trees.
Poor sap. He can't tell when he's being taken advantage of.

satellite.definition:
n. man-made equipment that orbits around the earth or the moon
n. a person who follows or serves another
n. any celestial body orbiting around a planet or star
v. broadcast or disseminate via satellite
satellite.translation: n. 人造卫星\n[医] 伴行静脉, 陪静脉, 陪病部, 随体, 卫星

examples.en: Choose a suitable satellite image as the base map.
examples.zh: 选择合适的卫星图做为底图。

examples.en: The Moon isn't a planet, but a satellite of the Earth.
examples.zh: 月球不是一颗行星，而是地球的一颗卫星。

examples.en: They are going to launch an artificial satellite tomorrow.
examples.zh: 明天将要发射一颗人造卫星。

satisfaction.definition: n. the contentment one feels when one has fulfilled a desire, need, or expectation\nn. (law) the payment of a debt or fulfillment of an obligation\nn. act of fulfilling a desire or need or appetite
satisfaction.translation: n. 满足, 满意, 快事, 赔偿, 赎罪, 报仇的机会\n[经] 偿还, 赎回

examples.en: I won't give them the satisfaction.
examples.zh: 我不会让他们得逞的。

examples.en: No matter what your main purpose is in reading, books should never fail to provide contentment and satisfaction.
examples.zh: 无论读书的目的是什么，书总会带给我们乐趣和满足。

satisfy.definition: v. meet the requirements or expectations of\nv. make happy or satisfied
satisfy.translation: vt. 使满意, 满足, 符合, 使确信, 赔偿\nvi. 令人满意, 替人赎罪

examples.en: I am sorry, we are unable to satisfy your demand.
examples.zh: 对不起，我们无法满足您的要求。

examples.en: The trigonometric functions satisfy a wide array of notable algebraic identities.
examples.zh: 三角函数满足各种代数恒等式。

examples.en: I am not satisfied with the result at all.
examples.zh: 我对这个结果一点儿也不满意。

saturate.definition: v. cause (a chemical compound, vapour, solution, magnetic material) to unite with the greatest possible amount of another substance
saturate.translation: vt. 使渗透, 浸透, 使充满, 使饱和\na. 浸透的, 饱和度高的, 深颜色的\nn. 饱和化合物, 饱和脂肪酸

examples.en: Kaleidoscopic prints saturate my blank mind, creating vital memories and burning thoughts.
I have high cholesterol and I need to avoid saturated fats.
The sky in this photo is very saturated.

sauce.definition:
n. flavorful relish or dressing or topping served as an accompaniment to food
v. behave saucily or impudently towards
v. dress (food) with a relish
v. add zest or flavor to, make more interesting
sauce.translation: n. 酱油, 调味汁, 酱\nvt. 给...调味, 使增加趣味

examples.en: The herb used in that pasta sauce might be parsley.
examples.zh: 用于那个义大利酱的香草可能是荷兰芹。

examples.en: Mix the rice and eggs with soy sauce.
examples.zh: 把米饭和鸡蛋及酱油混一下。

examples.en: Should we order the steamed perch or the beef with oyster sauce?
examples.zh: 叫个清蒸鲈鱼好呢，还是蚝油牛肉好？

savage.definition: n. a member of an uncivilized people\nv. attack brutally and fiercely\nv. criticize harshly or violently
savage.translation: a. 未开化的, 野蛮的, 无礼的, 残酷的, 原始的, 粗鲁的, 未开发的\nvt. 用暴力对付, 凶猛攻击\nn. 原始人, 粗鲁人

examples.en: In culture, they are on the same plane as savages.
examples.zh: 在教养上，他们可以说是和野蛮人差不多。

save.definition:
n. (sports) the act of preventing the opposition from scoring
v. to keep up and reserve for personal or special use
v. bring into safety
v. spend less; buy at a reduced price
save.translation:
n. 救球
vt. 解救, 挽救, 储蓄, 保存, 节省, 保留
vi. 挽救, 节省, 救球
prep. 除...之外
[计] 保存

examples.en: He pinched and scraped for many years to save money.
examples.zh: 为了存钱，他省吃俭用了许多年。

examples.en: The doctor tried every possible means to save his patient.
examples.zh: 为抢救病人医生已尽力了。

examples.en: Can you save one of those donuts for me?
examples.zh: 你可以帮我留一个甜甜圈吗？

scale.definition:
n. an ordered reference standard
n. relative magnitude
n. the ratio between the size of something and a representation of it
n. a specialized leaf or bract that protects a bud or catkin
scale.translation:
n. 刻度, 衡量, 比例, 比例尺, 数值范围, 等级, 规模, 天平, 秤, 鳞, 积垢
vt. 依比例决定, 攀登, 测量, 绘制, 刮鳞, 使生垢, 过秤
vi. 剥落, 生水垢, 重量为, 攀登, 衡量
[计] 刻度

examples.en: On a scale from 1 to 10, how have you been feeling?
examples.zh: 从一到十分，你最近感觉如何？

examples.en: I want a map of Texas on a scale of 1 to 250000.
examples.zh: 我想要一张1比250000的得克萨斯州的地图。

examples.en: For many individuals, the pentatonic scale is associated with Chinese music.
examples.zh: 在很多人的印象中，五声音阶往往与中国音乐挂钩。

scan.definition:
n. the act of scanning; systematic examination of a prescribed region
n. an image produced by scanning
v. examine minutely or intensely
v. examine hastily
scan.translation:
n. 审视, 浏览, 扫描, 细查
vt. 细看, 浏览, 扫描, 详细调查, 标出格律
vi. 押韵, 扫描
[计] 网络软件目录, 编码与分析系统

examples.en: Sami did a quick scan of the room and saw Layla.
With a 3D scanner it is possible to scan three-dimensional objects.
I'll perform a full scan of the system.

scandal.definition: n. disgraceful gossip about the private lives of other people\nn. a disgraceful event
scandal.translation: n. 丑闻, 中伤, 耻辱, 反感, 流言蜚语\n[法] 丑事, 丑闻, 干丑事的人

examples.en: This scandal will likely ruin your chances of being elected.
examples.zh: 这则丑闻很有可能会断送您的选举。

examples.en: In point of fact, she had nothing to do with the scandal.
examples.zh: 事实上，她和这个丑闻没有任何关系。

examples.en: He admits being involved in the scandal.
examples.zh: 他承认自己与这宗丑闻有牵连。

scarce.definition: a. deficient in quantity or number compared with the demand
scarce.translation: a. 难得的, 稀罕的, 缺乏的

examples.en: Telephone booths are as scarce as hen's teeth around here.
examples.zh: 这里附近的电话亭少得可怜。

examples.en: Rain is scarce in this country.
examples.zh: 这个国家降雨量少。

examples.en: The trees were very scarce.
examples.zh: 树木很稀少。

scarcely.definition: r only a very short time before\nr almost not
scarcely.translation: adv. 简直不, 一定不, 仅仅

examples.en: She had scarcely finished speaking when he cut in.
examples.zh: 她几乎没有说完话，就被他打断了。

examples.en: She spoke scarcely a word of English.
examples.zh: 她几乎不说英语。

examples.en: He can scarcely write his name.
examples.zh: 他很难写他的名字。

scare.definition: n. a sudden attack of fear
scare.translation: n. 惊吓, 恐慌\nvt. 惊吓, 使恐慌\nvi. 受惊

examples.en: Your random firing will scare away the prey.
examples.zh: 你胡乱打枪，会吓跑猎物的。

examples.en: I was scared to be alone in the dark.
examples.zh: 我害怕一个人处在黑暗之中。

examples.en: Why are you so scared? It's just a movie.
examples.zh: 你怕啥？就是部电影罢了。

scatter.definition:
n. a haphazard distribution in all directions
n. the act of scattering
v. distribute loosely
v. sow by scattering
scatter.translation:
n. 消散, 分散, 散播, 散射, 散布, 酒馆
vi. 散布, 散播, 消散
vt. 使消散, 使分散, 撒, 散布, 散播, 散射
[计] 散点图

examples.en: The shards of thought were scattered on the ground.
examples.zh: 思想的碎片散落一地。

examples.en: As usual the peasants are busy scattering grain seeds.
examples.zh: 农民们如常在忙著播种。

examples.en: There are beautiful flowers scattered throughout the garden.
examples.zh: 花园里散落著美丽的花朵。

scenario.definition: n. an outline or synopsis of a play (or, by extension, of a literary work)\nn. a setting for a work of art or literature\nn. a postulated sequence of possible events
scenario.translation: n. 剧本提纲, 情节, 剧本, 方案, 事态\n[计] 方案

examples.en: Best case scenario, you get kicked out of the house.
examples.zh: 即使最乐观而言，你也会被赶出这间房子。

examples.en: That's something like a movie scenario.
examples.zh: 这件事情像是电影情节。

examples.en: I'm jumping to the worst-case scenario.
examples.zh: 现在是我一直往最坏的方面想。

scene.definition:
n. the place where some action occurs
n. an incident (real or imaginary)
n. a consecutive series of pictures that constitutes a unit of action in a film
n. a subdivision of an act of a play
scene.translation: n. 场, 情景, 镜头, 发生地点, 道具, 布景, 景色\n[化] 现场

examples.en: There were three uniformed police officers at the crime scene.
examples.zh: 犯罪现场有三名穿制服的警察。

examples.en: The police got to the scene of the accident.
examples.zh: 警察到达了事故现场。

examples.en: Seeing this scene, I couldn’t help but sigh.
examples.zh: 看见这副景象，我不禁叹了口气。

scenery.definition: n. the painted structures of a stage set that are intended to suggest a particular locale\nn. the appearance of a place
scenery.translation: n. 风景, 景色, 舞台布景

examples.en: Tom and Mary admired the scenery as they held hands.
examples.zh: 汤姆和玛丽手牵着手，一起欣赏风景。

examples.en: When it got dark, the scenery became strange and spooky.
examples.zh: 天黑之后，景色变得诡异阴森。

examples.en: The scenery of the city reminded me of London.
examples.zh: 这座城市的景色让我想起了伦敦。

scent.definition: n. an odor left in passing by which a person or animal can be traced\nv. catch the scent of; get wind of
scent.translation: n. 气味, 香味, 香水, 踪迹, 痕迹, 线索, 嗅觉\nvt. 闻出, 嗅, 发觉, 使充满气味\nvi. 嗅猎, 发出气味

examples.en: The scent of cedar repels moths.
examples.zh: 雪松的气味可以驱赶飞蛾。

examples.en: After washing, the cat's fur is soft and fluffy, and has a faint scent.
examples.zh: 洗过澡后，猫咪的毛柔软又蓬松，还有淡淡的香味。

examples.en: Musk is one of the best scents.
examples.zh: 麝香的味道是最好闻的味道之一。

schedule.definition: n. an ordered list of times at which things are planned to occur\nv. plan for an activity or event\nv. make a schedule; plan the time and place for events
schedule.translation: n. 时间表, 一览表, 计划表, 议事日程\nvt. 预定, 编制目录, 制...表, 安排

examples.en: Tom checked the TV schedule to see what was on.
examples.zh: 汤姆检查电视时间表，看看在上映什么。

examples.en: Do you know the concert schedule of London Symphony Orchestra?
examples.zh: 你知道伦敦交响乐团的演奏会行程吗？

examples.en: The schedule is only slightly affected by this delay.
examples.zh: 日程表只受到了这次延误的轻微影响。

scheme.definition: n. an elaborate and systematic plan of action\nv. form intrigues (for) in an underhand manner\nv. devise a system or form a scheme for
scheme.translation: n. 方案, 计划, 组合, 系统, 图解, 诡计, 阴谋\nv. 计划, 设计, 图谋, 策划

examples.en: Your help is indispensable for the success of the scheme.
examples.zh: 没有你帮忙，计划就不能成功了。

examples.en: He carried out the scheme faithfully.
examples.zh: 他忠实地实行了该计划。

scholar.definition: n. a learned person (especially in the humanities); someone who by long study has gained mastery in one or more disciplines\nn. a student who holds a scholarship
scholar.translation: n. 学者, 奖学金获得者, 有文化者, 学习者

examples.en: Mr Tani is not so much a scholar as a journalist.
examples.zh: Tani 先生与其说是学者，倒不如说是新闻工作者。

examples.en: People thought him to be a great scholar.
examples.zh: 人们认为他是一名伟大的学者。

examples.en: He is a great statesman, and what is more a great scholar.
examples.zh: 他是一个伟大的政治家，更重要的是，他也是一个伟大的学者。

scholarship.definition: n. financial aid provided to a student on the basis of academic merit
scholarship.translation: n. 学问, 学术成就, 奖学金

examples.en: Thirty-two Madagascan students who receive scholarship are flying to China.
examples.zh: 三十二名领奖学金的马达加斯加学生飞往中国。

examples.en: Tom was able to go to college thanks to a scholarship.
examples.zh: 因为一份奖学金，Tom得以上大学。

examples.en: He won a scholarship to study in Germany.
examples.zh: 他赢取了一份去德国留学的奖学金。

scientific.definition: a. of or relating to the practice of science\na. conforming with the principles or methods used in science
scientific.translation: a. 科学的, 系统的, 符合科学规律的\n[计] 科学记数法

examples.en: Dr. Yukawa played an important part in the scientific study.
examples.zh: 汤川博士在科学研究上起了很重要的作用。

examples.en: Scientific discoveries don't always make the world a better place.
examples.zh: 科学发明并不总是使世界变得更美好。

examples.en: There is no scientific basis for these claims.
examples.zh: 这些主张没有科学的根据。

scissors.definition: n. an edge tool having two crossed pivoting blades\nn. a wrestling hold in which you wrap your legs around the opponents body or head and put your feet together and squeeze\nn. a gymnastic exercise performed on the pommel horse when the gymnast moves his legs as the blades of scissors move

examples.en: There is a pair of scissors on the desk.
examples.zh: 书桌上有一把剪刀。

examples.en: The hair dresser is cutting the hair with scissors.
examples.zh: 理发师正在用剪刀剪头发。

examples.en: These scissors are suitable for left and right-handed people.
examples.zh: 这把剪刀左右撇子都适用。

scold.definition: n. someone (especially a woman) who annoys people by constantly finding fault
scold.translation: n. 好骂街的人, 责骂\nv. 责骂

examples.en: You mustn't answer your mother back when she scolds you.
examples.zh: 给母亲责骂的时候不要回嘴。

examples.en: To tell you the truth, I've been scolded by my mom.
examples.zh: 老实说，我被我妈妈骂了。

examples.en: Not only they but also I was scolded by the teacher.
examples.zh: 不仅他们，连我也被老师罚了。

scoop.definition:
n. the quantity a scoop will hold
n. a hollow concave shape made by removing something
n. the shovel or bucket of a dredge or backhoe
n. a large ladle
scoop.translation: n. 铲子, 勺子, 穴, 口, 独家新闻\nvt. 汲取, 舀取, 挖空, 抢先报道

examples.en: Can you scoop the ice cream into bowls for dessert?
When you walk your dog, scoop up the poop.
You're lucky. The scoop fell right into your lap.

scope.definition: n. an area in which something acts or operates or has power or control: "the range of a supersonic jet"
scope.translation: n. 范围, 机会, 广度, 眼界, 观察仪器, 导弹射程\n[计] 作用域

examples.en: This is beyond the scope of my imagination.
examples.zh: 这超出了我的想像范围。

score.definition:
n. a written form of a musical composition; parts for different instruments appear on separate staves on large pages
n. a number that expresses the accomplishment of a team or an individual in a game or contest
n. a set of twenty members
n. grounds
score.translation:
n. 得分, 抓痕, 二十个, 刻痕, 帐目, 乐谱, 起跑线, 终点线, 大量
vt. 刻划, 划线, 获得, 评价, 把...记下
vi. 刻痕, 记分, 得分
[计] 得分

examples.en: A man's life is but three score years and ten.
examples.zh: 一个人只能活七十岁左右。

examples.en: The game ended in a draw, and the final score was 2-2.
examples.zh: 比赛以平局结束，最后比分是二比二。

examples.en: Because of his score of zero, he didn't dare to return.
examples.zh: 因为考了零分，所有不敢回去。

scorn.definition:
n lack of respect accompanied by a feeling of intense dislike
n open disrespect for a person or thing
v look down on with disdain
v reject with contempt
scorn.translation: n. 轻蔑, 藐视, 嘲笑, 被嘲弄的人\nvt. 轻蔑, 不屑做

examples.en: You scorned both the Nymphs, who beheld your deeds, and me the mighty Pan.
examples.zh: 你蔑视了目睹你罪行的仙女们，也蔑视了我を这位强大的潘神。

examples.en: She scorned the boy.
examples.zh: 他鄙视那个小伙子。

scout.definition:
n. a Boy Scout or Girl Scout
n. someone employed to discover and recruit talented persons (especially in the worlds of entertainment or sports)
n. someone who can find paths through unexplored territory
v. explore, often with the goal of finding something or somebody
scout.translation: n. 守候, 侦察, 搜索, 侦察员, 侦察机\nvi. 守候, 侦察, 巡视, 嘲笑\nvt. 侦察, 跟踪, 发现, 监视, 嘲弄

examples.en: Boy Scouts need to do one good deed every day.
examples.zh: 童子军每天都要完成一件好事。

scramble.definition:
n. an unceremonious and disorganized struggle
v. to move hurriedly
v. bring into random order
v. make unintelligible
scramble.translation: n. 攀缘, 爬行, 抢夺, 混乱, 紧急起飞\nvi. 攀缘, 杂乱蔓延, 争夺, 拼凑, 匆忙\nvt. 攀登, 扰乱, 使混杂

examples.en: Would you like some scrambled egg?
examples.zh: 你想要来些炒蛋吗？

scrap.definition: n. a small piece of something that is left over after the rest has been used\nv. make into scrap or refuse
scrap.translation:
n. 碎片, 残余物, 些微, 片断, 铁屑, 吵架
vt. 扔弃, 敲碎, 拆毁
vi. 互相殴打
a. 零碎拼凑成的, 废弃的

examples.en: There is not a scrap of truth in his words.
examples.zh: 他说的话没有一句是真的。

examples.en: Please get me a scrap of paper.
examples.zh: 请给我一张废纸。

examples.en: I'm only reading the scraps on news on the Internet, but, well, I get the general picture.
examples.zh: 虽然我只是在网上看了几则新闻，但也大概知道了整件事的来龙去脉。

scrape.definition:
n. a harsh noise made by scraping
n. a deep bow with the foot drawn backwards (indicating excessive humility)
v. scratch repeatedly
v. make by scraping
scrape.translation: n. 刮, 擦, 挖, 擦痕, 刮擦声, 困境\nvi. 刮掉, 擦掉, 刮出刺耳声\nvt. 刮, 擦, 擦伤, 挖成, 积蓄

examples.en: He pinched and scraped for many years to save money.
examples.zh: 为了存钱，他省吃俭用了许多年。

examples.en: She scraped her shoes clean before she entered the house.
examples.zh: 她进屋前擦了鞋。

examples.en: Please scrape the skin off the potatoes.
examples.zh: 请把马铃薯的皮削掉。

scratch.definition:
n. a competitor who has withdrawn from competition
n. (golf) a handicap of zero strokes
n. an indication of damage
v. cut the surface of; wear away the surface of
scratch.translation:
n. 抓痕, 搔, 抓, 擦伤, 刮擦声, 乱写, 零分, 起跑线
vt. 搔, 抓, 挖出, 擦, 刮, 乱涂, 勾抹掉
vi. 搔, 抓, 发刮擦声, 勉强糊口
a. 碰巧的, 凑合的, 打草稿用的
[计] 擦除

examples.en: Have I got to do it from scratch?
examples.zh: 我得从头开始做吗？

examples.en: The boy scratched his ear.
examples.zh: 那男孩搔了搔耳朵。

examples.en: Your cat scratched me.
examples.zh: 你的猫抓伤我了。

screen.definition:
n. a white or silvered surface where pictures can be projected for viewing
n. the display that is electronically created on the surface of the large end of a cathode-ray tube
n. a covering that serves to conceal or shelter something
n. a protective covering consisting of netting; can be mounted in a frame
screen.translation:
n. 幕, 银幕, 屏风, 掩蔽物, 屏蔽, 筛子
vt. 掩蔽, 放映, 拍摄, 掩护, 筛, 甄别
vi. 拍电影
[计] 筛选; 屏幕

examples.en: Overall, the movie was a success from script to screen.
examples.zh: 总的来说，这部电影从剧本到银幕是成功的。

examples.en: I prefer a phone with a large screen.
examples.zh: 我更喜欢萤幕大的手机。

examples.en: "It's so huge!" "Yes, it's an IMAX screen!"
examples.zh: 「好大！」「对，这是 IMAX！」

screw.definition:
n. a simple machine of the inclined-plane type consisting of a spirally threaded cylindrical rod that engages with a similarly threaded hole
n. a propeller with several angled blades that rotates to push against water or air
n. a fastener with a tapered threaded shank and a slotted head
v. turn like a screw
screw.translation: n. 螺旋, 螺杆, 螺钉, 螺旋桨, 吝啬鬼\nvt. 调节, 扭紧, 旋, 拧, 加强, 压榨, 勒索\nvi. 转动, 旋, 拧

examples.en: Now all you have to do is tighten the screw, and Bob's your uncle.
examples.zh: 现在你只要拧紧螺丝，就大功告成了。

examples.en: I screwed up the very first note.
examples.zh: 我搞砸了第一个音符。

script.definition: n. a written version of a play or other dramatic composition; used in preparing for a performance\nn. a particular orthography or writing system\nv. write a script for
script.translation: n. 手迹, 手稿, 正本, 手写体\nvt. 改编为演出本\n[计] 手写体, 小型程序

examples.en: Overall, the movie was a success from script to screen.
examples.zh: 总的来说，这部电影从剧本到银幕是成功的。

examples.en: The syntax of Python scripts is very simple.
examples.zh: Python脚本的语法很简单。

scroll.definition: n. a document that can be rolled up (as for storage)\nv. move through text or graphics in order to display parts that do not fit on the screen
scroll.translation: n. 卷轴, 画卷, 名册, 条幅, 滚动\nv. (使)成卷形\n[计] 滚动

examples.en: I can scroll down with my mouse, but not up.
Scroll compressors consist of two scrolls to pressurize refrigerant.
Scroll down to the bottom of the page.

scrutiny.translation: n. 细看, 仔细检查, 监视, 选票检查\n[经] 复查, 评核, 仔细检查

examples.en: Corporate political donations are coming under heavy scrutiny.
The downside of fame is public scrutiny.
The statement seems to make sense, but under further scrutiny, it falls apart.

sculpture.definition: n. a three-dimensional work of plastic art\nn. creating figures or designs in three dimensions
sculpture.translation: n. 雕刻, 雕塑\nvt. 雕刻, 雕塑\nvi. 当雕刻师

examples.en: A sculptor made a sculpture that looks like a person.
He went to art school to study painting and sculpture.
Mary's sculpture was brazenly ugly, which was precisely her intention.

seal.definition:
n. a device incised to make an impression; used to secure a closing or to authenticate documents
n. the pelt or fur (especially the underfur) of a seal
n. a stamp affixed to a document (as to attest to its authenticity or to seal it)
n. a finishing coat applied to exclude moisture
seal.translation: n. 印章, 封条, 海豹, 海豹皮, 火漆, 封蜡, 玺, 保证, 批准, 象征, 标志\nvt. 封闭, 盖印, 盖章\nvi. 猎海豹

examples.en: This mask completely seals your face.
examples.zh: 这个面具完全盖住了你的脸。

seam.definition: n. joint consisting of a line formed by joining two pieces\nn. a stratum of ore or coal thick enough to be mined with profit\nv. put together with a seam
seam.translation: n. 缝合线, 衔接口, 接缝, 线缝, 伤疤\nvt. 缝合, 接合, 焊合, 使留下伤痕\nvi. 裂开, 发生裂痕

examples.en: I am walking up the seam of stairs.
Please take in the seams of the jacket a little.
The public school system is coming apart at the seams.

search.definition:
n. the activity of looking thoroughly in order to find something or someone
n. an investigation seeking answers
n. an operation that determines whether one or more of a set of items has a specified property
n. the examination of alternative hypotheses
search.translation: n. 搜寻, 查究\nv. 搜寻, 搜查, 探求, 调查, 搜索\n[计] 搜索, 路径检索程序

examples.en: We spread out and began to search through the woods.
examples.zh: 我们分散开来并在树林中展开搜索。

examples.en: The police said the search for Tom will continue.
examples.zh: 警方表示，对汤姆的搜寻工作将持续进行。

examples.en: We have a warrant to search your apartment.
examples.zh: 我们有权搜查你的公寓。

season.definition:
n. a period of the year marked by special events or activities in some field
n. one of the natural periods into which the year is divided by the equinoxes and solstices or atmospheric conditions
n. a recurrent time marked by major holidays
v. lend flavor to
season.translation: n. 季节, 时节, 当令期, 时期\nvt. 给...调味, 使成熟, 使老练, 缓和\nvi. 变干燥

examples.en: It seems that the rainy season is over at last.
examples.zh: 雨季似乎终于结束了。

examples.en: The holiday season is my favourite time of the year.
examples.zh: 圣诞节是我一年中最喜爱的季节。

examples.en: When out of tourist season, the tickets will be cheap.
examples.zh: 在旅游淡季，机票会很便宜。

seasonal.definition: a. occurring at or dependent on a particular season
seasonal.translation: a. 季节的, 依照季节的, 周期性的\n[经] 季节性的, 季节的

examples.en: Benedito's salad is a great way to showcase seasonal produce.
You should try to feed your family fresh, seasonal vegetables.
The decline is not as sharp after seasonal adjustment.

secondary.definition:
n. the defensive football players who line up behind the linemen
a. being of second rank or importance or value; not direct or immediate
s. depending on or incidental to what is original or primary
s. not of major importance
secondary.translation: a. 中级的, 中等的, 次要的, 第二的, 从属的, 辅助的\n[化] 仲(指CH-3...CH(CH-3)-型支链烃基或指二元胺及R-2CHOH型的醇); 第二

examples.en: Tom told me he didn't take French at secondary school.
examples.zh: 汤姆告诉我说他在中学没修法语。

examples.en: This is a chemistry laboratory in an ordinary secondary school.
examples.zh: 这里是普通中学的化学实验室。

examples.en: I go to the same secondary school as Tom.
examples.zh: 我和汤姆上同一所中学。

secret.definition:
n. something that should remain hidden from others (especially information that is not to be passed on)
n. information known only to a special group
s. not open or public; kept private or not revealed
s. communicated covertly
secret.translation: n. 秘密, 机密, 秘诀, 秘方\na. 秘密的, 极机密的, 隐蔽的, 暗中的, 神秘的, 偏僻的

examples.en: He is the last person to give away the secret.
examples.zh: 他这个人嘴很严。

examples.en: Frank left a message by means of a secret code.
examples.zh: 法兰克用暗号留下了一则讯息。

examples.en: Do you want to know my secret? It's very simple...
examples.zh: 你想不想知道我的秘密？它很简单……

secretary.definition: n. a person who is head of an administrative department of government\nn. an assistant who handles correspondence and clerical work for a boss or an organization\nn. a desk used for writing
secretary.translation: n. 秘书, 书记, 大臣\n[经] 秘书

examples.en: My sister worked as a secretary before she got married.
examples.zh: 我的姐姐结婚前是个秘书.

examples.en: Sato is the new secretary of the company president.
examples.zh: 佐藤是社长的新秘书。

examples.en: Her name is Mary, she is my secretary.
examples.zh: 她叫玛丽，是我的秘书。

section.definition:
n. a self-contained part of a larger composition (written or musical)
n. a very thin slice (of tissue or mineral or other substance) for examination under a microscope
n. a distinct region or subdivision of a territorial or political area or community or group of people
n. one of several parts or pieces that fit with others to constitute a whole object
section.translation:
n. 区段, 部分, 区域, 节, 截面, 处, 科, 区, 扇区
vt. 把...分段, 把...切片
vi. 被切成片
[计] 扇区

examples.en: There are seven men and four women in my section.
examples.zh: 在我的部门里有七男四女。

examples.en: Dad said he'd be promoted to section manager next year.
examples.zh: 爸爸说他明年就要被升为部门主管了。

examples.en: I would like to sit in the non-smoking section.
examples.zh: 我想坐在无烟区。

sector.definition:
n. a plane figure bounded by two radii and the included arc of a circle
n. a social group that forms part of the society or the economy
n. a particular aspect of life or activity
n. the minimum track length that can be assigned to store information; unless otherwise specified a sector of data consists of 512 bytes
sector.translation: n. 扇形, 部门, 部分, 函数尺, 象限仪, 段, 区段\nvt. 把...分成扇形\n[计] 扇面; 扇区; 段; 区段

examples.en: Algeria needs to train its public sector employees on new technologies, communication skills, and customer service.
examples.zh: 阿尔及利亚需要对其公共部门员工进行新技术、沟通技巧和客服方面的培训。

secular.definition: a. of or relating to the doctrine that rejects religion and religious considerations\na. of or relating to clergy not bound by monastic vows
secular.translation: n. 修道院外的教士\na. 世俗的, 现世的, 长期的

examples.en: In recent years, secular ideas have flourished throughout the region.
Laïcité is an embarrassment to the secular world.
January is the first month in the secular calendar.

secure.definition:
v. assure payment of
a. free from fear or doubt; easy in mind
a. free from danger or risk
a. not likely to fail or give way
secure.translation: a. 无虑的, 安心的, 安全的, 可靠的, 保险的\nvt. 固定, 获得, 保证, 使安全, 掩护, 招致\nvi. 停止操作, 船抛锚

examples.en: The bank secured the city from a flood.
examples.zh: 堤坝保护了城市免受洪灾。

examples.en: I feel secure with him.
examples.zh: 我和他在一起时很有安全感。

examples.en: This bridge looks secure.
examples.zh: 这座桥看起来很安全。

security.definition:
n. the state of being free from danger or injury
n. defense against financial failure; financial independence
n. freedom from anxiety or fear
n. a formal declaration that documents a fact of relevance to finance and investment; the holder has a right to receive interest or dividends
security.translation: n. 安全, 安全性, 防护物, 保安, 可靠性, 担保人, 抵押品, 保证金\n[计] 安全性, 保密性, 安全检查程序

examples.en: Germany adopted a social security system in the 1880's.
examples.zh: 德国在1880年代采取了一种社会保障制度。

examples.en: If you want security in your old age, begin saving now.
examples.zh: 如果你想安享晚年，现在就要开始储蓄了。

examples.en: Hackers are adept at getting around computer security measures.
examples.zh: 黑客很会利用电脑安全措拖的漏洞。

sediment.definition: n. matter that has been deposited by some natural process\nv. deposit as a sediment\nv. settle as sediment
sediment.translation: n. 沉淀物, 沉积\n[化] 沉降物; 沉积物

examples.en: Layers of sediment lay at the bottom of the riverbed.
Continental shelves are often covered by young land-derived sediment.
By means of a super high-pressure water spray practically all the sediment is removed.

seed.definition:
n. a small hard fruit
n. a mature fertilized plant ovule consisting of an embryo and its food source and having a protective coat or testa
v. go to seed; shed seeds
v. help (an enterprise) in its early stages of development by providing seed money
seed.translation: n. 种子, 籽, 萌芽, 子孙, 精液\nvt. 在...播种, 催...发育, 脱...籽\nvi. 结实, 播种

examples.en: I ordered a sesame seed buns for the veggie burgers.
examples.zh: 我点了一份芝麻面包，用来制作素食汉堡。

examples.en: As usual the peasants are busy scattering grain seeds.
examples.zh: 农民们如常在忙著播种。

examples.en: The incident sowed the seeds of the war.
examples.zh: 该事件播下了战争的种子。

seek.definition:
n. the movement of a read/write head to a specific data track on a disk
v. try to get or reach
v. go to or towards
v. inquire for
seek.translation: vt. 寻求, 寻找, 探索, 追求, 搜索, 请求\nvi. 寻找, 搜索\n[计] 查找

examples.en: Some people prefer conformity, while others seek novelty.
examples.zh: 有些人喜欢循规蹈矩，而有些人总喜欢寻求刺激。

examples.en: Perhaps you will seek his aid.
examples.zh: 你也许要寻求他的帮助。

examples.en: You need to seek help.
examples.zh: 你需要寻求协助。

seemingly.translation: adv. 看来似乎, 表面上看来

examples.en: Algeria is in a seemingly endless war with Morocco.
The world is a place of seemingly infinite complexity.
Kalman was driving down that seemingly endless fire road.

segment.definition: n. one of the parts into which something naturally divides\nv. divide into segments\nv. divide or split up
segment.translation: n. 片段, 部分, 分节, 段\nv. 分割, 分裂\n[计] 段

examples.en: This segment of the audio contains too much background noise.
This segment is brought to you by the Ford Motor Company.
Many firms are competing for the wealthier segment of the market.

seize.definition:
v. take hold of; grab
v. take or capture by force
v. hook by a pull on the line
v. affect
seize.translation: vt. 抓住, 逮捕, 俘获, 没收, 扣押, 掌握\nvi. 突然抓住, 利用

examples.en: The boy seized the ladder, and began to climb.
examples.zh: 男孩登上了梯子，向上爬了起来。

examples.en: The policeman seized the boy by the arm.
examples.zh: 警察抓住了那个男孩的手臂。

examples.en: He seized me by the neck.
examples.zh: 他抓住了我的脖子。

seldom.translation: a. 不常的, 稀少的\nadv. 很少, 不常

examples.en: Although her house is nearby, I seldom see her.
examples.zh: 虽然我住在她家附近，可是也很少见到她。

examples.en: Bob seldom talks with Maria without making her angry.
examples.zh: 鲍伯和玛丽亚说话时很少不惹她生气。

examples.en: She goes to the dentist regularly, so she seldom gets toothache.
examples.zh: 她定期去看牙医，因此很少牙疼。

select.definition: v pick out, select, or choose from a number of alternatives\ns of superior grade\ns selected or chosen for special qualifications
select.translation:
a. 挑选出来的, 极好的
v. 选择, 挑选
n. 被挑选者, 精萃
[计] 选定

examples.en: Please select a language for the Image Viewer interface.
examples.zh: 请为Image Viewer的界面选择语言。

examples.en: The conference will be held in a specially selected church.
examples.zh: 会议将会在特意安排的礼堂里举行。

examples.en: Those selected will have to face extensive medical and psychological tests.
examples.zh: 被选上的将会面临大量的医学和精神测试。

selection.definition: n. an assortment of things from which a choice can be made
selection.translation: n. 选择, 选文, 精选品\n[医] 选择, 淘汰

examples.en: My mother prefers the arbitrary selection of the lottery machines over my lucky numbers.
examples.zh: 我母亲宁愿选彩票机上的任意数字，也不选我的幸运数字。

self.definition: n. your consciousness of your own identity\nn. a person considered as a unique individual\na. (used as a combining form) relating to--of or by or to or from or for--the self
self.translation:
n. 自己, 自我, 本性, 本质, 私心, 本人
vt. 使近亲繁殖, 使自花授精
vi. 自花授精
a. 同一的

examples.en: It doesn't matter how others see you. What is important is to be sure to affirm your own self.
examples.zh: 别人怎样看自己不重要,重要的是要保证自己得到自己的认同。

self-esteem.definition: n. a feeling of pride in yourself
self-esteem.translation: n. 自尊, 自负, 自大

examples.en: Your abilities and self-esteem need to go hand in hand.
Gina's sheer coldness attracted scads of men with low self-esteem.
Why do so many people suffer from low self-esteem?

semester.definition: n. one of two divisions of an academic year\nn. half a year; a period of 6 months

examples.en: I haven't studied physics much all semester.
examples.zh: 我这学期几乎没学物理。

examples.en: The new school semester has started.
examples.zh: 新的学期开始了。

examples.en: I'm taking Spanish this semester.
examples.zh: 我这学期修西班牙文。

semiconductor.definition: n. a substance as germanium or silicon whose electrical conductivity is intermediate between that of a metal and an insulator; its conductivity increases with temperature and in the presence of impurities
semiconductor.translation: n. 半导体\n[化] 半导体

examples.en: Car makers are struggling to deal with semiconductor shortages.
Sputter deposition is widely employed in the semiconductor industry.
Semiconductors were the top United States export to South Korea.

seminar.definition: n. any meeting for an exchange of ideas\nn. a course offered for a small group of advanced students
seminar.translation: n. 研究班, 专题讨论会\n[经] 讨论会, 专家讨论会

examples.en: Pretty good. Did you go to today's history seminar?
examples.zh: 非常好。你去了今天的历史研讨会吗？

examples.en: How was the seminar?
examples.zh: 研讨会怎么样？

senator.definition: n. a member of a senate
senator.translation: n. 参议员, (某些大学的)理事\n[法] 参议员, 上议员

examples.en: The senator was censured by the congressional ethics committee.
examples.zh: 议员受到了议会道德委员会的谴责。

senior.definition: n. an undergraduate student during the year preceding graduation\na. older; higher in rank; longer in length of tenure or service\ns. used of the fourth and final year in United States high school or college
senior.translation: n. 年长者, 资深者, 毕业班学生\na. 年长的, 高级的, 资深的

examples.en: John is senior to me by two years.
examples.zh: John比我大两岁。

examples.en: She gave her seat to a senior citizen.
examples.zh: 她把她的座位让给了一个老人。

examples.en: He is my senior by two years.
examples.zh: 他比我大两岁。

sensation.definition: n. an unelaborated elementary awareness of stimulation\nn. a general feeling of excitement and heightened interest\nn. a state of widespread public excitement and interest
sensation.translation: n. 感觉, 轰动\n[医] 感觉

examples.en: The hair style of the Beatles created a sensation.
examples.zh: 披头士的发型引起了轰动。

sense.definition:
n. a general conscious awareness
n. the meaning of a word or expression; the way in which a word or expression or situation can be interpreted
n. the faculty through which the external world is apprehended
n. a natural appreciation or ability
sense.translation: n. 感应, 感觉, 感官, 意识, 观念, 情理, 知觉, 理智\nvt. 感觉, 觉察, 检测\n[计] 阅读; 检测

examples.en: A man of sense would be ashamed to do so.
examples.zh: 聪明人会羞于干这种事。

examples.en: Tom's main problem is he has no sense of humour.
examples.zh: 汤姆的主要问题是他一点幽默感都没有

examples.en: I don't like people who have no sense of boundaries.
examples.zh: 我很讨厌没有边界感的人。

sensible.definition: a. able to feel or perceive\ns. readily perceived by the senses\ns. aware intuitively or intellectually of something sensed
sensible.translation: a. 有感觉的, 敏感的, 明智的\n[医] 可感觉的

examples.en: A sensible man wouldn't say such a thing in public.
examples.zh: 稍有头脑的人都不会在公众场合里说出这种话来。

examples.en: It was sensible of you to follow her advice.
examples.zh: 你听从她的忠告是明智的。

examples.en: His advice is always very sensible.
examples.zh: 他的忠告总是很明智。

sensitive.definition:
a. responsive to physical stimuli
a. being susceptible to the attitudes, feelings, or circumstances of others
s. hurting
s. of or pertaining to classified information or matters affecting national security
sensitive.translation: a. 敏感的, 易感的, 灵敏的, 感光的\n[机] 敏感的, 灵敏的, 感度高的

examples.en: Sharks are sensitive to electrical impulses as well as sound.
examples.zh: 鲨鱼对电子信号和噪音很敏感。

examples.en: Is this tooth sensitive to cold food?
examples.zh: 这颗牙对冷的食物敏感吗？

examples.en: Cats' eyes are very sensitive to light.
examples.zh: 猫的眼睛对光很敏感。

sensor.definition: n any device that receives a signal or stimulus (as heat or pressure or light or motion etc.) and responds to it in a distinctive manner
sensor.translation: n. 传感器\n[计] 检测器

examples.en: The lambda sensor is on the fritz again.
Flavio need to fix a broken camera sensor.
Our sensors did not detect anything out of the ordinary.

sentence.definition: n. a string of words satisfying the grammatical rules of a language\nv. pronounce a sentence on (somebody) in a court of law
sentence.translation: n. 句子, 命题, 宣判\nvt. 宣判, 判决\n[计] 句子

examples.en: I can't get at the exact meaning of the sentence.
examples.zh: 我抓不到句子的确切含义。

examples.en: I'm not a sentence. I should be deleted from Tatoeba.
examples.zh: 我不是一个句子。我应该从Tatoeba当中被删除掉。

examples.en: I can't translate a sentence if I don't understand it.
examples.zh: 如果我不明白一个句子，我不能翻译。

sentiment.definition: n. tender, romantic, or nostalgic feeling or emotion
sentiment.translation: n. 感情, 感伤, 情操, 情绪, 感想, 意见\n[医] 情感, 情操

examples.en: Anti-Chinese sentiment is on the rise in Myanmar.
examples.zh: 缅甸反华情绪正在增长。

sentimental.definition: s. given to or marked by sentiment or sentimentality
sentimental.translation: a. 感伤的, 感情用事的

examples.en: I don't think that Ziri was that sentimental about animals.
The younger sister is more sentimental than the other.
Sami things that were very sentimental for him in that box.

separate.definition:
n. a garment that can be purchased separately and worn in combinations with other garments
v. act as a barrier between; stand between
v. force, take, or pull apart
v. divide into components or constituents
separate.translation:
n. 独立件, 抽印本
a. 分开的, 各别的, 单独的, 分隔的
vi. 分开, 隔开, 分居
vt. 使分离, 使分开, 区分, 使分居

examples.en: In our city, we carefully separate and collect garbage.
examples.zh: 在我们的城市那，我们非常谨慎地分类收集垃圾。

examples.en: They sleep in separate bedrooms even though they're married.
examples.zh: 他们分房睡，即使他们已经结婚了。

examples.en: I have a separate notebook for each class.
examples.zh: 每堂课我都分别有一本笔记。

separation.definition:
n. the state of lacking unity
n. coming apart
n. sorting one thing from others
n. the social act of separating or parting company
separation.translation: n. 分离, 分居, 缺口, 退职\n[化] 分离

examples.en: One day apart seems like a separation of three years.
examples.zh: 一日不见如隔三秋。

sequence.definition:
n. serial arrangement in which things follow in logical order or a recurrent pattern
n. a following of one thing after another in time
n. film consisting of a succession of related shots that develop a given subject in a movie
n. several repetitions of a melodic phrase in different keys
sequence.translation: n. 序列, 续发事件, 顺序, 连续\nvt. 按顺序排好\n[计] 顺序

examples.en: There are many examples of the Fibonacci sequence in nature.
The Fibonacci sequence of numbers is found widely in nature.
The Fibonacci sequence is found everywhere in the natural world.

serial.definition:
n. a serialized set of programs
a. pertaining to or composed in serial technique
a. pertaining to or occurring in or producing a series
s. of or relating to the sequential performance of multiple operations
serial.translation: n. 分期连载作品, 连载小说\na. 连续的, 一连串的, 连载的, 分期偿还的\n[计] 连续的; 串行的

examples.en: Tom had no idea that Mary was a serial killer.
examples.zh: 汤姆不知道玛丽是个连环杀手。

examples.en: Tom had no idea Mary was a serial killer.
examples.zh: 汤姆不知道玛丽是个连环杀手。

examples.en: Betty is a serial killer.
examples.zh: 贝蒂是连环杀手。

series.definition:
n. similar things placed in order or happening one after another
n. a periodical that appears at scheduled times
n. (sports) several contests played successively by the same teams
n. (electronics) connection of components in such a manner that current flows first through one and then through the other
series.translation: n. 串联, 序列, 连续, 系列, 丛书, 套, 级数, 组\n[计] 系列

examples.en: Recently, this brand launched a series of limited edition underwear.
examples.zh: 最近这个品牌推出了一系列限量版内衣。

examples.en: Lucario is a creature in the Pokémon series.
examples.zh: 路卡利欧是《神奇宝贝》系列中的一种生物。

examples.en: A series of blasts reduced the laboratory to ruins.
examples.zh: 一连串的爆炸使实验室成为废墟。

serious.definition: a. concerned with work or important matters rather than play or trivialities\ns. of great consequence\ns. requiring effort or concentration; complex and not easy to answer or solve
serious.translation: a. 严肃的, 认真的, 重要的, 严重的\n[电] 严重的

examples.en: I was serious when I said I love you.
examples.zh: 我说我爱你时是认真的。

examples.en: We are having a serious talk about your future.
examples.zh: 我们在严肃地谈论你的未来。

examples.en: He could not come because of his serious illness.
examples.zh: 他因为生重病不能来。

sermon.definition: n. an address of a religious nature (usually delivered during a church service)\nn. a moralistic rebuke
sermon.translation: n. 说教, 启示, 布道

examples.en: Is this "giving sermons" or "sticking one's nose in someone else's business"?
examples.zh: 「好为人师」还是「好管闲事」?

servant.definition: n. a person working in the service of another (especially in the household)
servant.translation: n. 仆人, 有用物, 公务员, 雇员\n[法] 受雇人, 服务者, 公务员

examples.en: A prudent bird chooses its tree. A wise servant chooses his master.
examples.zh: 良禽择木而栖，贤臣择主而事。

examples.en: Tom made his servants eat in the dark.
examples.zh: 汤姆让他的仆人们在黑暗下进餐。

examples.en: The mind should be a good servant, but the heart should be the master.
examples.zh: 心灵应该当一个好仆人，但心应该是主人。

serve.definition:
n. (sports) a stroke that puts the ball in play
v. serve a purpose, role, or function
v. do duty or hold offices; serve in a specific function
v. contribute or conduce to
serve.translation: vt. 可作...用, 服务, 经历, 招待, 供应, 送交, 对待\nvi. 服务, 服役, 侍应, 适合, 有用, 开球\nn. 发球, 轮到发球

examples.en: It's better to chill white wine before you serve it.
examples.zh: 在你侍酒前最好先将白葡萄酒冷却一下。

examples.en: I'll be very happy if I can serve you.
examples.zh: 能为你服务我会感到非常高兴。

examples.en: All these things serve to add to our happiness.
examples.zh: 所有这些都有助于增加我们的幸福。

service.definition:
n. work done by one person or group that benefits another
n. an act of help or assistance
n. the act of public worship following prescribed rules
n. a company or agency that performs a public service; subject to government regulation
service.translation:
n. 服务, 贡献, 雇佣, 公职, 服役, 功劳, 仪式, 送达, 行政部门
vt. 保养, 维修
a. 武装部队的, 服务性的, 仆人的, 耐用的
[计] 服务, 业务

examples.en: It is a fact that I'm poor at customer service.
examples.zh: 事实上，我的客服能力很差。

examples.en: The toilets at motorway service stations are often very dirty.
examples.zh: 服务站的卫生间大多很脏。

examples.en: Employees of the call centre answer all customer service calls.
examples.zh: 呼叫中心的员工负责接听所有客服电话。

session.definition: n. a meeting for execution of a group's functions\nn. a meeting devoted to a particular activity
session.translation: n. 期间, 开庭期, 会议, 学期\n[计] 会话, 对话, 会晤, 通用任务程序

examples.en: Are you taking tests on the next session?
examples.zh: 下学期你要参加考试吗？

examples.en: I'll keep the meeting notes to review them before the next session.
examples.zh: 我会记会议笔记，下次会议前可以回顾一下。

setback.definition: n an unfortunate happening that hinders or impedes; something that is thwarting or frustrating
setback.translation: n. 挫折, 退步, 逆流

examples.en: He overcame all sorts of hardship and setbacks to succeed in a solo crossing of Antarctica.
examples.zh: 他克服了种种困难和挫折，终于成功一个人越过了南极洲。

setting.definition: n. the context and environment in which something is set\nn. the state of the environment in which a situation exists\nn. the physical position of something
setting.translation: n. 环境, 背景, 布景, 镶嵌, 调整, 沉落, 一副餐具\n[计] 设置

examples.en: I need to set my watch to two minutes faster.
examples.zh: 我得把手表调快两分钟。

examples.en: How do you plan to achieve the goals you set?
examples.zh: 你们准备如何达到你们制定的目标？

examples.en: A new health clinic is set to open next month.
examples.zh: 一家新的健康诊所将于下个月开幕。

settle.definition:
n. a long wooden bench with a back
v. settle into a position, usually on a surface or ground
v. settle conclusively; come to terms
v. take up residence and become established
settle.translation: n. 有背长椅\nvt. 决定, 整理, 安放, 使定居, 使平静, 支付, 安排, 解决, 结算\nvi. 停留, 下陷, 沉淀, 澄清, 安下心来, 结清, 定居, 安家

examples.en: They made a great effort to settle the problem.
examples.zh: 为了解决问题，他们尽了很大努力。

examples.en: I need to settle in here first.
examples.zh: 我需要先在这里安顿下来。

examples.en: Eventually I'd like to settle down and have a family, but not yet.
examples.zh: 我会找个地方安顿下来，然后结婚生子的，但这是以后的事。

settlement.definition: n. a conclusive resolution of a matter and disposition of it\nn. something settled or resolved; the outcome of decision making\nn. an area where a group of families live together
settlement.translation: n. 安顿, 解决, 处理, 结算, 殖民, 殖民地, 沉降\n[医] 居住区; 沉渣

examples.en: On this small island are two large towns and many small settlements.
examples.zh: 这个小岛上有两座大城市及许多小村镇。

severe.definition: s. intensely or extremely bad or unpleasant in degree or quality\ns. unsparing and uncompromising in discipline or judgment\ns. very bad in degree or extent
severe.translation: a. 严格的, 尖锐的, 严肃的, 严重的, 严厉的, 朴素的\n[法] 严厉的, 苛刻的, 严重的

examples.en: No one knows when a severe earthquake will strike Tokyo.
examples.zh: 没有人知道东京甚么时候会发生大地震。

examples.en: The blizzard has already had a severe impact on the economy.
examples.zh: 这场暴风雪已经对经济造成了很严重的影响。

examples.en: In severe weather, it's best to stay indoors.
examples.zh: 天气恶劣的时候尽量不要外出。

sew.definition: v. fasten by sewing; do needlework\nv. create (clothes) with cloth
sew.translation: vt. 缝纫, 缝合, 缝\nvi. 缝纫

examples.en: While you are reading to me, I can do my sewing.
examples.zh: 你读给我听的时候，我就可以做缝纫了。

examples.en: Did you sew this by hand?
examples.zh: 是用手缝的吗？

examples.en: She put aside the sewing and stood up.
examples.zh: 她放下手中的针线活，并站了起来。

shabby.definition: s. mean and unworthy and despicable
shabby.translation: a. 衣衫褴褛的, 低劣的, 破旧的, 吝啬的, 卑鄙的

examples.en: The room was empty except for a shabby bed.
examples.zh: 房间除了一张破旧的床以外，就甚么也没有了。

examples.en: In the end, we ended up eating at that shabby restaurant.
examples.zh: 结果，我们在那破破烂烂的餐馆里吃了饭。

shade.definition:
n. relative darkness caused by light rays being intercepted by an opaque body
n. a quality of a given color that differs slightly from another color
n. protective covering that protects something from direct sunlight
n. a position of relative inferiority
shade.translation:
n. 荫, 阴暗, 遮光物, 灯罩, 帘, 浓淡, 微量, 底纹
vi. 渐变
vt. 使阴暗, 使渐变, 遮蔽, 微减
[计] 底纹

examples.en: There's no light without shade, and no shade without light.
examples.zh: 不存在没有阴影的光明，也不存在没有光明的阴影。

examples.en: They sat in the shade of that big tree.
examples.zh: 他们在那棵大树的树荫下坐了下来。

examples.en: An old man was resting in the shade of the tree.
examples.zh: 一个老人在树荫下休息。

shadow.definition:
n. shade within clear boundaries
n. a premonition of something adverse
n. refuge from danger or observation
n. a dominating and pervasive presence
shadow.translation:
n. 阴影, 荫, 影子, 影像, 阴暗, 幽灵, 少许, 隐蔽处, 庇护
vt. 遮蔽, 使朦胧, 预示, 尾随
vi. 渐变, 变阴暗
[计] 阴影

examples.en: He is afraid of his own shadow.
examples.zh: 他怕自己的影子。

examples.en: She is afraid of her own shadow.
examples.zh: 她害怕自己的影子。

examples.en: The shadow of the stick is visible.
examples.zh: 立竿见影。

shaft.definition:
n. a line that forms the length of an arrow pointer
n. a long rod or pole (especially the handle of an implement or the body of a weapon like a spear or arrow)
n. a vertical passageway through a building (as for an elevator)
n. (architecture) upright consisting of the vertical part of a column
shaft.translation: n. 轴, 箭杆, 矛, 矿井\nvt. 装杆于, 利用

examples.en: The elevator shaft goes all the way to the basement.
The engineer measured the axial alignment of the rotating shaft.
From here, you can look down the elevator shaft.

shallow.definition:
v. make shallow
v. become shallow
a. lacking physical depth; having little spatial extension downward or inward from an outer surface or backward or outward from a center
a. not deep or strong; not affecting one deeply
shallow.translation: n. 水浅的地方, 浅滩\na. 浅的, 肤浅的\nv. (使)变浅

examples.en: Between you and me, he has a shallow way of thinking.
examples.zh: 他思考的方式缺乏深度，这个我们知道就好。

examples.en: Between you and me, he's a shallow thinker.
examples.zh: 他思想肤浅，这个我们知道就好。

examples.en: Contemporary Chinese youth culture is very shallow.
examples.zh: 中国的当代青年文化很空洞。

shame.definition:
n. a painful emotion resulting from an awareness of inadequacy or guilt
n. a state of dishonor
v. compel through a sense of shame
v. cause to be ashamed
shame.translation: n. 羞耻, 羞愧, 耻辱\nvt. 使羞愧, 侮辱

examples.en: It's a crying shame that they weren't insured against fire.
examples.zh: 这简直是太可惜了，他们没有买火险。

examples.en: It is a shame not to keep your promise.
examples.zh: 不遵守承诺是可耻的。

examples.en: I think death is preferable to shame.
examples.zh: 我觉得士可杀不可辱。

shape.definition:
n. any spatial attributes (especially as defined by outline)
n. the spatial arrangement of something as distinct from its substance
n. a concrete representation of an otherwise nebulous concept
v. make something, usually for a specific function
shape.translation:
n. 形状, 形态, 外形, 形式, 身材
vt. 定形, 使成形, 塑造, 计划, 使符合
vi. 成形, 形成, 成长
[计] 形状

examples.en: All of the cookies are in the shape of stars.
examples.zh: 所有饼干都是星星的形状。

examples.en: My father has been in good shape since his operation.
examples.zh: 自从手术后，我父亲一直处于良好的状态。

examples.en: That cloud is in the shape of a fish.
examples.zh: 那片云是鱼的形状。

share.definition:
n. assets belonging to or due to or contributed by an individual person or group
n. any of the equal portions into which the capital stock of a corporation is divided and ownership of which is evidenced by a stock certificate
v. have in common
v. use jointly or in common
share.translation:
n. 部分, 参与, 一份, 参股, 份额
vt. 均分, 分担, 分享, 分配, 共有
vi. 分享
[计] 共享; DOS外部命令:在网络或多工系统中提供文件共享
文件锁定及检测磁盘更动和对超过32MB硬盘分区的支持

examples.en: Canada and Mexico both share a border with the USA.
examples.zh: 加拿大和墨西哥跟美国分享一个国境。

examples.en: Lastly, is there anything else to share with the group?
examples.zh: 最后，还有其他要和大家分享的吗？

examples.en: To share one's passion is to live it fully.
examples.zh: 分享激情，就是完全沉浸在里面。

sharp.definition:
n. a musical notation indicating one half step higher than the note named
n. a long thin sewing needle with a sharp point
s. harsh
a. keenly and painfully felt; as if caused by a sharp edge or point
sharp.translation: n. 半升音调, 利刃, 骗子\na. 锋利的, 明显的, 敏锐的, 急剧的, 尖刻的, 严厉的, 刺耳的, 精明的\nadv. 锐利地, 急速地

examples.en: The soldier kept a sharp lookout in the darkness.
examples.zh: 这名士兵在黑暗中保持戒备。

examples.en: His observations are sharp, but he doesn't say much.
examples.zh: 他的观察是敏锐的，但他没有说太多。

examples.en: A sharp crack of thunder split the sky.
examples.zh: 一道闪电划破天空。

shatter.definition: v. break into many pieces\nv. damage or destroy\nv. cause to break into many pieces
shatter.translation: n. 碎片, 粉碎, 落叶, 喷洒\nvt. 打碎, 使散开, 粉碎, 破坏\nvi. 粉碎, 损坏, 脱落

examples.en: The vase crashed and shattered into pieces.
examples.zh: 花瓶摔成碎片了。

examples.en: The frustrated artist stomped on his failed painting, leaving a trail of shattered colors.
examples.zh: 画家失望地践踏失败之作，留下一片混乱的色彩。

examples.en: The vase was shattered.
examples.zh: 花瓶被打碎了。

shear.definition:
n. (physics) a deformation of an object in which parallel planes remain parallel but are shifted in a direction parallel to themselves
n. a large edge tool that cuts sheet metal by passing a blade through it
v. cut with shears
v. cut or cut through with shears
shear.translation: n. 修剪, 剪下的东西, 大剪刀, 切变, 剪切机, 切\nvt. 修剪, 割, 剥夺, 横越, 削剪\nvi. 剪, 修剪, 剪羊毛, 切断

examples.en: Ziri asked Yazid if he could borrow his hedge shear.
I want to learn how to shear a sheep.
I cannot shear my sheep now. It's still cold.

shed.definition: n. an outbuilding with a single story; used for shelter or storage\nv. get rid of\nv. cast off hair, skin, horn, or feathers
shed.translation: n. 车棚, 小屋, 脱落之物, 分水岭\nvt. 使流出, 放射, 脱落, 散发, 摆脱\nvi. 流出, 散布, 脱落

examples.en: Nobody's going to shed any tears if that old building gets torn down.
examples.zh: 没有人会为这个旧建筑物的拆除而落泪。

examples.en: She shed plentiful tears when her beloved dog was killed in an accident.
examples.zh: 她目睹爱犬在意外中离世，不禁泪如泉涌。

examples.en: You need to shed some pounds.
examples.zh: 你需要甩掉几磅。

sheer.definition: v. cause to sheer\nr. straight up or down without a break\nr. directly
sheer.translation:
a. 绝对的, 全然的, 纯粹的, 透明的, 峻峭的
vi. 偏转, 偏航
vt. 使急转向, 使偏航
adv. 完全, 全然, 峻峭
n. 偏航

examples.en: She put two pairs of sheer tights in the suitcase.
examples.zh: 她在行李箱中放进了两条裤袜。

examples.en: It is a sheer waste of time.
examples.zh: 这完全是浪费时间。

shell.definition:
n. ammunition consisting of a cylindrical metal casing containing an explosive charge and a projectile; fired from a large gun
n. the material that forms the hard outer covering of many animals
n. the hard usually fibrous outer layer of some fruits especially nuts
n. the exterior covering of a bird's egg
shell.translation:
n. 贝壳, 壳, 外形, 炮弹
vt. 去壳, 脱落, 炮轰
vi. 剥落, 脱壳
[计] 外壳; DOS内部命令:指定命令行处理程序

examples.en: I picked up a pretty shell at the seaside.
examples.zh: 我在海边捡了个漂亮贝壳。

examples.en: The shell of an egg is easily broken.
examples.zh: 蛋壳容易破碎。

examples.en: I found a beautiful shell on the shore.
examples.zh: 我在海滩上发现了一个漂亮的贝壳。

shelter.definition:
n. a structure that provides privacy and protection from danger
n. protective covering that provides protection from the weather
n. temporary housing for homeless or displaced persons
v. provide shelter for
shelter.translation: n. 庇护所, 避难所, 庇护, 隐蔽处, 掩蔽\nvt. 庇护, 保护, 隐匿\nvi. 躲避

examples.en: Children depend on their parents for food, clothing and shelter.
examples.zh: 孩子们的衣食住行靠的是他们的父母。

examples.en: Food, clothing and shelter are the basis of life.
examples.zh: 衣食住是生存的基础。

examples.en: To escape the storm, we took shelter in a nearby barn.
examples.zh: 为躲避风暴，我们躲到了附近的一个谷仓内。

shepherd.definition: n. a clergyman who watches over a group of people\nv. watch over like a shepherd, as a teacher of her pupils\nv. tend as a shepherd, as of sheep or goats
shepherd.translation: n. 牧羊人, 牧羊犬, 牧师, 保护者\nvt. 看守, 领导, 指导, 牧羊

examples.en: A shepherd drove his snow-covered goat into an abandoned cave to take shelter from the blizzard.
examples.zh: 一个牧羊人把他一身白雪的山羊赶进被遗弃的山洞躲避暴风雪。

sheriff.definition: n. the principal law-enforcement officer in a county
sheriff.translation: n. 郡治安官, 县治安官\n[法] 司法行政官, 郡长, 执行吏

examples.en: The sheriff doesn't want me to work on cases anymore.
The sheriff beat the suspect until he was almost dead.
Jonas was an idiot for not calling the sheriff sooner.

shield.definition: n. a protective covering or structure\nn. armor carried on the arm to intercept blows\nv. protect, hide, or conceal from danger or harm
shield.translation: n. 盾, 防卫物, 保护者, 屏蔽\nvt. 保护, 遮蔽, 屏蔽, 庇护, 挡开, 避开\nvi. 起保护作用

examples.en: The goddess gave the warrior a sword and a shield.
The ship would burn if the shield is not repaired.
I want my boss to shield me from unnecessary stuff.

shift.definition:
n. an event in which something is displaced without rotation
n. the time period during which you are at work
n. the act of moving from one place to another
n. a crew of workers who work for a specific period of time
shift.translation:
n. 变化, 移动, 轮班, 手段, 应急办法, 移位
vt. 替换, 转移, 改变, 推卸, 变速
vi. 转换, 移动, 转变, 推托, 变速
[计] DOS内部命令:该命令可将批处理参数向左移动一个位置

examples.en: Tom is working the night shift.
examples.zh: 汤姆上夜班。

examples.en: As tectonic plates shifted, uniquely adapted species of dinosaur emerged on each continent through vicariance.
examples.zh: 随著板块的移动，各大洲因地理隔离而出现了适应不同环境的独特恐龙物种。

shine.definition:
v. emit light; be bright, as of the sun or a light
v. be distinguished or eminent
v. be clear and obvious
v. throw or flash the light of (a lamp)
shine.translation: n. 光泽, 阳光\nvt. 使发光\nvi. 照耀, 发光, 发亮

examples.en: This is a world where the sun doesn't shine.
examples.zh: 这是一个没有阳光的世界。

examples.en: The game will be played rain or shine.
examples.zh: 无论刮风还是下雨，比赛都会继续进行下去。

examples.en: The stars are shining very brightly in the sky tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚的夜空星光非常明亮。

ship.definition:
n. a vessel that carries passengers or freight
v. hire for work on a ship
v. travel by ship
v. place on board a ship
ship.translation: n. 船, 舰\nvt. 以船运送, 装船, 运送\nvi. 上船, 乘船

examples.en: Due to a lack of balance the ship turned over.
examples.zh: 那艘船失去平衡，翻了过来。

examples.en: This ship is too big to pass through the canal.
examples.zh: 这艘船太大，没法通过运河。

examples.en: It is very pleasant to cross the ocean by ship.
examples.zh: 乘船过海非常舒服。

shipment.definition: n goods carried by a large vehicle\nn the act of sending off something
shipment.translation: n. 装船, 出货\n[经] 运送, 运送(寄出)货物, 装载

examples.en: In case the shipment is delayed, we have special delay insurance.
examples.zh: 万一船运迟了，我们有特别的迟到保险。

shiver.translation: vi. 颤抖, 哆嗦, 被打碎\nvt. 使迎风飘动, 粉碎\nn. 战栗, 碎块

examples.en: The mere thought of a snake makes me shiver.
examples.zh: 一想到蛇就发颤。

examples.en: "The castle is haunted," he said with a shiver.
examples.zh: 他边颤抖边说：「那座城堡有鬼。」

examples.en: I shiver just thinking about snakes.
examples.zh: 一想到蛇就发颤。

shock.definition:
n. the violent interaction of individuals or groups entering into combat
n. (pathology) bodily collapse or near collapse caused by inadequate oxygen delivery to the cells; characterized by reduced cardiac output and rapid heartbeat and circulatory insufficiency and pallor
n. an instance of agitation of the earth's crust
n. an unpleasant or disappointing surprise
shock.translation:
n. 震动, 冲突, 震惊, 冲击, 突击, 禾束堆, 休克, 长毛狗
vt. 使震动, 使休克, 使受电击, 震惊得
vi. 震动, 吓人
a. 蓬乱浓密的

examples.en: She got over the shock of her father's death.
examples.zh: 她从她父亲过世的震惊中恢复了。

examples.en: His death was great shock to his wife.
examples.zh: 他的去世让他的太太大受打击。

examples.en: It was a great shock to me.
examples.zh: 这对我是很大的震撼。

shore.definition: n. the land along the edge of a body of water\nn. a beam or timber that is propped against a structure to provide support\nv. serve as a shore to
shore.translation: n. 海岸, 海滨, 斜撑柱\nvt. 把...送上岸, 支撑, 支持

examples.en: Now, get off the boat and swim to shore.
examples.zh: 现在下船，游到岸边。

examples.en: We went walking on the shore of the lake.
examples.zh: 我们沿着湖岸散步。

examples.en: We walked along the shore of the lake.
examples.zh: 我们沿着湖岸散步。

short.definition:
n. the location on a baseball field where the shortstop is stationed
a. primarily temporal sense; indicating or being or seeming to be limited in duration
a. (primarily spatial sense) having little length or lacking in length
a. low in stature; not tall
short.translation:
a. 短的, 近的, 矮的, 短期的, 简短的, 少量的
adv. 简短地, 突然
n. 扼要, 短片, 缺乏
vt. 故意少给, 使短路

examples.en: I can't finish the job in so short a time.
examples.zh: 我无法在这么短的时间内完成这份工作。

examples.en: Father ran short of money and had to borrow some.
examples.zh: 父亲缺钱，所以他必须去借点钱。

examples.en: It’s impossible to learn English in a short time.
examples.zh: 不可能短时间内学会英语。

shortage.definition: n the property of being an amount by which something is less than expected or required\nn an acute insufficiency
shortage.translation: n. 不足, 缺乏\n[化] 缺额

examples.en: There is a shortage of good construction timber right now.
examples.zh: 现在正缺良好的建筑木材。

examples.en: There is a shortage of good building wood.
examples.zh: 现在正缺良好的建筑木材。

examples.en: The recent coffee shortage brought about many problems.
examples.zh: 最近的咖啡短缺带来了许多问题。

examples.en: From the practical point of view, there are many shortcomings in his plan.
examples.zh: 从现实的角度看，他的计划有很多缺点。

examples.en: I am not without my shortcomings, but these shortcomings can easily be amended.
examples.zh: 我是个有缺点的人，但这些缺点很容易就能被改正。

shortly.definition: r. for a short time\nr. at a short distance
shortly.translation: adv. 不久, 简短, 唐突地

examples.en: Shortly before his wedding, he decided not to get married.
examples.zh: 他在要结婚之际决定还是不结婚了。

examples.en: My grandfather died shortly after my birth.
examples.zh: 我出生不久之后我的爷爷就去世了。

examples.en: Shortly after the accident, the police came.
examples.zh: 事故发生后不久，警察来了。

shoulder.definition:
n. the part of the body between the neck and the upper arm
n. a cut of meat including the upper joint of the foreleg
n. a ball-and-socket joint between the head of the humerus and a cavity of the scapula
n. the part of a garment that covers or fits over the shoulder
shoulder.translation: n. 肩, 肩膀, 衣肩\nvt. 肩负, 负担, 担任\nvi. 用肩推挤

examples.en: Lend me your shoulder for me to lean on.
examples.zh: 把你的肩膀借给我让我依靠。

examples.en: My shoulder hurts so much, I don't know what to do.
examples.zh: 我的肩膀很痛，我不知道怎么办。

examples.en: Tom hooked his arm under John's shoulder and flipped him over.
examples.zh: 汤姆把手臂勾进约翰的腋下，把他翻了过去。

shout.definition: v. utter in a loud voice; talk in a loud voice (usually denoting characteristic manner of speaking)\nv. utter a sudden loud cry
shout.translation: n. 呼喊, 喊声\nvi. 呼喊, 喊叫, 嚷\nvt. 高喊

examples.en: All at once she began to shout in a shrill voice.
examples.zh: 突然间她开始用尖锐的声音大喊。

examples.en: I heard someone shout outside the window.
examples.zh: 我听到窗外有人大叫。

examples.en: When he shouted, the veins in his neck stood out clearly.
examples.zh: 他大喊的时候，脖子上青筋暴起。

shove.definition: n. the act of shoving (giving a push to someone or something)\nv. push roughly
shove.translation: n. 推, 挤\nvt. 推挤, 猛推, 强使\nvi. 推

examples.en: Shove a stick up your ass.
examples.zh: 把一根棍子塞进你的屁股里。

showcase.definition: n. a setting in which something can be displayed to best effect
showcase.translation: n. 陈列橱\n[经] 商品陈列所, 货物陈列架

examples.en: Benedito's salad is a great way to showcase seasonal produce.
She's jealous of the talents that her peers showcase.
Do you have any special talents that you showcase at school?

shower.definition:
n. a plumbing fixture that sprays water over you
n. washing yourself by standing upright under water sprayed from a nozzle
n. a brief period of precipitation
n. a sudden downpour (as of tears or sparks etc) likened to a rain shower
shower.translation: n. 阵雨, 淋浴, 一阵, 展出者, 显示者\nvi. 淋浴, 下阵雨\nvt. 淋湿, 倾注

examples.en: Do you have any rooms with a shower and toilet?
examples.zh: 有带马桶和淋浴的房间吗？

examples.en: By the shower of time, people have forgotten this event.
examples.zh: 在时间的洗礼下，这事件已经被人们遗忘。

examples.en: I didn't have time to take a shower today.
examples.zh: 我今天没时间冲澡。

shrewd.definition: s marked by practical hardheaded intelligence\ns used of persons
shrewd.translation: a. 精明的, 锐利的, 剧烈的, 机灵的, 厉害的

examples.en: I know that Tom is a very shrewd businessman.
I know that Tom is a shrewd businessman.
I know Tom is a very shrewd businessman.

shrink.definition: v. reduce in size; reduce physically\nv. become smaller or draw together\nv. decrease in size, range, or extent
shrink.translation: n. 收缩, 萎缩, 回避\nvi. 收缩, 退缩, 萎缩, 缩小, 回避\nvt. 使收缩, 使缩小

examples.en: Fruit that has been left for a long time will shrink.
examples.zh: 水果放久了，就会萎缩。

shrub.definition: n. a low woody perennial plant usually having several major stems
shrub.translation: n. 矮树, 灌木, 果汁甜酒

examples.en: The latest treatment, artemisinin, comes from a Chinese shrub.
The oleander is an evergreen shrub that doesn't require much care.
Elias checked under every shrub and found nothing.

shrug.definition: n. a gesture involving the shoulders\nv. raise one's shoulders to indicate indifference or resignation

examples.en: She shrugged her shoulders.
examples.zh: 她耸了耸肩。

shut.translation: n. 关闭\nvt. 关上, 闭起, 幽禁, 合拢, 轧住\nvi. 关上, 停止营业

examples.en: He was drunk and forgot to shut the back door.
examples.zh: 他醉得忘了把门关上。

examples.en: It looks like rain. We had better shut the windows.
examples.zh: 好像快要下雨了。我们把窗关上吧。

examples.en: Keep your eyes wide open before marriage, half shut afterwards.
examples.zh: 婚前张开眼，婚后半闭眼。

shutter.definition: n. a mechanical device on a camera that opens and closes to control the time of a photographic exposure\nn. a hinged blind for a window\nv. close with shutters
shutter.translation: n. 百叶窗, 关闭物, 照相机快门, 关闭者\nvt. 为...装百叶窗, 以百叶窗遮闭

examples.en: I forgot to shutter the windows before the storm hit.
He likes to shutter himself away and read a good book.
More light is required when using faster shutter speeds.

shuttle.definition: n. public transport that consists of a bus or train or airplane that plies back and forth between two points\nn. bobbin that passes the weft thread between the warp threads\nv. travel back and forth between two points
shuttle.translation: n. 穿梭, 梭子, 往返移动之物\nv. (使)穿梭移动, 往返运送

examples.en: How long does it take for the airport shuttle to get to the airport?
examples.zh: 穿梭班车到机场需要多长时间？

shy.definition:
n. a quick throw
v. start suddenly, as from fright
v. throw quickly
s. short
shy.translation:
n. 惊跳, 惊避
a. 胆怯的, 畏缩的, 迟疑的, 羞怯的
vi. 惊退, 乱投, 乱掷, 厌恶, 避开
vt. 乱投, 乱掷

examples.en: I was too shy to look her in the face.
examples.zh: 我害羞得不敢正面看她的脸。

examples.en: Yes. She used to be a very shy girl.
examples.zh: 对啊，她以前是一个很害羞的女孩。

examples.en: She cast a shy glance on the young man.
examples.zh: 她羞怯地看了一眼那个年轻人。

sibling.definition: n. a person's brother or sister
sibling.translation: n. 兄弟, 同胞\n[医] 同胞(兄弟姐妹)

examples.en: "Do you have any siblings?" "No, I'm an only child."
examples.zh: “你有没有兄弟姐妹？”　“没有，我是个独生子女。”

examples.en: I've always wondered what it'd be like to have siblings.
examples.zh: 我总是想有兄弟姐妹会怎么样。

examples.en: The youngest siblings are in general the most beautiful ones.
examples.zh: 最小的兄弟姐妹一般都最漂亮。

sick.definition: n. people who are sick\ns. deeply affected by a strong feeling
sick.translation: n. 病人\na. 不舒服, 有病的, 恶心的, 厌恶的, 渴望的, 病态的\nvt. 呕吐, 追击, 使(狗)去攻击

examples.en: As I was sick, I did not go to school.
examples.zh: 由于我生病了，我便没去上学。

examples.en: My son always gets sick when he rides a bus.
examples.zh: 我的儿子每次乘坐公交车都会晕车。

examples.en: I didn't go to the party because I was sick.
examples.zh: 我病了，所以那次聚会没去。

side.definition:
n. a place within a region identified relative to a center or reference location
n. one of two or more contesting groups
n. either the left or right half of a body
n. a surface forming part of the outside of an object
side.translation:
n. 旁边, 侧, 方面, 胁, 侧边, 血统
a. 旁的, 侧的, 次要的
vt. 同意, 支持
vi. 支持, 赞助

examples.en: My house is on the south side of the park.
examples.zh: 我的家在公园南边

examples.en: There was a cottage on the side of the hill.
examples.zh: 山坡上有一个茅屋。

examples.en: There are many stores on either side of the street.
examples.zh: 街道两边有许多商店。

siege.definition: n. the action of an armed force that surrounds a fortified place and isolates it while continuing to attack
siege.translation: n. 包围, 围攻, 再三的努力\nvt. 包围, 围攻

examples.en: A trebuchet is a siege weapon similar to a catapult.
The siege of the fortress lasted a long time.
After a siege lasting ten weeks, the city surrendered.

sigh.definition:
n. an utterance made by exhaling audibly
n. a sound like a person sighing
v. heave or utter a sigh; breathe deeply and heavily
v. utter with a sigh
sigh.translation: n. 叹息\nvi. 叹息, 渴望\nvt. 叹息着说

examples.en: Seeing this scene, I couldn’t help but sigh.
examples.zh: 看见这副景象，我不禁叹了口气。

examples.en: We all breathed a big sigh of relief.
examples.zh: 我们都舒了一口长气。

examples.en: She gave out a sigh of relief.
examples.zh: 她松了一口气。

sight.definition:
n. an instance of visual perception
n. anything that is seen
n. the ability to see; the visual faculty
n. a range of mental vision
sight.translation:
n. 景观, 视力, 眼界, 阅读, 见解, 意见
vt. 看见, 瞄准
vi. 瞄准, 观看
a. 即席的, 见票即付的

examples.en: She began to cry at the sight of my face.
examples.zh: 她看到我的脸就开始哭。

examples.en: I caught sight of a parade on my way home.
examples.zh: 在回家的路上，我看到一场阅兵式。

examples.en: Did you fall in love with her at first sight?
examples.zh: 你对她是不是一见钟情？

signal.definition:
n. any nonverbal action or gesture that encodes a message
n. any incitement to action
n. an electric quantity (voltage or current or field strength) whose modulation represents coded information about the source from which it comes
s. notably out of the ordinary
signal.translation:
n. 信号, 暗号, 近因, 导火线
vt. 向...作信号, 标志, 用信号通知
vi. 发信号
a. 作为信号的, 显著的
[计] 信号

examples.en: An increase in customer complaints could signal a decline in business.
examples.zh: 顾客投诉量增加，可能代表生意正在走下坡。

examples.en: He gave us the signal to begin.
examples.zh: 他给了我们开始的信号。

examples.en: What are you saying? I cannot hear, the signal here is too bad.
examples.zh: 你说什么？我听不见，这里信号太差了。

signature.definition: n. your name written in your own handwriting\nn. a melody used to identify a performer or a dance band or radio/tv program\nn. a sheet with several pages printed on it; it folds to page size and is bound with other signatures to form a book
signature.translation: n. 签字, 识别标志, 调号\n[计] 签名附件

examples.en: Recent J-POP doesn't really have many signature songs, you know.
examples.zh: 你也知道，最近的 J-POP 实际上并没有很多招牌歌曲。

examples.en: I attached my signature to the document.
examples.zh: 我签署了文件。

examples.en: The signature had been a forgery.
examples.zh: 签名是伪造的。

significance.definition: n. the quality of being significant\nn. a meaning that is not expressly stated but can be inferred
significance.translation: n. 重要性, 意义, 意味\n[计] 有效; 有效性

examples.en: I don't understand its significance.
examples.zh: 我没有领会这个意义。

significant.definition: a. important in effect or meaning\ns. fairly large\na. too closely correlated to be attributed to chance and therefore indicating a systematic relation
significant.translation: a. 重要的, 有效的, 有含义的, 暗示的, 值得注意的

examples.en: As everyone knows, today is a very significant day for us.
examples.zh: 大家知道，今天对我们来说是一个很有意义的日子。

examples.en: Survival analysis showed a significant reduction.
examples.zh: 存活分析显示，机率显著减少。

examples.en: We sustained significant losses.
examples.zh: 我们遭受了重大损失。

signify.definition: v. convey or express a meaning\nv. make known with a word or signal
signify.translation: vt. 象征, 预示\nvi. 要紧, 重要

examples.en: This is because you approach everything as a total person, with no loose ends hanging out to signify divided intentions.
examples.zh: 这是因为你总是全身心处理每一件事情，没有让鸡毛蒜皮的问题分散了你的目标。

silence.definition: n. the state of being silent (as when no one is speaking)\nn. the absence of sound\nv. keep from expression, for example by threats or pressure
silence.translation: n. 沉默, 无声, 静寂, 湮没, 无声息\nvt. 使缄默\ninterj. 安静

examples.en: As the saying goes: Speech is silver, silence is gold.
examples.zh: 常言道：言语是银，沉默是金。

examples.en: The eternal silence of these infinite spaces terrifies me.
examples.zh: 这些无限空间的永恒沉默使我恐惧。

examples.en: There was a minute of silence and then everybody started screaming.
examples.zh: 有一分钟的沉默，然后每个人都开始尖叫。

silicon.definition: n. a tetravalent nonmetallic element; next to oxygen it is the most abundant element in the earth's crust; occurs in clay and feldspar and granite and quartz and sand; used as a semiconductor in transistors

examples.en: Could Algeria become the Silicon Valley of the Maghreb region?
Silicon Valley CEOs are a uniquely psychopathic and parasitic bunch.
Tom works for a tech company in Silicon Valley.

silk.definition: n. a fabric made from the fine threads produced by certain insect larvae\nn. animal fibers produced by silkworms and other larvae that spin cocoons and by most spiders
silk.translation: n. 丝, 绸, 绸锻类, 丝织品\na. 丝的, 丝织的

examples.en: She is wearing a pair of white, silk socks.
examples.zh: 她穿著一双白色丝袜。

examples.en: The child is wearing a belly-slip made of silk.
examples.zh: 这个小孩穿着一件丝绸织成的肚兜.

examples.en: The original purpose of the Silk Road was not for trade.
examples.zh: 丝绸之路形成的初衷并非是贸易。

silly.definition: n. a word used for misbehaving children
silly.translation: a. 愚蠢的, 糊涂的

examples.en: My dad was completely shocked by my silly question.
examples.zh: 我爸被我的愚蠢问题彻底吓到了。

examples.en: I need to ask you a silly question.
examples.zh: 我必须问你一个蠢问题。

examples.en: It would be silly to do that again.
examples.zh: 再那样做就太蠢了。

silver.definition:
n. a soft white precious univalent metallic element having the highest electrical and thermal conductivity of any metal; occurs in argentite and in free form; used in coins and jewelry and tableware and photography
n. coins made of silver
v. coat with a layer of silver or a silver amalgam
v. make silver in color
silver.translation:
n. 银, 银币, 银器
a. 银的, 银制的, 银器的
vt. 镀银
vi. 变银白色

examples.en: Donna was born with a silver spoon in her mouth.
examples.zh: Donna是含着金钥匙出生的。

examples.en: As the saying goes: Speech is silver, silence is gold.
examples.zh: 常言道：言语是银，沉默是金。

examples.en: Can you tell silver and tin apart?
examples.zh: 你能分辨银和锡吗?

similar.definition: a. marked by correspondence or resemblance\ns. (of words) expressing closely related meanings
similar.translation: a. 相似的, 类似的\nn. 相似的东西

examples.en: The climate here is very similar to that of England.
examples.zh: 这里的气候和英国十分相似。

examples.en: The climate here is very similar to that in England.
examples.zh: 这里的气候和英国十分相似。

examples.en: The climate of England is similar to that of Hokkaido.
examples.zh: 英国的气候和北海道很相似。

similarity.definition: n. the quality of being similar\nn. a Gestalt principle of organization holding that (other things being equal) parts of a stimulus field that are similar to each other tend to be perceived as belonging together as a unit
similarity.translation: n. 类似, 类似处\n[法] 类似, 相似, 类似事例

examples.en: Assonance is a similarity between words based on their vowel sounds.
I am not writing about myself. Any similarity is purely coincidental.
