The similarity between the two persons is astonishing.

simple.definition:
n. any herbaceous plant having medicinal properties
a. having few parts; not complex or complicated or involved
a. (botany) of leaf shapes; of leaves having no divisions or subdivisions
s. unornamented
simple.translation: a. 简单的, 普通的, 朴素的, 单纯的, 绝对的, 初级的, 原始的, 迟钝的\nn. 出身低微者, 傻子

examples.en: How foolish I was not to discover that simple lie!
examples.zh: 我竟然蠢得被这么简单的谎话骗倒了！

examples.en: Do you want to know my secret? It's very simple...
examples.zh: 你想不想知道我的秘密？它很简单……

examples.en: What we had to do was really quite simple.
examples.zh: 我们要做的很简单。

simplify.definition: v. make simpler or easier or reduce in complexity or extent
simplify.translation: vt. 单一化, 简单化

examples.en: I like simplifying complex problems.
examples.zh: 我喜欢把复杂的问题简单化。

examples.en: If I search for "什么" using Simplified Chinese, I expect to also see "甚麼" in the results.
examples.zh: 如果我用简体中文输入“什么”，我希望找到的结果里也有“甚么”。

examples.en: This is simplified Chinese.
examples.zh: 这是简体字。

simulate.translation: vt. 模拟, 假装, 模仿\n[法] 伪装的, 模拟的; 假装的, 伪装的, 冒充

examples.en: Why not simulate quantum physics with actual quantum physics?
The proposed method is applied to three simulated case studies.
The proposed methodology is applied to three simulated case studies.

simultaneous.definition: s occurring or operating at the same time
simultaneous.translation: a. 同时的, 同时发生的\n[计] 同时的

examples.en: Tom and Mary say they want to become simultaneous interpreters.
He really wants to work as a simultaneous interpreter.
Tom says he wants to become a simultaneous interpreter.

sin.definition:
n. estrangement from god
n. an act that is regarded by theologians as a transgression of God's will
n. (Akkadian) god of the Moon; counterpart of Sumerian Nanna
n. the 21st letter of the Hebrew alphabet
sin.translation: n. 罪, 犯罪, 过失, 失礼\nv. 犯

examples.en: Is it always a sin to tell a lie?
examples.zh: 说谎总是一种罪吗？

examples.en: Repay your sins with your life.
examples.zh: 纳命来赎罪。

sincere.definition: a. open and genuine; not deceitful
sincere.translation: a. 诚实的, 正直的, 真挚的, 纯净的

examples.en: Please accept my sincere congratulations on your success today.
examples.zh: 请接受我对您今天的成功最诚挚的祝贺。

examples.en: Any emotion, if it is sincere, is involuntary.
examples.zh: 任何情绪，只要它是真诚的，就说明它是发自内心的自然流露。

examples.en: I don't think that he is sincere.
examples.zh: 我不觉得他很诚实。

single.definition:
n. a base hit on which the batter stops safely at first base
v. hit a single
a. used of flowers having usually only one row or whorl of petals
a. existing alone or consisting of one entity or part or aspect or individual
single.translation:
a. 单身的, 单程的, 单一的, 个别的, 孤独的, 专一的
n. 一个, 单打, 单程票
vt. 选出
vi. 击出一垒打
[计] 单精度型

examples.en: Not a single cloud could be seen in the sky.
examples.zh: 天上万里无云。

examples.en: A giraffe can kill a lion with a single kick.
examples.zh: 长颈鹿一脚可以踢死狮子。

examples.en: A single step, and you will fall over the cliff.
examples.zh: 只迈一步，你就会落下悬崖。

singular.definition:
n. the form of a word that is used to denote a singleton
s. being a single and separate person or thing
a. composed of one member, set, or kind
a. grammatical number category referring to a single item or unit
singular.translation: n. 单数\na. 异常的, 单一的

examples.en: In German, the feminine definite article's genitive singular is "der".
Is the word "politics" a singular or plural noun?
There are many religions, but the truth is singular.

sink.definition:
n. plumbing fixture consisting of a water basin fixed to a wall or floor and having a drainpipe
n. (technology) a process that acts to absorb or remove energy or a substance from a system
v. fall or descend to a lower place or level
v. cause to sink
sink.translation: n. 藏垢的场所, 沟渠, 污水槽\nvi. 下沉, 沉没, 下陷, 减弱, 衰退, 消沉, 堕落, 渗透\nvt. 使低落, 使下沉, 陷于, 投入(资金等), 挖掘

examples.en: There's a red candle on top of the bathroom sink.
examples.zh: 洗手台上有一个红色的蜡烛。

examples.en: Tom seems to have packed everything but the kitchen sink.
examples.zh: Tom把除了厨房水槽之外的所有东西都打包了。

examples.en: Ziri needs baking soda to clean his kitchen sink.
examples.zh: 齐里需要小苏打，用来清洁他的厨房水槽。

sip.definition: n. a small drink\nv. drink in sips
sip.translation:
n. 啜饮, 小口喝, 抿
vi. 啜饮
vt. 啜
[计] 单列直插式组件

examples.en: He savored a sip of coffee.
examples.zh: 他细细地品了一口咖啡。

examples.en: He sipped the hot coffee slowly.
examples.zh: 他慢慢地啜饮热咖啡。

sir.definition: n. term of address for a man\nn. a title used before the name of knight or baronet

examples.en: Sir, you are not allowed to park your car here.
examples.zh: 先生，您无权把您的车停在这儿。

examples.en: Yes, there are. How many of you are there, Sir?
examples.zh: 有的，先生你有几位？

examples.en: Please don't get mad, sir! I'm a new worker!
examples.zh: 先生，请别生我的气！我是新来的工人！

site.definition: n. the piece of land on which something is located (or is to be located)\nn. physical position in relation to the surroundings
site.translation: n. 位置, 场所, 地点\nvt. 给...择址

examples.en: The site of the castle is now a park.
examples.zh: 城堡的遗迹现在变成了公园。

examples.en: How can I deactivate my account on this site?
examples.zh: 我要怎么停用我在这个网站上的帐户？

examples.en: Ironbridge Gorge is a Unesco world heritage site.
examples.zh: 铁桥峡谷是联合国教科文组织世界遗产。

situate.definition: v. determine or indicate the place, site, or limits of, as if by an instrument or by a survey\nv. put (something somewhere) firmly
situate.translation: vt. 使位于, 使处于

examples.en: Situate yourself near the door if you need to leave early.
The ramifications of situating an abortion clinic between two churches had yet to be realized.
For example, designers can reduce cooling costs depending on how they situate a building to take in sunlight.

situation.definition: n. the general state of things; the combination of circumstances at a given time\nn. a condition or position in which you find yourself\nn. a complex or critical or unusual difficulty
situation.translation: n. 情形, 境遇, 位置\n[医] 情境, 处境

examples.en: I am not in a situation to discuss this problem.
examples.zh: 我不在讨论这个问题的状态。

examples.en: The situation is getting worse and worse day by day.
examples.zh: 情况一天比一天差。

examples.en: The situation was much more complex than he had thought.
examples.zh: 事情可比他所想的要复杂得多。

size.definition:
n. the physical magnitude of something (how big it is)
n. the property resulting from being one of a series of graduated measurements (as of clothing)
n. any glutinous material used to fill pores in surfaces or to stiffen fabrics
n. the actual state of affairs
size.translation:
n. 大小, 尺寸, 规模, 尺码, 能力, 浆料
vt. 上浆, 依大小排列
vi. 可比拟
a. 一定大小的, 一定尺寸的

examples.en: To date nobody knows the actual size of the cosmos.
examples.zh: 宇宙的实际大小至今无人知道。

examples.en: The bird was half the size of a hawk.
examples.zh: 那只鸟的体积有半只老鹰那么大。

examples.en: We have your size, but not in that color.
examples.zh: 我们有你的尺寸，但是没有那个颜色。

skeleton.definition: n. something reduced to its minimal form\nn. a scandal that is kept secret\nn. the internal supporting structure that gives an artifact its shape
skeleton.translation: n. 骨骼, 骨瘦如柴的人, 梗概, 骨干, 残骸\na. 骨骼的, 概略的, 基层的, 骨干的\n[计] 骨架

examples.en: The explorers discovered a skeleton in the cave.
examples.zh: 探险家们在洞穴里发现了骸骨。

examples.en: Tom found a skeleton in the cave.
examples.zh: 汤姆在洞穴里找到了一具骨架。

skeptical.definition: s denying or questioning the tenets of especially a religion\ns marked by or given to doubt
skeptical.translation: a. 怀疑论的, 怀疑的, 不可知论的\n[法] 怀疑的, 不信的, 怀疑论者的

examples.en: We're very skeptical.
examples.zh: 我们非常怀疑。

skepticism.definition: n doubt about the truth of something\nn the disbelief in any claims of ultimate knowledge
skepticism.translation: n. 怀疑论\n[医] 多疑癖

examples.en: The promises he makes cause skepticism to arise.
Real skeptics also apply skepticism to fringe voices, not just mainstream ones.
Skepticism is a vital characteristic of science.

sketch.definition:
n. preliminary drawing for later elaboration
n. a brief literary description
n. short descriptive summary (of events)
v. make a sketch of
sketch.translation: n. 素描, 草图, 小品\nv. 描绘略图, 画素描或速写

examples.en: Tom ripped a page out of his sketch book.
examples.zh: 汤姆从他的绘画本上撕下了一页。

examples.en: Can you sketch it for me on this piece of paper please?
examples.zh: 请你帮我在这张纸上画个草图。

examples.en: Jiro made a sketch of Mt. Fuji.
examples.zh: 次郎画了一幅富士山的素描。

skill.definition: n. an ability that has been acquired by training\nn. ability to produce solutions in some problem domain
skill.translation: n. 技术, 技巧, 技能, 熟练, 熟练工人\n[化] 技能

examples.en: Fluency in English is a very marketable skill today.
examples.zh: 流利的英语在今天是一种十分抢手的技能。

examples.en: My cooking skills are not as good as my mother's.
examples.zh: 我的厨艺比不上我的母亲。

examples.en: He has an interesting job but it requires a lot of skill.
examples.zh: 他有个很有意思但很费功夫的工作。

skilled.definition: a. having or showing or requiring special skill
skilled.translation: a. 熟练的\n[经] 熟练的, 有技能的

examples.en: The position requires applicants to be skilled in spoken English.
examples.zh: 这份职位要求应征者有一定的英语口语表达能力。

examples.en: He is already skilled in both math and literature.
examples.zh: 他既精于数学又精于文学。

examples.en: Skilled soldiers know how to use their environment as a weapon.
examples.zh: 熟练的士兵知道怎么以他们的环境为武器。

skin.definition:
n. a natural protective body covering and site of the sense of touch
n. an outer surface (usually thin)
n. a person's skin regarded as their life
n. a bag serving as a container for liquids; it is made from the hide of an animal
skin.translation: n. 皮肤, 皮\nvt. 剥皮, 在...植皮\nvi. 长皮, 愈合, 蜕皮

examples.en: Anger me again, I might just peel your skin off.
examples.zh: 再惹我生气，小心我扒了你的皮！

examples.en: This medicine will cure you of your skin disease.
examples.zh: 这药可以治疗你的皮肤病。

examples.en: Staying up late at night is very bad for your skin.
examples.zh: 熬夜是皮肤的大敌。

skip.definition: n. a gait in which steps and hops alternate\nv. bound off one point after another
skip.translation:
n. 跳跃, 跳读
vi. 跳越, 跳读, 跳绳, 遗漏, 跳级
vt. 跳过, 遗漏
[计] 跳过

examples.en: Skip the problems you can not do and go ahead.
examples.zh: 跳过做不出来的题目，继续往后做。

examples.en: It's no crime to skip breakfast once in a while.
examples.zh: 偶尔不吃早餐也不会如何不好呀。

examples.en: My physics teacher doesn't care if I skip classes.
examples.zh: 我的物理老师不在乎我是否逃课。

skull.definition: n. the bony skeleton of the head of vertebrates
skull.translation: n. 头盖骨, 头脑, 好学生\n[医] 头颅

examples.en: Tom has a tattoo of a skull on his chest.
examples.zh: 汤姆在胸上有个头骨文身。

examples.en: Another step forward revealed that the skull had received violent impact and disintegrated.
examples.zh: 进一步的检查发现头骨受到剧烈的撞击而碎裂。

examples.en: After careful examination, it can be seen that the skull was smashed to pieces.
examples.zh: 仔细检查后发现，该头骨被重击碎裂。

sky.definition: n. the atmosphere and outer space as viewed from the earth
sky.translation: n. 天空, 天色, 天堂\nvt. 击向空中, 挂在高处\nvi. 高涨

examples.en: You can see a lot of stars in the sky.
examples.zh: 你能看到天空中的繁星。

examples.en: A cloud is a mass of vapor in the sky.
examples.zh: 云是天空中的水汽团。

examples.en: There is a mass of dark clouds in the sky.
examples.zh: 空中有一大片乌云。

slam.definition:
n. winning all or all but one of the tricks in bridge
n. the noise made by the forceful impact of two objects
n. a forceful impact that makes a loud noise
v. close violently
slam.translation: n. 砰然声, 猛然, 猛烈的抨击\nvt. 猛然关上, 砰地关上, 猛烈抨击\nvi. 砰地关上, 猛攻

examples.en: Tom slammed on the brakes and the car began to skid.
examples.zh: 汤姆猛踩煞车，汽车开始打滑。

examples.en: I could hear doors slamming.
examples.zh: 我可以听见门砰砰作响。

examples.en: Did you hear that? That was Mary. She slams the door like that when she's angry.
examples.zh: 你听见了吗？刚那是玛丽。她生气时就会那样摔门。

slap.definition: n. a blow from a flat object (as an open hand)\nv. hit with something flat, like a paddle or the open hand
slap.translation: n. 掴, 掌击, 侮辱, 拍击声\nv. 拍击, 惩罚\nadv. 正面地, 直接地, 突然地

examples.en: She gave him a slap in the face.
examples.zh: 她打了他一巴掌。

examples.en: After slapping Tom's right cheek, Mary stomped on his left foot.
examples.zh: 玛丽给了汤姆的右脸一巴掌，然后踩了他的左脚。

examples.en: Guards! Slap that vile woman's face!
examples.zh: 来人，给我掌这贱女人嘴巴！

slash.definition:
n. an open tract of land in a forest that is strewn with debris from logging (or fire or wind)
n. a strong sweeping cut made with a sharp instrument
v. cut with sweeping strokes; as with an ax or machete
v. cut open
slash.translation: v. 猛砍, 乱砍\nn. 猛砍, 乱砍, 删减\n[计] 斜线

examples.en: The U.S. should slash its military budget in half.
I'm dying for a slash and I can't find a toilet.
Gunter used a huge knife to slash Amelia's tires.

slaughter.definition: n. the killing of animals (as for food)\nn. the savage and excessive killing of many people
slaughter.translation: n. 残杀, 屠杀, 杀戮\nvt. 残杀, 屠杀, 亏本出售

examples.en: Many conservationists fear the continuing slaughter of whales is pushing these animals towards extinction.
examples.zh: 许多自然环境保护主义者担心持续屠杀鲸鱼正推动这些动物走向灭绝。

slave.definition:
n. a person who is owned by someone
n. someone who works as hard as a slave
n. someone entirely dominated by some influence or person
v. work very hard, like a slave
slave.translation: n. 奴隶, 从动装置, 卑鄙的人\nvi. 拼命工作\n[计] 从设备

examples.en: I refuse to be treated like a slave by you.
examples.zh: 我拒绝被你像奴隶一样对待。

examples.en: She is a slave of fashion.
examples.zh: 她是潮流的奴隶。

examples.en: Don't be a slave to money.
examples.zh: 不要成为金钱的奴隶。

slavery.definition: n. the practice of owning slaves\nn. work done under harsh conditions for little or no pay
slavery.translation: n. 奴隶的身分, 奴隶状态, 奴隶制度\n[法] 奴隶制度, 奴役, 苦役

examples.en: War is peace. Freedom is slavery. Ignorance is strength.
examples.zh: 战争即和平，自由即奴役，无知即力量。

examples.en: Slavery is a crime against humanity.
examples.zh: 奴役制是一种危害人类罪。

examples.en: America did away with slavery in 1863.
examples.zh: 美国在一八六三年废除了奴隶制度。

sleep.definition:
n. a natural and periodic state of rest during which consciousness of the world is suspended
n. a torpid state resembling deep sleep
n. a period of time spent sleeping
v. be asleep
sleep.translation: n. 睡眠, 静止, 昏迷, 麻木, 长眠, 冬眠\nvi. 睡觉, 睡眠, 静止\nvt. 睡

examples.en: He was just on the verge of going to sleep.
examples.zh: 他快要睡了。

examples.en: Are you sure you don't want to sleep on it?
examples.zh: 你确定你不想睡在它上面吗？

examples.en: Why do women want to sleep in a man's embrace?
examples.zh: 女人为什么想被男人抱着睡觉？

sleeve.definition: n. the part of a garment that is attached at the armhole and that provides a cloth covering for the arm\nn. small case into which an object fits
sleeve.translation: n. 袖子, 套管\nvt. 缝上袖子

examples.en: The men are wearing short sleeve shirts.
examples.zh: 男人们穿著短袖上衣。

examples.en: Shorter people got more tricks up their sleeves.
examples.zh: 个子矮的人心眼多。

examples.en: Roll up your right sleeve.
examples.zh: 卷起你右边的袖子。

slender.definition:
s. being of delicate or slender build
s. very narrow
s. having little width in proportion to the length or height
s. small in quantity
slender.translation: a. 苗条的, 纤弱的, 微少的, 微薄的\n[机] 细的, 纤细的

examples.en: Slender and form-fitting with a high cut, the new qipao contrasted sharply with the traditional one.
examples.zh: 新的旗袍又修长又紧身，也有短裙摆，与传统式样构成了鲜明的对比。

slice.definition:
n. a share of something
n. a golf shot that curves to the right for a right-handed golfer
n. a thin flat piece cut off of some object
n. a spatula for spreading paint or ink
slice.translation:
n. 薄的切片, 一部分, 菜刀
vt. 切成薄片, 切下
vi. 切
[计] 片

examples.en: I want to slice these potatoes into strips.
examples.zh: 我想把这些土豆切成丝。

examples.en: Do you want a slice of cake?
examples.zh: 你想要一块蛋糕吗?

examples.en: Give me a slice of cake too!
examples.zh: 也给我一块蛋糕！

slide.definition:
n. a small flat rectangular piece of glass on which specimens can be mounted for microscopic study
n. (geology) the descent of a large mass of earth or rocks or snow etc.
n. plaything consisting of a sloping chute down which children can slide
n. the act of moving smoothly along a surface while remaining in contact with it
slide.translation: n. 滑, 滑道, 山崩, 雪崩, 幻灯片\nvt. 使滑动, 偷偷放入\nvi. 滑动, 滑落, 不知不觉陷入, 偷偷地走

examples.en: He slid his arms around her and kissed her.
examples.zh: 他垂下手臂环绕住她然后亲吻。

examples.en: The slow blue puma slides under the diligent cat.
examples.zh: 行动迟缓的蓝色美洲狮从勤奋的猫身下滑过。

examples.en: Hasn't Huiru sent the slides yet? The client's pushing.
examples.zh: 慧如那个简报档还没传喔？客户在催。

slight.definition: v. pay no attention to, disrespect
slight.translation: n. 轻蔑, 怠慢\na. 轻微的, 纤细的, 脆弱的, 苗条的\nvt. 轻视, 忽略, 怠慢

examples.en: Having a slight headache, I went to bed early.
examples.zh: 因为我有点头疼，所以我早早上床睡觉。

examples.en: I had a slight headache, so I went to bed early.
examples.zh: 因为我有点头疼，所以我早早上床睡觉。

examples.en: A slight cold prevented me from going to Ibusuki with my family.
examples.zh: 我有点感冒，没能和家人一起去指宿。

slim.definition: v take off weight\ns being of delicate or slender build\ns small in quantity
slim.translation: a. 瘦的, 苗条的, 微小的, 稀少的, 微薄的\nvi. 变苗条\nvt. 使苗条

examples.en: She has blonde hair and a slim figure.
examples.zh: 她有著一头金发，瘦高的身材。

examples.en: Hsin-yi got so much slimmer lately. Is it gym or heartbreak?
examples.zh: 欣怡最近瘦好多喔，是去健身房还是失恋啊？

examples.en: His body type is born balanced! Wide shoulders, slim waist, belly not popping outwards.
examples.zh: 他的体形生得很匀称！肩膀宽，腰身窄，肚子又没凸出来。

slip.definition:
n. a minor inadvertent mistake usually observed in speech or writing or in small accidents or memory lapses etc.
n. potter's clay that is thinned and used for coating or decorating ceramics
n. a young and slender person
n. an accidental misstep threatening (or causing) a fall
slip.translation:
n. 滑, 滑行, 事故, 溜, 差错, 滑台, 下降, 插条, 后裔, 板条, 瘦长的年轻人
vi. 滑动, 滑倒, 失足, 溜走, 滑落, 犯错, 变坏
vt. 使滑动, 滑过, 摆脱, 闪开, 塞入, 从...取接枝
a. 滑动的, 滑移的, 活络的, 有活结的
[计] 串行线接口协议

examples.en: A slip of the tongue often brings about unexpected results.
examples.zh: 一时失言常常会带来意想不到的结果。

examples.en: Tom talked too much and let the secret slip.
examples.zh: 汤姆话太多，不小心把秘密泄露了出去。

examples.en: A slip of the tongue is sometimes fatal to a politician.
examples.zh: 有时候口误对政治家来说是致命的。

slippery.definition: a. causing or tending to cause things to slip or slide\ns. not to be trusted
slippery.translation: a. 滑的, 光滑的, 靠不住的, 圆滑的, 不稳固的\n[法] 狡猾的, 不可靠的, 不安定的

examples.en: Driving on a slippery road can lead to a car wreck.
examples.zh: 在光滑的路上开车会导致车祸。

examples.en: The slippery snake slithered right out of his hand.
examples.zh: 那条蛇滑溜溜的，一下子就从他的手中掉了出来。

examples.en: The roads are slippery on a rainy day. Be careful not to fall.
examples.zh: 雨天路滑，小心摔跤。

slogan.definition: n a favorite saying of a sect or political group
slogan.translation: n. 呐喊声, 标语, 口号

examples.en: The slogan for the day was "colorful instead of brown".
We need a campaign slogan that'll really energize the base.
David was campaigning on the slogan of "Freedom and Peace."

slope.definition: n. an elevated geological formation\nv. be at an angle
slope.translation: n. 倾斜, 斜坡, 斜率, 扛枪姿势\nvt. 使倾斜, 弄斜, 扛\nvi. 倾斜, 走, 逃走

examples.en: The path zigzagged up the steep slope.
examples.zh: 这条小路沿著陡峭的斜坡蜿蜒而上。

examples.en: We climbed a sharp slope.
examples.zh: 我们爬上陡坡。

slot.definition:
n. a position in a grammatical linguistic construction in which a variety of alternative units are interchangeable
n. a small slit (as for inserting a coin or depositing mail)
n. a position in a hierarchy or organization
n. the trail of an animal (especially a deer)
slot.translation: n. 水沟, 细长孔, 硬币投币口, 缝, 狭槽, 狭通道, 位置, 一档(广播节目等)\nvt. 开槽于, 把...纳入机构\n[计] 槽; 存储槽

examples.en: Mary inserted a stick of RAM into the RAM slot.
Insert the VHS tape into the slot, and press play.
The network is moving your show to another time slot.

slow.definition:
v. become slow or slower
v. cause to proceed more slowly
a. not moving quickly; taking a comparatively long time
a. at a slow tempo
slow.translation: a. 慢的, 缓慢的, 迟缓的, 迟钝的, 冷漠的, 落后的\nadv. 慢地, 迟缓地\nv. (使)慢下来

examples.en: It's a bit slow, can you wait for a bit?
examples.zh: 现在有点慢，能不能等一下？

examples.en: When PC problems slow you down, what can you do?
examples.zh: 当电脑出现问题导致您的工作速度变慢时，您该怎么办？

examples.en: When you are driving, you should slow down on corners.
examples.zh: 当您开车的时候，应该在转弯处减速。

slum.definition: n. a district of a city marked by poverty and inferior living conditions\nv. spend time at a lower socio-economic level than one's own, motivated by curiosity or desire for adventure; usage considered condescending and insensitive
slum.translation: n. 贫民窟\nvi. 访问贫民区

examples.en: There are a lot of slums in Mexico.
examples.zh: 在墨西哥有很多贫民窟。

examples.en: Tom lives in a slum.
examples.zh: 汤姆住在贫民窟里。

examples.en: There are many slums in Mexico.
examples.zh: 在墨西哥有很多贫民窟。

slump.definition:
n. a noticeable deterioration in performance or quality
v. assume a drooping posture or carriage
v. fall or sink heavily
v. fall heavily or suddenly; decline markedly
slump.translation: n. 暴跌, 垂头弯腰的姿态\nvi. 猛然掉落, 陷入, 衰落(经济等)

examples.en: The Taiwanese dollar appreciated, causing Taiwanese exports to slump.
examples.zh: 台币上涨，造成台湾的出口贸易萎靡不振。

smart.definition:
n. a kind of pain such as that caused by a wound or a burn or a sore
a. showing mental alertness and calculation and resourcefulness
s. painfully severe
s. quick and brisk
smart.translation: a. 聪明的, 漂亮的, 刺痛的, 剧烈的, 敏捷的, 巧妙的, 伶俐的, 潇洒的\nn. 刺痛, 痛苦\nvi. 刺痛

examples.en: Tom isn't nearly as smart as he thinks he is.
examples.zh: 汤姆并不像他自认为的那么聪明。

examples.en: Is Tom really as smart as people think he is?
examples.zh: 汤姆真的有人们认为的那样聪明吗？

examples.en: She's beautiful, smart, and - most importantly - has a good heart.
examples.zh: 她很漂亮，聪明，并且最重要的是，她有一颗善良的心。

smash.definition:
n. a serious collision (especially of motor vehicles)
v. hit hard
v. break into pieces, as by striking or knocking over
v. hit violently
smash.translation:
n. 打碎, 粉碎, 打碎时哗啦声, 猛击, 扣球, 杀球, 经营失败, 破产, 硬币, 假硬币
a. 非常轰动的, 了不起的
vt. 打碎, 粉碎, 击溃, 使破产, 使裂变, 使用假硬币
vi. 碎裂, 猛撞, 破产, 扣球, 杀球
adv. 轰隆一声, 哗啦一声

examples.en: The front windshield of a car was smashed to pieces.
examples.zh: 车头的挡风玻璃被砸至粉碎。

examples.en: The glass from a round table has been smashed.
examples.zh: 一块圆桌玻璃被打碎了。

examples.en: Someone smashed the windshield of my new car.
examples.zh: 有人把我新车的挡风玻璃砸碎了。

smell.definition:
n. the sensation that results when olfactory receptors in the nose are stimulated by particular chemicals in gaseous form
n. the faculty that enables us to distinguish scents
n. the act of perceiving the odor of something
v. inhale the odor of; perceive by the olfactory sense
smell.translation: n. 味道, 气味, 嗅觉, 嗅, 臭味, 气息\nvt. 闻, 探出, 察觉, 发出...的气味\nvi. 嗅, 散发气味, 发臭

examples.en: The air was permeated by the smell of the sea.
examples.zh: 空气中充斥著海的气息。

examples.en: You smell it. Do five spice tea eggs smell good?
examples.zh: 你闻闻香味，五香茶叶蛋香不香？

examples.en: The best fish smell when they are three days old.
examples.zh: 最好的鱼三天就要发臭。

smile.definition: n. a facial expression characterized by turning up the corners of the mouth; usually shows pleasure or amusement\nv. change one's facial expression by spreading the lips, often to signal pleasure\nv. express with a smile
smile.translation: n. 微笑, 喜色, 笑容\nvi. 微笑, 觉得好笑\nvt. 微笑着表示

examples.en: Whenever I hear this song, I think of his smile.
examples.zh: 只要听到这首歌，我就会想起他们的笑容。

examples.en: She saw her mother and gave a little smile.
examples.zh: 她看见了她的母亲，露出了微笑。

examples.en: Fadil was a man with a million dollar smile.
examples.zh: 法迪尔是个拥有迷人笑容的男人。

smoke.definition:
n. a cloud of fine particles suspended in a gas
n. a hot vapor containing fine particles of carbon being produced by combustion
n. an indication of some hidden activity
n. something with no concrete substance
smoke.translation: n. 烟, 雾气, 烟熏剂, 抽烟, 烟色\nvi. 吸烟, 冒烟, 弥漫\nvt. 以烟熏, 抽烟而导致...

examples.en: I used to smoke a lot, but now I've quit.
examples.zh: 我以前常抽烟，但现在我戒掉了。

examples.en: Look at that smoke. That building must be on fire.
examples.zh: 你看，那边正在冒烟，那栋大厦一定是失火了。

examples.en: Tom doesn't like people who smoke in no smoking areas.
examples.zh: 汤姆讨厌在禁烟区吸烟的人。

smooth.definition:
n. the act of smoothing
v. make smooth or smoother, as if by rubbing
v. free from obstructions
a. having a surface free from roughness or bumps or ridges or irregularities
smooth.translation:
a. 平滑的, 平稳的, 流畅的, 和蔼的, 安祥的, 圆滑的, 调匀的, 无毛的
vt. 使光滑, 烫平, 使平和, 消除
vi. 变平滑, 变平静
n. 一块平地, 平滑部分

examples.en: Blend the mixture together until it is smooth.
examples.zh: 将混合物搅拌均匀。

examples.en: It's as smooth as a baby's bottom.
examples.zh: 它像婴儿的屁股一样光滑。

examples.en: The reimagined user interface allows smoother play across devices.
examples.zh: 全新设计的操作介面能让玩家在各种装置上享受更流畅的体验。

snake.definition:
n. limbless scaly elongate reptile; some are venomous
n. a deceitful or treacherous person
n. a tributary of the Columbia River that rises in Wyoming and flows westward; discovered in 1805 by the Lewis and Clark Expedition
n. something long, thin, and flexible that resembles a snake
snake.translation: n. 蛇, 阴险的人\nvi. 曲折行进\nvt. 迂回, 拉, 急抽

examples.en: He froze with fear when he saw the snake.
examples.zh: 他看见蛇就吓得不动了。

examples.en: The mere thought of a snake makes me shiver.
examples.zh: 一想到蛇就发颤。

examples.en: We suspect it's about a poisoning by snake bite.
examples.zh: 我们猜这是一种被蛇咬伤的毒。

snap.definition:
n. a spell of cold weather
n. the noise produced by the rapid movement of a finger from the tip to the base of the thumb on the same hand
n. a sudden breaking
n. a fastener used on clothing; fastens with a snapping sound
snap.translation:
vt. 使突然中断, 猛咬, 争夺, 拉断, 使有啪啪声, 厉声说, 突然射击, 用快照拍摄
vi. 咬, 扑, 抓, 折断, 劈啪地响, 厉声说, 砰然关上
n. 猛咬, 猛扑, 劈啪声, 申斥, 快照, 活力, 一般时期的寒冷天气, 揿钮
a. 突然的, 装搭扣的
adv. 猛地
[计] 子网访问协议

examples.en: Sorry, I didn't mean to snap at you.
examples.zh: 对不起，我并不想对你发火。

examples.en: A cold snap spread across Europe.
examples.zh: 一股寒流侵袭了欧洲。

examples.en: The B4 and D-sharp-5 strings snapped.
examples.zh: B4和升D5的弦断了。

snatch.definition:
n. a small fragment
n. a weightlift in which the barbell is lifted overhead in one rapid motion
v. to grasp hastily or eagerly
v. to make grasping motions
snatch.translation: n. 抢夺, 攫取, 片断\nvt. 夺取, 攫取\nvi. 想抢走, 攫取

examples.en: You have to snatch at happiness when you can.
A hornbill could snatch around ten bats every evening.
Love is something that you can neither snatch away nor express.

sneak.definition: n. a person who is regarded as underhanded and furtive and contemptible\nv. to go stealthily or furtively\nv. put, bring, or take in a secretive or furtive manner
sneak.translation:
vi. 鬼鬼祟祟做事
vt. 偷偷地做
n. 鬼鬼祟祟的人, 偷偷摸摸的行为, 帆布胶底运动鞋
a. 暗中进行的

examples.en: David decided to sneak into the kitchen and find something delicious to eat.
examples.zh: 大卫决定偷偷溜进厨房，找点好吃的吃。

examples.en: Tom sneaked up behind Mary.
examples.zh: 汤姆鬼鬼祟祟地溜近了玛丽身后。

examples.en: Every night, when all was quiet, he would sneak into his neighbour's garden to nick an apple.
examples.zh: 每天晚上，当周围安静下来，他就会偷溜进邻居的花园里偷走一颗苹果。

snow.definition:
n. precipitation falling from clouds in the form of ice crystals
n. a layer of snowflakes (white crystals of frozen water) covering the ground
n. English writer of novels about moral dilemmas in academe (1905-1980)
v. fall as snow
snow.translation: n. 雪, 积雪, 下雪, 雪花形干扰\nvi. 下雪, 似雪般落下\nvt. 使雪白, 用雪覆盖, 使像雪般落下

examples.en: They found the track of a bear in the snow.
examples.zh: 他们在雪地里找到了熊的脚印。

examples.en: School was closed for the day due to the snow.
examples.zh: 学校因大雪停课一天。

examples.en: Tom told Mary that it would probably snow all day.
examples.zh: 汤姆告诉玛丽雪可能会下一整天。

so-called.translation: a. 所谓的, 号称的\n[法] 所谓的, 据称的

examples.en: Looks like these so-called painters can't paint anything.
examples.zh: 看来这些所谓的画家啥也不会画。

examples.en: So-called regional specialities are things prized by out-of-towners but spurned by locals.
examples.zh: 所谓特产，就是外地人奉之为宝，本地人嗤之以鼻的东西。

examples.en: She is a so-called bookworm.
examples.zh: 她就是所谓的书虫。

soap.definition:
n. a cleansing agent made from the salts of vegetable or animal fats
n. money offered as a bribe
n. street names for gamma hydroxybutyrate
v. rub soap all over, usually with the purpose of cleaning
soap.translation: n. 肥皂, 阿谀\nvt. 以肥皂洗, 阿谀\n[计] 评语

examples.en: Our love affair was as short-lived as a soap bubble.
examples.zh: 我们的爱情就像肥皂泡一样脆弱。

examples.en: This soap is infused with natural fragrances.
examples.zh: 这块肥皂里添加了天然香料。

examples.en: They wash their hands with soap.
examples.zh: 他们用肥皂洗手。

soar.definition:
n. the act of rising upward into the air
v. rise rapidly
v. fly upwards or high in the sky
v. go or move upward
soar.translation: n. 高扬, 翱翔\nvi. 往上飞舞, 高耸, 翱翔

examples.en: The birds soar in the air.
examples.zh: 鸟儿在空中飞翔。

examples.en: The value of the yen has soared.
examples.zh: 日元的价值大幅上升。

examples.en: Travel agencies' profits soared.
examples.zh: 旅行社的利润猛涨。

sober.definition: v. cause to become sober\na. not affected by a chemical substance (especially alcohol)
sober.translation: a. 未醉的, 稳重的, 节制的, 严肃的, 不夸大的, 合理的, 朴素的\nvt. 使醒酒, 使严肃\nvi. 从醉里醒来, 变严肃

examples.en: I was as sober as a judge.
examples.zh: 我当时非常清醒。

examples.en: I was very sober at the time.
examples.zh: 我当时非常清醒。

soccer.definition: n. a football game in which two teams of 11 players try to kick or head a ball into the opponents' goal

examples.en: The soccer game will be played, even if it rains.
examples.zh: 就算下雨，足球比赛也会如期进行。

examples.en: This soccer match is full of energetic and splendid competition.
examples.zh: 这场足球赛充满着激情和精彩的竞争。

examples.en: I don't like soccer, but I like watching it.
examples.zh: 我不喜欢足球，但是喜欢看足球。

sociable.definition: n. a party of people assembled to promote sociability and communal activity\na. inclined to or conducive to companionship with others\ns. friendly and pleasant
sociable.translation: a. 好交际的, 社交的, 过社会生活的\nn. 联谊会

examples.en: I attended the party just to be sociable.
examples.zh: 我去那个派对纯粹是为了交际。

social.definition:
a. relating to human society and its members
a. living together or enjoying life in communities or organized groups
a. relating to or belonging to or characteristic of high society
s. composed of sociable people or formed for the purpose of sociability
social.translation: a. 社会的, 群居的, 社交的\nn. 联欢会

examples.en: Germany adopted a social security system in the 1880's.
examples.zh: 德国在1880年代采取了一种社会保障制度。

examples.en: The natural sciences are harder than the social sciences.
examples.zh: 理科比文科难。

examples.en: I believe that a fine education can change one's social status.
examples.zh: 我相信良好的教育能改变人的社会地位。

socialism.definition: n. a political theory advocating state ownership of industry\nn. an economic system based on state ownership of capital
socialism.translation: n. 社会主义, 社会主义运动

examples.en: Is the Party for Socialism and Liberation a cult?
Socialism is the same as Communism, only better English.
In the 1970s, Algeria accepted socialism as its ideology.

society.definition: n. an extended social group having a distinctive cultural and economic organization\nn. the fashionable elite
society.translation: n. 社会；社交界；交往；社团

examples.en: America likes to claim that it is a "classless" society.
examples.zh: 美国是一个自称没有社会阶层的国家。

examples.en: In our society we find men of integrity along with crooks.
examples.zh: 我们的社会良莠不齐。

examples.en: Respect for law is fundamental to our society.
examples.zh: 尊重法律是我们社会的基础。

sociology.definition: n. the study and classification of human societies
sociology.translation: n. 社会学\n[医] 社会学

examples.en: He not only graduated from studying sociology, but also philosophy.
examples.zh: 他不仅社会学毕业，还有哲学。

examples.en: The student is working at sociology.
examples.zh: 那个学生正在学习社会学。

examples.en: Frank majored in sociology at university.
examples.zh: 弗兰克在大学主修社会学。

socket.definition: n. a bony hollow into which a structure fits\nn. receptacle where something (a pipe or probe or end of a bone) is inserted\nn. a receptacle into which an electric device can be inserted
socket.translation: n. 窝, 穴, 插座, 眼窝\nvt. 插进插座\n[计] 套接字

examples.en: I need the extension cord. The socket is too far.
I need to plug the cable into the socket.
The socket came out of the wall quite easily.

soft.definition:
a. yielding readily to pressure or weight
a. compassionate and kind; conciliatory
a. (of sound) relatively low in volume
a. not protected against attack (especially by nuclear weapons)
soft.translation: a. 软的, 温和的, 柔和的, 柔滑的, 温柔的, 软弱的, 坡度小的, 笨的, 纸币的\nn. 柔软的东西, 笨人, 纸币\nadv. 柔软地, 温和地

examples.en: Your lips are soft like the surface of a cactus.
examples.zh: 你的嘴唇软绵绵的，就像仙人掌的表皮一样。

examples.en: This towel is so soft and fluffy. It feels good!
examples.zh: 这条毛巾蓬松又柔软，特别舒服。

examples.en: Root beer is considered a classic American carbonated soft drink.
examples.zh: 麦根沙士被视为一种经典的美式碳酸饮品。

software.definition: n. (computer science) written programs or procedures or rules and associated documentation pertaining to the operation of a computer system and that are stored in read/write memory
software.translation: n. 软件\n[计] 软设备

examples.en: Pierre has a lot of pirated software on his computer.
examples.zh: Pierre电脑里有很多盗版软件。

examples.en: I use all kinds of software to study Chinese.
examples.zh: 我用各种各样的软件学习中文。

examples.en: Software is like sex: it's better when it's free.
examples.zh: 软件就像性交一样，免费的更好。

soil.definition: n. the part of the earth's surface consisting of humus and disintegrated rock
soil.translation: n. 土壤, 土地, 国家, 国土, 温床, 污物, 粪便, 水池\nvt. 弄脏, 污辱\nvi. 变脏

examples.en: She renewed the soil in the flower pot.
examples.zh: 她更新了花盆里的土。

examples.en: Nothing seems to grow in this soil.
examples.zh: 这个土壤似乎长不出任何东西来。

examples.en: The rain washed away the soil.
examples.zh: 土壤被雨水冲走了。

solar.definition: a. relating to or derived from the sun or utilizing the energies of the sun
solar.translation: a. 太阳的, 日光的, 源自太阳的\n[医] 太阳的; 腹腔丛的

examples.en: The Sun is in the center of the solar system.
examples.zh: 太阳在太阳系的中心。

examples.en: Saturn is the second largest planet in the Solar System.
examples.zh: 土星是太阳系中第二大的行星。

examples.en: Saturn is the second largest planet in the solar system.
examples.zh: 土星是太阳系中第二大的行星。

sole.definition:
n. the underside of footwear or a golf club
n. lean flesh of any of several flatfish
n. the underside of the foot
n. right-eyed flatfish; many are valued as food; most common in warm seas especially European
sole.translation: n. 脚掌, 鞋底, 底部\na. 唯一的, 仅有的, 单独的, 独身的\nvt. 上鞋底, 触底

examples.en: There was some chewing gum on the sole of Tom's shoe.
examples.zh: 汤姆的鞋底粘了口香糖。

examples.en: Some chewing gum was stuck to the sole of Tom's shoe.
examples.zh: 汤姆的鞋底粘了口香糖。

examples.en: There was some chewing gum stuck to the sole of Tom's shoe.
examples.zh: 汤姆的鞋底粘了口香糖。

solely.definition: r without any others being included or involved

examples.en: Victory and defeat aren't solely decided by the size of your army.
examples.zh: 胜败不能单靠兵力多少。

examples.en: Tom wanted to be able to read the original Quran and solely for that reason he started learning Arabic.
examples.zh: 汤姆是为了能够看懂古兰经的原文才去开始学习阿拉伯语的。

solemn.definition: s dignified and somber in manner or character and committed to keeping promises\ns characterized by a firm and humorless belief in the validity of your opinions
solemn.translation: a. 严肃的, 郑重的, 庄严的

examples.en: Ziri and Rima shook hands and swore a solemn oath.
A solemn wisp of smoke rose from the shattered city.
They watched the solemn ceremony in the church with awe.

solicitor.definition: n. a petitioner who solicits contributions or trade or votes\nn. a British lawyer who gives legal advice and prepares legal documents
solicitor.translation: n. (英)律师, 初级律师, (美)法务官, (美)掮客, 游说者, (美)募捐者\n[经] 募损者, 律师

examples.en: I asked the solicitor to make out my will.
I think she'll be successful as a solicitor.
I'll let you know my decision after I have consulted my solicitor.

solid.definition:
n. matter that is solid at room temperature and pressure
n. the state in which a substance has no tendency to flow under moderate stress; resists forces (such as compression) that tend to deform it; and retains a definite size and shape
n. a three-dimensional shape
s. characterized by good substantial quality
solid.translation: n. 固体\na. 坚硬的, 稳固的, 固体的, 实心的, 纯质的, 立体的, 立方的\n[计] 原色

examples.en: Water is liquid. When it freezes, it becomes solid.
examples.zh: 水是液体。冻起来就成了固体。

examples.en: Can you do me a solid?
examples.zh: 可以帮我一个忙吗?

examples.en: Water becomes solid when it freezes.
examples.zh: 水结冰后成为固体。

solidarity.definition: n. a union of interests or purposes or sympathies among members of a group
solidarity.translation: n. 团结, 团结一致, 共同一致\n[法] 团结, 共同责任

examples.en: What can we do to strengthen the movement of solidarity with the Palestinian people?
examples.zh: 我们能做些什么来加强声援巴勒斯坦人民的运动？

solo.definition:
n. any activity that is performed alone without assistance
n. a musical composition for one voice or instrument (with or without accompaniment)
n. a flight in which the aircraft pilot is unaccompanied
v. fly alone, without a co-pilot or passengers
solo.translation: n. 独奏, 独唱, 单独表演\na. 单独的, 独奏的, 独唱的\nvi. 放单飞

examples.en: Famous vibraphonist Stefon Harris has recorded at least one balafon solo.
examples.zh: 著名的铁琴演奏家Stefon Harris已经录制了至少一个巴拉风独奏。

examples.en: Charles Lindbergh made the first solo flight across the Atlantic Ocean in 1927.
examples.zh: Charles Lindbergh于1927年成功完成了第一次独自飞越大西洋。

examples.en: I hope you practiced your flute solo!
examples.zh: 我希望你练习了你的长笛独奏！

solution.definition:
n. a homogeneous mixture of two or more substances; frequently (but not necessarily) a liquid solution
n. a statement that solves a problem or explains how to solve the problem
n. a method for solving a problem
n. the set of values that give a true statement when substituted into an equation
solution.translation: n. 解决, 解答, 溶液\n[化] 溶液

examples.en: There couldn’t be a more ideal solution than that.
examples.zh: 再没有比这更如意的办法了。

examples.en: I am sure that we will find a solution.
examples.zh: 我确信我们会找到解决办法的。

examples.en: I am certain that we will find a solution.
examples.zh: 我确信我们会找到解决办法的。

solve.definition: v. find the solution to (a problem or question) or understand the meaning of
solve.translation:
vt. 解决, 付给, 溶解
vt. 求解
vi. 求解
[计] 求解

examples.en: This is a problem you have to solve by yourself.
examples.zh: 这是一个你必须自己解决的问题。

examples.en: Avoiding a problem isn't going to help you solve it.
examples.zh: 逃避并不能解决问题。

examples.en: Could you possibly suggest a way to solve the problem?
examples.zh: 你能提出解决问题的方法吗？

somehow.definition: r. in some unspecified way or manner; or by some unspecified means\nr. for some unspecified reason;

examples.en: The plush fur of the toy felt so soft and somehow soothing.
examples.zh: 那个玩具绒毛摸起来很柔软，让人感到舒适。

examples.en: I feel like somehow I've stopped thinking of translation as something enjoyable.
examples.zh: 不知怎么的，我觉得翻译好像已经不再是一件乐事了。

examples.en: We have to have fun somehow.
examples.zh: 我们总得找点乐子。

somewhat.definition: r to a small degree or extent\nr to a moderately sufficient extent or degree
somewhat.translation: n. 某物, 几分\nadv. 多少, 几分

examples.en: While walking, I used to feel somewhat in a hurry.
examples.zh: 以前，我散步的时候感觉有点匆忙。

examples.en: The rental should be somewhat close to where I work.
examples.zh: 租的房屋要离我工作地方近一点。

examples.en: Tom, Mary, John and Alice all looked somewhat surprised.
examples.zh: 汤姆、玛丽、约翰和爱丽丝都显得有些惊讶。

son.definition: n. a male human offspring\nn. the divine word of God; the second person in the Trinity (incarnate in Jesus)
son.translation: n. 儿子, 女婿, 子孙\n[法] 儿子, 女婿, 养子

examples.en: My son is not at home, he is at school.
examples.zh: 我儿子不在家，他在学校。

examples.en: Do I have to bring my son to your office?
examples.zh: 我必须带我的儿子到你的办公室吗？

examples.en: My son always gets sick when he rides a bus.
examples.zh: 我的儿子每次乘坐公交车都会晕车。

soon.translation: adv. 不久, 早, 快, 宁可

examples.en: As soon as I left home, I ran into her.
examples.zh: 我一离开家就遇见了她。

examples.en: I may give up soon and just take a nap.
examples.zh: 也许我会马上放弃然后去打盹。

examples.en: Drop me a line as soon as you get there.
examples.zh: 到了那儿之后跟我说一声儿。

soothe.translation: vt. 缓和, 使安静, 安慰, 奉承\nvi. 起安慰作用

examples.en: The plush fur of the toy felt so soft and somehow soothing.
examples.zh: 那个玩具绒毛摸起来很柔软，让人感到舒适。

sophisticated.definition: a. having or appealing to those having worldly knowledge and refinement and savoir-faire\ns. intellectually appealing
sophisticated.translation: a. 复杂的, 久经世故的\n[法] 尖端的, 高级的, 非常有经验的

examples.en: A vast and sophisticated system is usually based on a few simple rules.
examples.zh: 庞大而精妙的体系往往建立在几个简单的规则之上。

sore.translation: a. 悲伤的, 痛的, 引起痛苦的\nn. 痛处, 溃疡, 疮

examples.en: I have a very sore arm where you hit me.
examples.zh: 你打在我手臂上的地方超级痛。

examples.en: Mother applied the medicine to the sore on my knee.
examples.zh: 母亲把药膏涂在了我膝盖的伤口上。

examples.en: Do you have a fever and a sore throat?
examples.zh: 你发烧和喉咙痛吗?

sorry.definition:
a feeling or expressing regret or sorrow or a sense of loss over something done or undone
s bad; unfortunate
s without merit
s causing dejection
sorry.translation: a. 难过的, 悲哀的, 遗憾的

examples.en: Sorry it took me so long to write to you.
examples.zh: 对不起, 我过了这么长的时间才回你的信。

examples.en: I am sorry to have kept you waiting so long.
examples.zh: 对不起，让你久等了。

examples.en: I'm sorry I made you wait for so long today.
examples.zh: 今天很抱歉，让你等了这么多时间。

sort.definition: n. an approximate definition or example\nn. a person of a particular character or nature\nn. an operation that segregates items into groups according to a specified criterion
sort.translation:
n. 种类, 方式, 品质, 态度, 举止
vt. 分类, 排序, 挑选
vi. 交往, 协调
[计] 排序; DOS外部命令:从标准输入设备接收数据, 整个数据输入完后
对它以行为单位进行排序, 然后在标准输出设备上输出

examples.en: In the furry fandom, many are artists of some sort.
examples.zh: 在福瑞圈子里，不少人都会进行一些创作。

examples.en: It's sort of fashionable, but the price is too high!
examples.zh: 虽然时髦一点，但是价钱太大！

examples.en: You understand more than me about this sort of thing.
examples.zh: 这件事，你知道得比我清楚。

soul.definition:
n. the immaterial part of a person; the actuating cause of an individual life
n. deep feeling or emotion
n. the human embodiment of something
n. a secular form of gospel that was a major Black musical genre in the 1960s and 1970s
soul.translation: n. 灵魂, 心灵, 精神, 精髓, 人, 化身, 典型, 鬼魂\na. 黑人的

examples.en: Me without you is like a body with no soul.
examples.zh: 没有了你，我就像没有灵魂的躯体。

examples.en: Since then he has put his soul into his work.
examples.zh: 从那时起，他就把他整个灵魂投入到他的工作。

examples.en: The soul is made up of reason, determination, and passion.
examples.zh: 灵魂是由理性、意志和情欲构成的。

sound.definition:
n. the particular auditory effect produced by a given cause
n. the subjective sensation of hearing something
n. mechanical vibrations transmitted by an elastic medium
n. the sudden occurrence of an audible event
sound.translation:
n. 声音, 语音, 吵闹, 声调, 听力范围, 探条, 海峡
a. 健全的, 可靠的, 合理的, 健康的, 彻底的, 资金充实的
adv. 彻底地, 充分地
vi. 发出声音, 回响, 测深, 试探, 听起来
vt. 使发声, 宣告, 听诊, 测...深, 试探
[计] 声音

examples.en: It may sound strange, but what she said is true.
examples.zh: 听起来或许有点怪，但她说的是真的。

examples.en: I just felt like hearing the sound of your voice.
examples.zh: 我只是想要听听你的嗓音。

examples.en: It might sound far-fetched, but this is a real problem.
examples.zh: 这可能听起来牵强，但却是个真实的问题。

source.definition:
n. a document (or organization) from which information is obtained
n. anything that provides inspiration for later work
n. a facility where something is available
n. (technology) a process by which energy or a substance enters a system
source.translation: n. 来源, 水源, 根源, 原始资料, 源\n[计] 来源, 源程序

examples.en: His work is a source of pride for him.
examples.zh: 他以他的工作为傲。

examples.en: I can't locate the source of the problem.
examples.zh: 我无法找到问题的根源。

examples.en: Money by itself isn't a source of happiness.
examples.zh: 金钱本身并不是幸福的来源。

sovereign.definition: n. a nation's ruler or head of state usually by hereditary right\ns. greatest in status or authority or power
sovereign.translation: n. 元首, 独立国\na. 具有主权的, 至高无上的, 国王的, 完全的

examples.en: I hope for Taiwan to be a sovereign democratic country.
examples.zh: 我希望台湾是主权独立的民主国家。

examples.en: Zelensky is a democratically elected president of a sovereign country.
examples.zh: 泽伦斯基是一位主权国家的民选总统。

examples.en: Zelenskyy is an elected president of a sovereign country.
examples.zh: 泽伦斯基是一位主权国家的民选总统。

sovereignty.definition: n. government free from external control\nn. the authority of a state to govern another state
sovereignty.translation: n. 主权, 独立国\n[法] 主权, 主权国家, 统治权

examples.en: China is an advocate for the Diaoyu Islands' sovereignty.
examples.zh: 中国主张钓鱼岛的主权。

examples.en: We need to defend Taiwan's sovereignty.
examples.zh: 我们需要保卫台湾的主权。

sow.definition: n. an adult female hog\nv. place (seeds) in or on the ground for future growth\nv. introduce into an environment
sow.translation: n. 母猪, 懒胖女人\nvt. 播种, 散布, 使密布\nvi. 播种

examples.en: As you sow, so will you reap.
examples.zh: 种瓜得瓜，种豆得豆。

examples.en: As you sow, so shall you reap.
examples.zh: 种瓜得瓜，种豆得豆。

examples.en: As a man sows, so he shall reap.
examples.zh: 种瓜得瓜，种豆得豆。

soybean.definition: n a source of oil; used for forage and soil improvement and as food\nn erect bushy hairy annual herb having trifoliate leaves and purple to pink flowers; extensively cultivated for food and forage and soil improvement but especially for its nutritious oil-rich seeds; native to Asia\nn the most highly proteinaceous vegetable known; the fruit of the soybean plant is used in a variety of foods and as fodder (especially as a replacement for animal protein)

examples.en: Milking soybeans must be a tiring task, all that squeezing.
examples.zh: 挤大豆肯定是很累人的工作，需要不停地挤压。

examples.en: I could eat some beef noodle soup, or some reheated rice with soybean paste like that, no problem.
examples.zh: 我可以不慌不忙吃牛奶面包鸡蛋，或者泡饭酱菜。

space.definition:
n. the unlimited expanse in which everything is located
n. an empty area (usually bounded in some way between things)
n. an area reserved for some particular purpose
n. a blank character used to separate successive words in writing or printing
space.translation:
n. 位置, 空间, 距离, 太空, 空白, 间隔, (期刊等的)篇幅
vt. 隔开, 分隔
vi. 留间隔
[计] 空白, 空格校验

examples.en: Space travel will be commonplace some time in the future.
examples.zh: 太空旅行终有一天会成为平常事。

examples.en: He was the first man to float in space.
examples.zh: 他是世上第一个在太空中飘浮的人。

examples.en: There's no space in the room for another bed.
examples.zh: 这间房间没有空间再放一张床了。

spacecraft.definition: n. a craft capable of traveling in outer space; technically, a satellite around the sun

examples.en: Viking 1 and 2 became the first spacecraft to successfully land on the surface of Mars.
examples.zh: 维京1号和2号成为了最先在火星表面成功著陆的空间探测器。

examples.en: The Soyuz spacecraft undocked from the International Space Station at 9:53 p.m. EDT, carrying three people back to Earth.
examples.zh: 联盟号宇宙飞船于美国东部时间晚上9点53分脱离国际空间站，携带3人返回地球。

spacious.definition: s very large in expanse or scope\ns (of buildings and rooms) having ample space
spacious.translation: a. 广大的, 宽广的

examples.en: The living room in my new house is very spacious.
examples.zh: 我新家的客厅很宽敞。

span.definition: n. the complete duration of something\nn. the distance or interval between two points\nn. a unit of length based on the width of the expanded human hand (usually taken as 9 inches)
span.translation: n. 指距, 全长, 跨距, 一段时间, 小范围\nvt. 以手指测量, 跨越, 架设, 持续

examples.en: The life span of a butterfly is short.
examples.zh: 蝴蝶的寿命短。

spare.definition:
n. a score in tenpins; knocking down all ten after rolling two balls
v. refrain from harming
v. save or relieve from an experience or action
v. give up what is not strictly needed
spare.translation:
n. 剩余, 备用品, 备件, 备用零件, 备用轮胎
a. 多余的, 备用的, 空闲的, 节约的, 瘦的
vi. 节约, 省掉, 宽恕
vt. 节约, 省用, 剩下, 饶恕, 赦免

examples.en: What do you like to do in your spare time?
examples.zh: 您空闲的时候喜欢干甚么呢？

examples.en: Tom spends most of his spare time practising the guitar.
examples.zh: 汤姆把他大部分的空闲时间花在练习吉他上。

examples.en: Father would often read detective stories in his spare time.
examples.zh: 父亲常常在空闲时间读侦探小说。

spark.definition:
n. a small but noticeable trace of some quality that might become stronger
n. Scottish writer of satirical novels (born in 1918)
n. a small fragment of a burning substance thrown out by burning material or by friction
v. emit or produce sparks
spark.translation: n. 火花, 火星, 闪光, 无线电报务员, 瞬间放电, 活力, 朝气, 花花公子, 情郎\nvi. 闪光, 发火花, 求婚\nvt. 发动, 鼓舞, 使有朝气, 求婚

examples.en: A spark led the gunpowder to explode.
examples.zh: 一点火花让火药爆炸。

examples.en: A spark caused the gunpowder to explode.
examples.zh: 一点火花让火药爆炸。

examples.en: My comment sparked off an argument in the group.
examples.zh: 我的评论引起了小组内的争论。

sparkle.definition: n. merriment expressed by a brightness or gleam or animation of countenance\nv. reflect brightly\nv. be lively or brilliant or exhibit virtuosity
sparkle.translation: n. 闪耀, 火花, 活力, 发泡\nvi. 闪耀, 冒火花\nvt. 使闪耀

examples.en: I count the sparkle of constellations to foretell the future of my love.
examples.zh: 我数著星宿的星光来预测我爱情的未来。

examples.en: The icy road sparkled in the sunlight.
examples.zh: 结冰的道路在阳光下闪闪发亮。

examples.en: Her diamond is sparkling under the light.
examples.zh: 她的钻石在亮光下闪闪发光。

spatial.definition: a. pertaining to or involving or having the nature of space
spatial.translation: a. 空间的, 受空间条件限制的, 占地位的\n[医] 隙的, 间隙的, 腔的; 空间的, 立体的

examples.en: Vertigo is a feeling of spatial disorientation.
Algeria needs better national spatial plans.
He has no spatial awareness.

spawn.definition: n. the mass of eggs deposited by fish or amphibians or molluscs\nv. lay spawn
spawn.translation: n. (鱼)卵, 产物\nvt. 产卵, 酿成, 大量生产\nvi. 产卵, 大量生产

examples.en: These fish swim to the shallows to spawn and feed.
Millions of salmon return to this river to spawn.
She doesn't like me calling her kids her "spawn."

speak.definition: v. use language\nv. make a characteristic or natural sound
speak.translation: vi. 说, 说话, 演说, 发言\nvt. 说, 讲, 说出

examples.en: He was so angry as to be unable to speak.
examples.zh: 他气得说不出话来了。

examples.en: I’ll go ask him if he can speak Japanese.
examples.zh: 我问问他会不会说日语。

examples.en: It's a ghost, and only I can speak to him.
examples.zh: 那是个幽灵，只有我能和它交谈。

specialist.definition: n. an expert who is devoted to one occupation or branch of learning\nn. practices one branch of medicine
specialist.translation: n. 专门医师, 专家\na. 专业的, 专家的

examples.en: Specialists are people who have only one string on their violin.
examples.zh: 专家就好像一台只有一根弦的小提琴一样。

examples.en: He's a specialist in economics.
examples.zh: 他是经济学的专家。

specialize.definition: v. become more focus on an area of activity or field of study\nv. suit to a special purpose\nv. devote oneself to a special area of work
specialize.translation: vt. 使特殊化, 列举, 特别指明, 限定...的范围\nvi. 成为专家, 专攻

examples.en: This publisher specializes in children's literature.
examples.zh: 这家出版社专门出版儿童文学。

specialty.definition: n an asset of special worth or utility\nn a distinguishing trait\nn the special line of work you have adopted as your career
specialty.translation: n. 专业, 专长, 特产, 特制品, 特性, 特点\na. 专门的, 独立的

examples.en: What is the specialty food here?
examples.zh: 这里的特色菜是什么？

examples.en: Let’s order the lobster! I’ve heard that’s the specialty dish here.
examples.zh: 让我们点龙虾！听说是这里的招牌菜。

examples.en: Fashion is not my specialty.
examples.zh: 时装不是我的天分。

species.definition: n. (biology) taxonomic group whose members can interbreed\nn. a specific kind of something
species.translation: n. 种, 类, 外形\n[医] 茶剂; 种

examples.en: The Ordovician-Silurian Extinction Event wiped out nearly 85% of marine species.
examples.zh: 奥陶纪—志留纪灭绝事件消灭了近 85% 的海洋物种。

examples.en: The giant panda is a surviving ancient animal species.
examples.zh: 大熊猫是一种残存的古动物。

examples.en: This species of butterfly has already gone extinct.
examples.zh: 这种种类的蝴蝶已经绝种了。

specific.definition:
n. a medicine that has a mitigating effect on a specific disease
a. (sometimes followed by `to') applying to or characterized by or distinguishing something particular or special or unique
s. stated explicitly or in detail
a. relating to or distinguishing or constituting a taxonomic species
specific.translation: n. 特效药, 特性\na. 特殊的, 明确的, 具有特效的, 特定地, 具体地

examples.en: Could you tell me what your specific requirements are?
examples.zh: 可以说说您的具体要求吗？

examples.en: It’s a communication medium, not a substance or specific activity.
examples.zh: 网络是一个相通的渠道，而不是物质或具体的活动。

examples.en: Can you be more specific?
examples.zh: 可以更具体些吗？

specification.definition: n. a detailed description of design criteria for a piece of work\nn. naming explicitly\nn. (patent law) a document drawn up by the applicant for a patent of invention that provides an explicit and detailed description of the nature and use of an invention
specification.translation: n. 规格, 详述, 详细说明书\n[计] 规范; 形式说明; 说明; 说明书; 规格

examples.en: The maximum response time is listed in the specification.
Within the framework of this project, your specifications are too complex.
Within the framework of this project, your specifications are too complicated.

specify.definition: v. decide upon or fix definitely\nv. determine the essential quality of\nv. be specific about
specify.translation: vt. 详列, 指定, 说明\n[计] 指定

examples.en: Please specify any conditions you have for the use of this information.
examples.zh: 如果您有关于这份问卷信息的使用条件，请在这里指定。

examples.en: Tom didn't specify what he wanted.
examples.zh: 汤姆没说他想要什么。

examples.en: He arrived five minutes after the specified time.
examples.zh: 他在指定时间的五分钟后到了。

specimen.definition: n. an example regarded as typical of its class\nn. a bit of tissue or blood or urine that is taken for diagnostic purposes
specimen.translation: n. 样品, 标本, 试料\n[化] 试样

examples.en: He would pay a million dollars for such a specimen.
The entomologist could not find a specimen of the bug.
A good specimen might weigh up to a kilo.

spectacle.definition: n. something or someone seen (especially a notable or unusual sight)\nn. an elaborate and remarkable display on a lavish scale\nn. a blunder that makes you look ridiculous; used in the phrase `make a spectacle of' yourself
spectacle.translation: n. 引人羡慕的东西, 景象, 眼镜, 场面, 公开展示

examples.en: I need to buy new spectacle frames.
examples.zh: 我需要购买新的镜架。

examples.en: Who is that gentleman in spectacles?
examples.zh: 那位戴眼镜的男士是谁？

spectacular.definition: n. a lavishly produced performance\ns. characteristic of spectacles or drama
spectacular.translation: a. 公开展示的, 惊人的, 壮观的\nn. 奇观, 惊人之举, 展览物

examples.en: These fireworks are spectacular!
examples.zh: 这些焰火真壮观！

spectator.definition: n. a close observer; someone who looks at something (such as an exhibition of some kind)
spectator.translation: n. 观众, 目击者, 旁观者

examples.en: There weren't many spectators at the game because of the rain.
examples.zh: 因为下雨了，球场上没有很多观众。

spectrum.definition: n. an ordered array of the components of an emission or wave\nn. a broad range of related objects or values or qualities or ideas or activities
spectrum.translation: n. 光谱, 范围, 系列\n[化] 光谱

examples.en: The number of legs in humans is on a spectrum.
He leans to the left side of the political spectrum.
The alt-right exists on one end of the political spectrum.

speculate.definition: v. to believe especially on uncertain or tentative grounds\nv. talk over conjecturally, or review in an idle or casual way and with an element of doubt or without sufficient reason to reach a conclusion\nv. invest at a risk
speculate.translation: vi. 深思, 推测, 投机\n[经] 投机

examples.en: I am speculating that he may win the game.
examples.zh: 我在推测他可能赢得比赛。

speculation.definition: n. a hypothesis that has been formed by speculating or conjecturing (usually with little hard evidence)\nn. an investment that is very risky but could yield great profits
speculation.translation: n. 沉思, 推测, 投机\n[经] 投机交易, 买空卖空

examples.en: I won't participate in speculation.
examples.zh: 我不会参与猜忌。

speed.definition:
n. distance travelled per unit time
n. a rate (usually rapid) at which something happens
n. changing location rapidly
v. travel at an excessive or illegal velocity
speed.translation:
n. 速率, 速度, 迅速
vi. 加速, 超速, 快进
vt. 快速传送, 促进, 使加速
[计] 中央处理机速度设置程序

examples.en: How can a router be used to limit network speed?
examples.zh: 怎么用路由器限制网速？

examples.en: Come on, Arianna, speed up or we'll never get there!
examples.zh: 来吧，阿里亚娜号，不快点我们就永远到不了那儿!

examples.en: The train is going at a speed of 50 miles per hour.
examples.zh: 火车以每小时50英里的速度前行。

spell.definition:
n. a verbal formula believed to have magical force
v. orally recite the letters of or give the spelling of
v. indicate or signify
v. write or name the letters that comprise the conventionally accepted form of (a word or part of a word)
spell.translation: n. 符咒, 魅力, 轮值, 轮班, 工作时间, 一次发作\nvt. 拼写, 拼成, 琢磨, 理解, 招致, 轮换, 迷住\nvi. 轮换, 拼字

examples.en: Well, I'll tell you how to spell my name.
examples.zh: 好的，我会告诉你怎么写我的名字。

examples.en: I don't know how to spell the word.
examples.zh: 我不知道这个单词怎么拼写。

examples.en: Layla cast a spell over everybody she met.
examples.zh: Layla使每个遇见她的人着迷。

spend.definition: v. pass time in a specific way\nv. pay out\nv. spend completely
spend.translation: vt. 花费, 浪费, 度过, 消耗, 消磨\nvi. 花费, 用尽

examples.en: That is as much as I dare spend on it.
examples.zh: 我敢花的就只那么多。

examples.en: Do you and Tom spend a lot of time together?
examples.zh: 你和汤姆呆在一起的时间很多吗?

examples.en: He likes to spend some time in solitude every day.
examples.zh: 他喜欢每天都享受一下一个人的时间。

sphere.definition:
n. a particular environment or walk of life
n. any spherically shaped artifact
n. the geographical area in which one nation is very influential
n. a solid figure bounded by a spherical surface (including the space it encloses)
sphere.translation: n. 球, 球面, 球体, 天体, 地球仪, 范围\nvt. 包围, 使成球体, 放入球内

examples.en: Then people knew, that the world is a sphere.
examples.zh: 当时人们就知道，地球是个球体。

examples.en: The earth is just a sphere suspended in space.
examples.zh: 地球只不过是悬浮在太空中的一个球体。

examples.en: He tried to enlarge his sphere of influence.
examples.zh: 他试图扩大自己的势力范围。

spider.definition: n. predatory arachnid with eight legs, two poison fangs, two feelers, and usually two silk-spinning organs at the back end of the body; they spin silk to make cocoons for eggs or traps for prey\nn. a computer program that prowls the internet looking for publicly accessible resources that can be added to a database; the database can then be searched with a search engine\nn. a skillet made of cast iron
spider.translation: n. 蜘蛛, 设圈套者\n[化] 星形轮

examples.en: This is not a spider, it's a monster!
examples.zh: 这不是一只蜘蛛，而是一个怪物。

examples.en: This house is full of spider webs.
examples.zh: 这栋房里布满了蛛网。

examples.en: She shrieked whenever she saw a spider.
examples.zh: 她一看到蜘蛛就尖叫。

spill.definition:
n. liquid that is spilled
n. the act of allowing a fluid to escape
n. a sudden drop from an upright position
v. cause or allow (a liquid substance) to run or flow from a container
spill.translation: n. 溢出, 溅出, 摔下, 溢出量, 木片, 小塞子\nvt. 使溢出, 使散落, 洒, 使流出, 倒出, 使摔下\nvi. 溢出, 涌流, 摔下

examples.en: I spilled my coffee on the carpet.
examples.zh: 我把咖啡倒翻在地毯上了。

examples.en: Tom admitted to spilling the red wine.
examples.zh: Tom承认了他摔了红酒。

examples.en: There's no use crying over spilled milk.
examples.zh: 为打翻的牛奶而哭泣是没用的。

spin.definition:
n. a swift whirling motion (usually of a missile)
n. the act of rotating rapidly
n. a short drive in a car
n. a distinctive interpretation (especially as used by politicians to sway public opinion)
spin.translation: n. 旋转, 自旋, 疾驰, 情绪低落\nvt. 纺织, 纺, 使旋转, 编造\nvi. 纺纱, 吐丝, 作茧, 结网, 旋转, 自旋, 疾驰

examples.en: What do you think would happen if the earth stopped spinning?
examples.zh: 如果地球停止自传，你认为会发生什么？

examples.en: Why does the Earth spin?
examples.zh: 地球为什么会自转呀？

spine.definition: n. a small sharp-pointed tip resembling a spike on a stem or leaf\nn. the part of a book's cover that encloses the inner side of the book's pages and that faces outward when the book is shelved\nn. a sharp rigid animal process or appendage; as a porcupine quill or a ridge on a bone or a ray of a fish fin
spine.translation: n. 背骨, 脊柱, 尖刺\n[医] 脊柱; 棘, 刺; 马蹄嵴

examples.en: A chill ran down his spine as he crossed the park.
examples.zh: 他穿过公园时，一阵寒意顺著脊背蔓延而下。

examples.en: The terrible scene sent shivers down his spine.
examples.zh: 恐怖的场面让了他颤抖。

spiral.definition:
n. a plane curve traced by a point circling about the center but at increasing distances from the center
n. a continuously accelerating change in the economy
n. ornament consisting of a curve on a plane that winds around a center with an increasing distance from the center
n. flying downward in a helical path with a large radius
spiral.translation:
n. 螺旋形之物, 螺线
a. 螺旋形的, 盘旋的
vi. 螺旋形下降, 螺旋形上升, 螺旋形行进
vt. 使螺旋形行进

examples.en: A snail's shell is spiral in form.
examples.zh: 蜗牛壳是螺旋形的.

spirit.definition:
n. the vital principle or animating force within living things
n. the general atmosphere of a place or situation and the effect that it has on people
n. a fundamental emotional and activating principle determining one's character
n. any incorporeal supernatural being that can become visible (or audible) to human beings
spirit.translation: n. 精神, 心灵, 灵魂, 态度, 志气, 人格, 情绪, 心情, 烈酒\nvt. 诱拐, 鼓励, 鼓舞

examples.en: The spirit is willing, but the flesh is weak.
examples.zh: 心有余而力不足。

examples.en: What he did really shows the right spirit!
examples.zh: 他做的这件事真是精神可嘉！

examples.en: There are rumors that some evil spirits linger around here.
examples.zh: 传闻这附近有些脏东西。

spiritual.definition: n. a kind of religious song originated by Blacks in the southern United States\ns. concerned with or affecting the spirit or soul\ns. lacking material body or form or substance
spiritual.translation: a. 精神上的, 神圣的, 崇高的, 高尚的, 鬼的, 招魂术的\nn. 有关教会的事

examples.en: Not material, but spiritual things determine our life.
examples.zh: 我们的生活不是由物质，而是由精神来决定的。

spite.definition: n feeling a need to see others suffer\nn malevolence by virtue of being malicious or spiteful or nasty\nv hurt the feelings of
spite.translation: n. 恶意, 怨恨, 使人烦恼的事物\nvt. 故意刁难, 欺侮

examples.en: In spite of everything, I think it's not bad.
examples.zh: 不论如何，我认为它不错。

examples.en: In spite of the heavy rain, he decided to go out.
examples.zh: 虽然下着大雨，但是他还是决定了要出外。

examples.en: I cannot help loving her in spite of her many faults.
examples.zh: 虽然她有许多缺点，但我却情不自禁地爱著她。

splash.definition:
n. the sound like water splashing
n. a patch of bright color
n. the act of scattering water about haphazardly
v. mark or overlay with patches of contrasting color or texture; cause to appear splashed or spattered
splash.translation: n. 飞溅, 污点, 一点儿, 溅泼声, 色斑\nvi. 溅湿, 溅开, 飞溅\nvt. 溅, 泼, 使溅起水, 洒, 使成斑驳状

examples.en: Angrily, he stomped on the puddle, splashing mud everywhere.
examples.zh: 他愤怒地践踏水坑，弄得泥水四溅。

examples.en: The passing car splashed muddy water on me.
examples.zh: 车子经过的时候把泥水溅到了我的身上。

examples.en: Tom and I splashed each other.
examples.zh: 汤姆和我溅了对方。

splendid.definition: s having great beauty and splendor\ns very good; of the highest quality\ns characterized by grandeur
splendid.translation: a. 光亮的, 了不起的, 灿烂的, 壮丽的, 显著的, 杰出的

examples.en: This soccer match is full of energetic and splendid competition.
examples.zh: 这场足球赛充满着激情和精彩的竞争。

examples.en: Cold and dry, splendid sunshine, what beautiful winter weather!
examples.zh: 寒冷干燥，灿烂的阳光，多么美丽的冬日天气!

examples.en: I never saw such a splendid sunset.
examples.zh: 我从没见过那么壮丽的日落景色。

split.definition:
n. extending the legs at right angles to the trunk (one in front and the other in back)
n. a bottle containing half the usual amount
n. a promised or claimed share of loot or money
n. a lengthwise crack in wood
split.translation:
n. 劈开, 裂片, 裂缝, 分裂, 派系, 派别, 柳条
a. 劈开的
vi. 分离, 分开, 裂开, 被劈开
vt. 劈开, 切开, 使分裂, 使分离
[计] 拆分

examples.en: A sharp crack of thunder split the sky.
examples.zh: 一道闪电划破天空。

examples.en: "Didn't you get married!?" "Oh, we split up. We broke our engagement."
examples.zh: "你没结婚吧!?" "哦，我们分手了。我们解除婚约了。"

examples.en: Let's split the bill today.
examples.zh: 今天我们AA制吧。

spoil.definition:
n. (usually plural) valuables taken by violence (especially in war)
n. the act of spoiling something by causing damage to it
n. the act of stripping and taking by force
v. become unfit for consumption or use
spoil.translation: n. 战利品, 赃物, 奖品, 变质, 次品\nvt. 损坏, 破坏, 溺爱\nvi. 腐坏, 掠夺

examples.en: I don't want to spoil the ending for you.
examples.zh: 我不想把结局提前透露给你。

examples.en: You should not spoil a kid too much.
examples.zh: 孩子不能太惯了。

examples.en: I-chun's mom spoils her. She prepares everything for her.
examples.zh: 怡君她妈超疼她，什么都帮她准备好。

spokesman.translation: n. 发言人, 代言者

examples.en: Do you want to be the spokesman of our group?
He is a paid spokesman for the oil industry.
The police spokesman said no suspects were in custody.

sponge.definition:
n. a porous mass of interlacing fibers that forms the internal skeleton of various marine animals and usable to absorb water or any porous rubber or cellulose product similarly used
n. primitive multicellular marine animal whose porous body is supported by a fibrous skeletal framework; usually occurs in sessile colonies
v. wipe with a sponge, so as to clean or moisten
v. erase with a sponge; as of words on a blackboard
sponge.translation: n. 海绵, 海绵状的东西\nvt. 用海绵擦拭, 吸收掉, 抹掉\nvi. 采集海绵, 海绵般吸收

examples.en: A sponge absorbs water.
examples.zh: 海绵吸水。

sponsor.definition: v. assume sponsorship of\nv. assume responsibility for or leadership of
sponsor.translation: n. 保证人, 赞助者, 发起者, 倡议者, 教父\nvt. 发起, 赞助, 倡议

examples.en: I don't think this sponsor is very suitable.
examples.zh: 我觉得这个赞助不太合适。

examples.en: Prospectuses must be signed by two sponsor representatives.
examples.zh: 招股说明书必须由两名保荐代表人签字。

spontaneous.definition: a. happening or arising without apparent external cause
spontaneous.translation: a. 自然的, 自发的, 未经琢磨的\n[医] 自发的, 特发的, 自生的

examples.en: The most beloved people in the world are the spontaneous.
This tall and thin young man had a spontaneous pneumothorax.
Tom isn't as spontaneous as he used to be.

sport.definition:
n. an active diversion requiring physical exertion and competition
n. the occupation of athletes who compete for pay
n. (Maine colloquial) a temporary summer resident of Maine
n. a person known for the way she (or he) behaves when teased or defeated or subjected to trying circumstances
sport.translation:
n. 运动, 游戏, 娱乐, 消遣, 玩笑
a. 运动的, 户外穿戴的
vi. 游戏, 参加体育运动, 戏弄, 产生变种
vt. 炫耀, 使产生变种

examples.en: A winter sport that many people enjoy is ice skating.
examples.zh: 许多人爱好的一个冬季运动是溜冰。

examples.en: He bought a pair of white sport shoes.
examples.zh: 他买了一双白色的运动鞋。

examples.en: Soccer is the most popular sport in Brazil.
examples.zh: 足球在巴西是最受欢迎的运动。

spotlight.definition: n. a lamp that produces a strong beam of light to illuminate a restricted area; used to focus attention of a stage performer\nv. illuminate with a spotlight, as in the theater
spotlight.translation: n. 照明灯, 反光灯, 聚光灯

examples.en: It's hard for me to always be in the spotlight.
When will I get my chance in the spotlight?
Tom is jealous of Mary for stealing the spotlight.

spouse.definition: n. a person's partner in marriage

examples.en: Tom found a wonderful spouse in Mary.
examples.zh: 汤姆认识了玛莉这么个好老婆。

spray.definition:
n. a pesticide in suspension or solution; intended for spraying
n. a quantity of small objects flying through the air
n. flower arrangement consisting of a single branch or shoot bearing flowers and foliage
n. water in small drops in the atmosphere; blown from waves or thrown up by a waterfall
spray.translation: n. 水沫, 浪花, 水花, 喷雾, 喷雾器, 小树枝\nvt. 喷雾, 扫射, 喷射\nvi. 喷, 溅开

examples.en: Mary carries pepper spray in her purse.
examples.zh: 玛丽的包里有辣椒喷雾。

spread.definition:
n. process or result of distributing or extending over a wide expanse of space
n. a tasty mixture to be spread on bread or crackers or used in preparing other dishes
n. two facing pages of a book or other publication
n. the expansion of a person's girth (especially at middle age)
spread.translation:
n. 传播, 散布, 伸展
a. 双唇展开的, 伸展的
vt. 展开, 铺开, 传播, 推广, 伸出, 涂, 敷, 延伸
vi. 展开, 扩大, 传开, 延伸
[计] 展开

examples.en: We spread out and began to search through the woods.
examples.zh: 我们分散开来并在树林中展开搜索。

examples.en: He spread his arms as though wanting to embrace the world.
examples.zh: 他张开双臂, 似乎要拥抱这个世界。

examples.en: She spread the clean bedsheet on the bed.
examples.zh: 她把干净的床单铺在床上。

spring.definition:
n. the season of growth
n. a metal elastic device that returns to its shape or position when pushed or pulled or pressed
n. a natural flow of ground water
n. a point at which water issues forth
spring.translation:
n. 春天, 弹簧, 跳跃, 弹性, 活力, 泉, 源泉
a. 春天的
vi. 跳, 弹跳, 涌出, 生长, 裂开, 高耸
vt. 使跳起, 使爆炸, 突然提出

examples.en: Out of all four seasons, I like spring the best.
examples.zh: 一年四季中我最喜欢春天了。

examples.en: Spring in the north sends gales to sweep the roads.
examples.zh: 北方的春天送来狂风扫路。

examples.en: Do you know why spring rolls are called spring rolls?
examples.zh: 你知道春卷为什么叫春卷吗？

sprinkle.definition:
n. the act of sprinkling or splashing water
v. cause (a liquid) to spatter about, especially with force
v. rain gently
v. scatter with liquid; wet lightly
sprinkle.translation: vt. 洒, 散置, 撒, 点缀\nvi. 洒, 撒, 下小雨\nn. 洒, 撒, 散置, 小雨, 少量

examples.en: I'll sauté a few sweet potatoes and sprinkle them with sugar.
examples.zh: 我去炸一点红薯，然后在上面撒上糖。

examples.en: There was a sprinkling of foreigners among the visitors in the museum.
examples.zh: 博物馆的参观者中有少数是外国人。

examples.en: The stage was sprinkled with flower petals.
examples.zh: 舞台上撒了花瓣。

sprint.definition: v. run very fast, usually for a short distance
sprint.translation: n. 短距离赛跑\nvi. 全速跑, 冲刺\nvt. 全速跑过

examples.en: I just did a 100-meter sprint and I'm so exhausted.
examples.zh: 我刚百米冲刺，还累得不行呢。

examples.en: Ziri kept us sprinting for fourteen minutes.
examples.zh: 齐里让我们冲刺跑 14 分钟。

spur.definition:
n. any sharply pointed projection
n. tubular extension at the base of the corolla in some flowers
n. a sharp prod fixed to a rider's heel and used to urge a horse onward
v. incite or stimulate
spur.translation: n. 马刺, 刺激物, 鼓舞\nvt. 刺激, 激励, 用马刺策(马)前进\nvi. 用马刺驱马, 疾驰

examples.en: More money for education will spur economic growth.
examples.zh: 更多投资在教育的钱将会刺激经济成长。

spy.definition:
n. (military) a secret agent hired by a state to obtain information about its enemies or by a business to obtain industrial secrets from competitors
n. a secret watcher; someone who secretly watches other people
v. watch, observe, or inquire secretly
v. catch sight of; to perceive with the eyes
spy.translation: n. 间谍, 侦探, 侦察\nvt. 侦察, 找出, 发现\nvi. 做密探, 侦查

examples.en: He believes that there is a spy among us.
examples.zh: 他认为我们当中有一个奸细。

examples.en: It occurred to me that he might be an industrial spy.
examples.zh: 我突然想到他可能是个商业间谍。

examples.en: He believes there is a spy among us.
examples.zh: 他相信我们中间有间谍。

squad.translation: n. 班, 小队, 小集团\nvt. 编成班

examples.en: Tom used to be a member of the bomb squad.
Yanni was placed in the back of the squad car.
Squad Leader Justin, a blip's appeared on the hyperspace radar!

square.definition:
n. (geometry) a plane rectangle with four equal sides and four right angles; a four-sided regular polygon
n. the product of two equal terms
n. something approximating the shape of a square
n. someone who doesn't understand what is going on
square.translation:
n. 正方形, 街区, 广场, 平方, 直角尺
a. 正方形的, 正直的, 公正的, 平方的, 方正的, 结清的
adv. 成直角地, 对准地
vi. 一致, 符合, 结清
vt. 使成方形, 使平方自乘, 调正, 结清, 使一致

examples.en: In front of you, you can see Tiananmen Square.
examples.zh: 前边儿是天安门。

examples.en: The Island of Taiwan's surface area is thirty-six thousand square kilometers.
examples.zh: 台湾岛的面积是三万六千平方公里。

examples.en: The area of the factory is 1,000 square meters.
examples.zh: 工厂的面积是1000平方米。

squash.definition:
n. any of numerous annual trailing plants of the genus Cucurbita grown for their fleshy edible fruits
n. edible fruit of a squash plant; eaten as a vegetable
n. a game played in an enclosed court by two or four players who strike the ball with long-handled rackets
v. to compress with violence, out of natural shape or condition
squash.translation: n. 挤压, 压碎的东西, 南瓜属植物, 拥挤的人群\nvt. 压扁, 镇压, 压制\nvi. 被压扁, 发溅泼声, 挤入

examples.en: By using this banana case, you can transport bananas without squashing them.
examples.zh: 使用这个香蕉盒，可以让您运送香蕉时不会压扁它们。

examples.en: This recipe requires acorn squash.
examples.zh: 这个菜谱需要一些青南瓜。

squat.definition:
n. the act of assuming or maintaining a crouching position with the knees bent and the buttocks near the heels
v. sit on one's heels
v. be close to the earth, or be disproportionately wide
v. occupy (a dwelling) illegally
squat.translation:
n. 蹲, 窝
a. 蹲着的, 矮胖的
vi. 蹲下, 蹲坐, 蹲伏
vt. 使蹲下, 擅自占有

examples.en: Tom started doing squat thrusts in the waiting room.
I heard there's a really good squat over on Park Street.
You need to work on your squat form.

squeeze.definition:
n. the act of gripping and pressing firmly
n. a situation in which increased costs cannot be passed on to the customer
n. (slang) a person's girlfriend or boyfriend
n. a twisting squeeze
squeeze.translation: n. 紧握, 挤, 榨, 榨取, 佣金\nvt. 紧握, 挤, 榨取\nvi. 压榨, 榨

examples.en: Milking soybeans must be a tiring task, all that squeezing.
examples.zh: 挤大豆肯定是很累人的工作，需要不停地挤压。

examples.en: She squeezed the juice from many oranges.
examples.zh: 她用了许多柳橙来榨汁。

examples.en: Tom squeezed Mary's hand.
examples.zh: 汤姆捏了玛丽的手。

stab.definition: n. a strong blow with a knife or other sharp pointed instrument\nv. stab or pierce
stab.translation: n. 刺, 戳, 剧痛, 尝试, 努力\nvt. 刺, 戳, 刺入, 刺痛, 直入, 使伤心\nvi. 刺, 刺伤

examples.en: I'll take a stab at it.
examples.zh: 我试试。

examples.en: Tom tried to stab me.
examples.zh: 汤姆企图刺我。

examples.en: She stabbed him in the back.
examples.zh: 她在他的背上戳了一下。

stability.definition: n. the quality or attribute of being firm and steadfast\nn. a stable order (especially of society)
stability.translation: n. 安定, 稳定性, 坚实, 巩固\n[化] 稳定性

examples.en: Tom gave Mary the stability that she had never had.
The tail at the rear of the plane provides stability.
Layla was looking at Fadil for financial gains and stability.

stabilize.definition: v. make stable and keep from fluctuating or put into an equilibrium\nv. become stable or more stable
stabilize.translation: vt. 使安定, 使稳固\nvi. 稳定, 安定

examples.en: Algeria needs to find a way to stabilize its economy.
Paul has finally figured out how to stabilize the machine.
The authorities are striving in vain to stabilize the currency.

stable.definition:
n. a farm building for housing horses or other livestock
v. shelter in a stable
a. resistant to change of position or condition
s. firm and dependable; subject to little fluctuation
stable.translation:
n. 马房, 牛棚
a. 稳定的, 安定的, 坚固的, 坚定的
vt. 赶入马房
vi. 被关在马厩

examples.en: He is a man of strong, stable and trustworthy character.
examples.zh: 他是个性格强、稳定且可靠的男人。

examples.en: A stable economy is the aim of every government.
examples.zh: 经济繁荣稳定，是每个政府都想达到的目标。

examples.en: It's stable because all the roots of this equation are negative.
examples.zh: 它是可靠的, 因为这个方程式所有的根都是负的。

stack.definition:
n. an orderly pile
v. load or cover with stacks
v. arrange in stacks
v. arrange the order of so as to increase one's winning chances
stack.translation:
n. 堆叠, 堆, 大量, 书库, 枪架, 烟囱, 堆积, 存贮栈
vt. 堆积, 堆满, 暗中对...做手脚
vi. 堆起
[计] 堆积, 堆栈

examples.en: Tom put a stack of letters on Mary's desk.
examples.zh: 汤姆把一叠信放在玛丽桌上。

examples.en: Hey, could you send over a stack of manuscripts straight away?
examples.zh: 喂，请问现在能给我马上送一叠稿子吗？

examples.en: Tom is clambering about on the roof, repairing the chimney stack.
examples.zh: 汤姆在屋顶一边爬一边修理烟囱。

staff.definition:
n. personnel who assist their superior in carrying out an assigned task
n. a strong rod or stick with a specialized utilitarian purpose
n. the body of teachers and administrators at a school
n. building material consisting of plaster and hair; used to cover external surfaces of temporary structure (as at an exposition) or for decoration
staff.translation: n. 全体人员, 工作班子, 棍棒, 杆, 拐杖, 支柱, 权杖\na. 职员的, 雇员的, 参谋的\nvt. 为...配备人员

examples.en: The fire broke out after the staff went home.
examples.zh: 在全体职员回家后，火事爆发了。

examples.en: Our staff will contact you in three working days.
examples.zh: 我们的工作人员会在三个工作日内联系您。

examples.en: The staff in that restaurant gave us a very good impression.
examples.zh: 那家饭馆儿的服务员给我们留下很好的印象。

stage.definition:
n. a large platform on which people can stand and can be seen by an audience
n. the theater as a profession (usually `the stage')
n. a section or portion of a journey or course
n. any scene regarded as a setting for exhibiting or doing something
stage.translation: n. 阶段, 舞台, 场所, 戏剧, 站, 驿站, 级, 层, 脚手架\nvt. 上演, 表演, 筹划\nvi. 适于上演, 乘驿车旅行

examples.en: He died of a heart attack on the stage.
examples.zh: 他是在舞台上心脏病发死的。

examples.en: A stage has been set up in the stadium.
examples.zh: 体育场内已搭建起舞台。

examples.en: Sami reenacted for us what he did on stage.
examples.zh: 萨米为我们重现了他在舞台上的表演。

stagger.definition:
v. walk as if unable to control one's movements
v. walk with great difficulty
v. to arrange in a systematic order
v. astound or overwhelm, as with shock
stagger.translation:
n. 蹒跚, 踌躇
vi. 蹒跚, 犹豫
vt. 使摇摆, 使踌躇, 交错, 错开
a. 交错的, 错开的

examples.en: But somehow he managed to stagger to the doors.
The march toward progress is really more of a haphazard stagger.
The company is attempting to stagger work hours.

stagnant.definition: s. not growing or changing; without force or vitality
stagnant.translation: a. 不流动的, 停滞的, 不景气的, 萧条的, 污浊的, 迟钝的\n[经] 萧条的

examples.en: The giraffes were quenching their thirst in the stagnant pool.
Salaries have remained more or less stagnant in Algeria?
Stagnant water is a breeding ground for mosquitoes.

stain.definition:
n. a soiled or discolored appearance
n. (microscopy) a dye or other coloring material that is used in microscopy to make structures visible
v. color with a liquid dye or tint
v. produce or leave stains
stain.translation: n. 污染, 污点, 着色剂\nvt. 沾染, 染污, 着色\nvi. 变脏

examples.en: My blue dress appeared with a blood stain.
examples.zh: 我的蓝色洋装上出现了血迹。

examples.en: A drop of mustard fell and stained my tie during lunch.
examples.zh: 吃午饭的时候，一坨芥末酱滴下来弄脏了我的领带。

examples.en: How do you clean oil stains off clothes?
examples.zh: 衣服沾上油渍怎么清洗？

staircase.definition: n a way of access (upward and downward) consisting of a set of steps
staircase.translation: n. 楼梯, 梯子, 楼梯部分\n[医] 阶梯现象

examples.en: There are two staircases in my house.
examples.zh: 我的房子有两座楼梯。

stake.definition:
n. instrument of execution consisting of a vertical post that a victim is tied to for burning
n. the money risked on a gamble
n. a strong wooden or metal post with a point at one end so it can be driven into the ground
v. mark with a stake
stake.translation: n. 桩, 炮烙刑, 木柱, 赌注, 奖金\nvt. 打桩, 用桩撑, 下赌注, 资助\nvi. 打赌

examples.en: I felt that my honor was at stake.
examples.zh: 我觉得我的名誉受到了威胁。

examples.en: I'll stake my reputation on it.
examples.zh: 我赌上我的名声。

stale.definition: v. urinate, of cattle and horses\na. lacking freshness, palatability, or showing deterioration from age
stale.translation:
n. 尿
a. 不新鲜的, 陈腐的, 疲惫的, 陈旧的
vt. 使变旧, 走味
vi. 变陈旧, 走味, 失时效, 撒尿

examples.en: The beggar is collecting stale bread.
examples.zh: 这名乞丐在收集干面包。

examples.en: The beer is stale.
examples.zh: 啤酒没气了。

stall.definition:
n. a compartment in a stable where a single animal is confined and fed
n. a booth where articles are displayed for sale
n. a malfunction in the flight of an aircraft in which there is a sudden loss of lift that results in a downward plunge
n. seating in the forward part of the main level of a theater
stall.translation: n. 厩, 停车处, 牧师职位, 货摊, 托辞, 拖延\nvt. 关入厩, 停顿, 推托, 支吾, 使陷于泥中\nvi. 被关在厩内, 陷于泥中, 停止, 支吾

examples.en: For years he has been at the market every Tuesday morning with his fish stall.
examples.zh: 他在街市卖鱼卖了许多年了，这些年来每逢星期二都会在街市见到他。

stamp.definition:
n. a type or class
n. a symbol that is the result of printing or engraving
n. machine consisting of a heavy bar that moves vertically for pounding or crushing ores
n. a block or die used to imprint a mark or design
stamp.translation: n. 印, 邮票, 打印器, 戳子, 图章, 印花税票, 标志, 特征, 类型, 跺脚\nvt. 盖章于, 顿足, 贴上邮票, 铭刻, 捣碎, 扑灭\nvi. 捣碎, 跺脚

examples.en: I forgot to put a stamp on the envelope.
examples.zh: 我忘记在信封上贴邮票了。

examples.en: I forgot to stick a stamp on the envelope.
examples.zh: 我忘记在信封上贴邮票了。

examples.en: I forgot to attach a stamp to the envelope.
examples.zh: 我忘记在信封上贴邮票了。

stance.translation: n. 准备击球姿势, 站立的姿势, 位置, 姿态\n[经] 地位, 形势

examples.en: It's OK to raise your voice and make your stance.
We might not share the same stance on all issues.
