examples.zh: 她嘲笑我的诗。

scorch.definition:
n. a surface burn
n. a plant disease that produces a browning or scorched appearance of plant tissues
n. a discoloration caused by heat
v. become superficially burned
scorch.translation: n. 烧焦, 枯萎\nv. 烧焦, 拷焦, (使)枯萎, 讽刺

examples.en: In the scorching heat, the cat is spread out lethargically on the ground.
examples.zh: 在炎热的天气里，猫咪没精神地摊在地上。

examples.en: The bread is slightly scorched.
examples.zh: 面包有点烤焦了。

scrub.definition:
n. dense vegetation consisting of stunted trees or bushes
n. the act of cleaning a surface by rubbing it with a brush and soap and water
v. clean with hard rubbing
v. wash thoroughly
scrub.translation:
n. 用力擦洗, 矮树, 矮人, 渺小之物
vt. 用力擦洗, 擦掉, 摩擦
vi. 擦洗干净, 进行手臂消毒
a. 次等的, 矮小的, 非正规球队的, 临时凑合的

examples.en: Use a sponge or dishcloth to scrub the dishes thoroughly.
Don't use your bare hands to scrub the floor.
She scrubbed the floor of the kitchen with a brush.

seaman.definition: n. muckraking United States journalist who exposed bad conditions in mental institutions (1867-1922)
seaman.translation: n. 船员, 海员, 水兵\n[法] 海员, 水手, 精通海事者

examples.en: The seaman had to clean the ship down to the copper bolts.
Many moons ago, I was a seaman.
Gabriel was an able seaman.

seaport.definition: n. a sheltered port where ships can take on or discharge cargo
seaport.translation: n. 海港, 港口城市

examples.en: Algeria announced plans for a massive seaport in El Hamdania.
The Port of Gdansk is Poland's biggest seaport.
When will be the El Hamdania seaport operational?

seaside.definition: n. the shore of a sea or ocean regarded as a resort
seaside.translation: a. 海边的, 海滨的\nn. 海滨

examples.en: If the weather's nice, I'll go to the seaside tomorrow.
examples.zh: 如果天气好的话，我明天就去海边。

examples.en: I'm going to the seaside tomorrow if the weather's nice.
examples.zh: 如果明天天气好的话，我就去海边。

examples.en: I'd like to go to the seaside with you.
examples.zh: 我想和你一起去海边。

examples.en: Secondly, is there any project scheduled to be released today?
examples.zh: 其次，按照日程今天有将要发布的项目吗？

sedentary.definition: s. requiring sitting or little activity
sedentary.translation: a. 久坐的, 坐惯的, 定栖的\n[医] 静坐的; 坐式的

examples.en: I need a lot more protein than a sedentary person.
Many people lead a sedentary life, which can lead to weight gain.
Ziri was a sedentary person.

selfish.definition: a. concerned chiefly or only with yourself and your advantage to the exclusion of others
selfish.translation: a. 自私的, 利己主义的, 自我中心的

examples.en: It seems to me that she is a little selfish.
examples.zh: 我觉得她有点自私。

examples.en: It is true that she is pretty, but she is selfish.
examples.zh: 她确实很漂亮，但她很自私。

examples.en: Perhaps you are right, I have been selfish.
examples.zh: 也许你说得对。我一直都很自私。

seller.definition: n. someone who promotes or exchanges goods or services for money
seller.translation: n. 销售者\n[化] 卖方

examples.en: I think this is going to be a good seller.
The Bible is the great best seller of all times.
A fight broke out between the thief and the seller.

senate.definition: n. assembly possessing high legislative powers
senate.translation: n. 参议院, 立法机构, 评议会

examples.en: He was elected to the Senate in the last election.
This bill was sent to the Senate for its approval.
"Advise and Consent" is a book about the US Senate.

senseless.definition:
s not marked by the use of reason
s unresponsive to stimulation
s serving no useful purpose; having no excuse for being
s (of especially persons) lacking sense or understanding or judgment
senseless.translation: a. 无感觉的, 无意识的, 不省人事的

examples.en: Even if your sentences were actually senseless, you at least have the luck to be able to form beautiful sentences.
examples.zh: 即使你的句子实际上是毫无意义的，至少你有幸能造出好句子。

sensitivity.definition: n. (physiology) responsiveness to external stimuli; the faculty of sensation\nn. the ability to respond to physical stimuli or to register small physical amounts or differences\nn. sensitivity to emotional feelings (of self and others)
sensitivity.translation: n. 敏感, 灵敏度\n[计] 灵敏度

examples.en: Writer Luiz Fernando Veríssimo, a columnist capable of uniting generations of readers with irony, precision and sensitivity, died in Porto Alegre, Brazil.
examples.zh: 作家路易斯・费尔南多・沃瑞西莫在巴西阿雷格里港去世，他是位专栏作家，能以讽刺、精确、敏感的文笔团结几代读者。

separately.translation: adv. [表]分开, 不相连, 分隔, 分离, 不同, 单独, 独立, 各自, 各别, 脱离肉体, 灵魂\n[计] 分离地

examples.en: This question must be discussed separately from that one.
examples.zh: 这两个问题必须分开讨论。

examples.en: Could you wrap this separately, please?
examples.zh: 请你分开包装好吗？

examples.en: Please bill us separately.
examples.zh: 请让我们分开付钱。

seriously.translation: adv. 严肃地, 认真地, 严重地

examples.en: Am I seriously the only one who isn't bilingual here?
examples.zh: 严肃的讲在这里只有我一个人不会双语的吗？

examples.en: I'm seriously too busy, so I can't come tonight.
examples.zh: 我实在很忙，所以今晚来不了。

examples.en: Seriously though, episode 21 made me almost cry while laughing.
examples.zh: 但是说真的，第21集让我笑得眼泪都要出来了。

serpent.definition: n. a firework that moves in serpentine manner when ignited\nn. an obsolete bass cornet; resembles a snake
serpent.translation: n. 巨蛇座, 蛇, 蛇形管, 狡猾的人

examples.en: The serpent tempted Eve.
examples.zh: 蛇诱惑了夏娃。

seventeen.definition: n. the cardinal number that is the sum of sixteen and one\ns. being one more than sixteen

examples.en: Tomorrow is my birthday and I will be seventeen.
examples.zh: 明天是我的生日，而我将会17岁。

examples.en: A boy of seventeen is often as tall as his father.
examples.zh: 十七岁的男孩常常长得和他父亲一样高。

examples.en: She got married at the age of seventeen.
examples.zh: 她十七岁结婚。

seventy.definition: n. the cardinal number that is the product of ten and seven\ns. being ten more than sixty

examples.en: Ten, twenty, thirty, forty, fifty, sixty, seventy, eighty, ninety, hundred.
examples.zh: 十、二十、三十、四十、五十、六十、七十、八十、九十、一百。

examples.en: Ten, twenty, thirty, forty, fifty, sixty, seventy, eighty, ninety, one hundred.
examples.zh: 十、二十、三十、四十、五十、六十、七十、八十、九十、一百。

examples.en: He lived to be seventy years old.
examples.zh: 他活到了70岁。

severely.definition: r to a severe or serious degree\nr with sternness; in a severe manner\nr causing great damage or hardship
severely.translation: adv. 严格, 尖锐, 严肃, 严重, 严厉, 朴素

examples.en: I found a bird whose wing was severely damaged.
examples.zh: 我发现了一只翅膀受了重伤的鸟儿。

examples.en: I got scolded severely by that teacher.
examples.zh: 我被那位老师严厉斥责了。

examples.en: The teacher scolded his students severely.
examples.zh: 老师把学生狠狠地骂了一顿。

sex.definition:
n. either of the two categories (male or female) into which most organisms are divided
n. all of the feelings resulting from the urge to gratify sexual impulses
n. the properties that distinguish organisms on the basis of their reproductive roles
v. tell the sex (of young chickens)
sex.translation: n. 性别, 性欲\nvt. 区别...的性别, 引起...的性欲

examples.en: My boyfriend and I had sex on the first date.
examples.zh: 我和男友第一次约会就发生了性关系。

examples.en: Desire for food and sex is part of human nature.
examples.zh: 食色性也（孔子）。

examples.en: Mary and Alice are a legally married same sex couple.
examples.zh: Mary和Alice是一对合法结婚的同性伴侣。

sexual.definition: a. of or relating to or characterized by sexuality\na. having or involving sex
sexual.translation: a. 性的, 性别的\n[医] 性的; 性欲的

examples.en: Have you and her had a sexual relationship?
examples.zh: 你和她有过性关系吗？

examples.en: Do transgender people need to continuously use hormones to maintain their sexual characteristics?
examples.zh: 变性者需要不断服用激素来维持性别特征吗？

shadowy.translation: a. 有影的, 暗黑的, 朦胧的, 虚幻的

examples.en: The shadowy figure started to come closer to Leonid's bed.
Kalman saw a shadowy figure lurking in the dark.
Ziri saw a shadowy creature in the corner of the room.

sham.definition:
n something that is a counterfeit; not what it seems to be
n a person who makes deceitful pretenses
v make a pretence of
v make believe with the intent to deceive
s adopted in order to deceive
sham.translation:
n. 假, 赝品, 骗子, 哄骗
a. 假的, 伪造的
vt. 假装, 冒充
vi. 装假

examples.en: With all its sham, drudgery and broken dreams; it is still a beautiful world.
examples.zh: 虽然虚伪、苦痛还有破碎的梦伴随着我，但这仍然是一个美丽的世界。

shameful.definition: s (used of conduct or character) deserving or bringing disgrace or shame\ns giving offense to moral sensibilities and injurious to reputation
shameful.translation: a. 可耻的, 丢脸的, 不道德的, 淫猥的, 猥亵的, 不体面的

examples.en: Your conduct is absolutely shameful.
examples.zh: 你的行为是绝对可耻的。

shampoo.definition: n. cleansing agent consisting of soaps or detergents used for washing the hair\nn. the act of washing your hair with shampoo\nv. use shampoo on (hair)
shampoo.translation: n. 洗头, 洗发剂\nvt. 洗头, 洗发

examples.en: What kind of shampoo do you use?
examples.zh: 你用哪种洗发水？

examples.en: He got shampoo in his eyes.
examples.zh: 他眼里进肥皂了。

examples.en: Have you got shampoo?
examples.zh: 你有洗发水吗？

sharpen.definition:
v. make sharp or sharper
v. make crisp or more crisp and precise
v. become sharp or sharper
v. make (images or sounds) sharp or sharper
sharpen.translation: vt. 使尖锐, 使敏捷, 加重, 削尖\nvi. 尖锐化, 变锋利

examples.en: Tom is sharpening a knife.
examples.zh: 汤姆在磨刀。

examples.en: She has sharpened the knives.
examples.zh: 她磨了这些刀。

sharply.definition: r. in a well delineated manner\nr. changing suddenly in direction and degree
sharply.translation: adv. 锐利地, 严厉地, 厉害地\n[经] 剧烈地

examples.en: Corporate earnings in the first quarter improved sharply.
examples.zh: 企业第一季度收益大幅增长。

examples.en: Industrial production rose sharply in July.
examples.zh: 7月份工业生产大幅增长。

examples.en: Housing prices in Hsinchu City have risen sharply due to the concentration of the tech industry.
examples.zh: 新竹市区的房价因为科技产业聚集而水涨船高。

sheet.definition:
n. any broad thin expanse or surface
n. paper used for writing or printing
n. bed linen consisting of a large rectangular piece of cotton or linen cloth; used in pairs
n. a flat artifact that is thin relative to its length and width
sheet.translation:
n. 床单, 张, 纸张, 印刷品, 裹尸布, 薄片
vt. 盖上被单, 遍布
vi. 大片落下
a. 片状的, 成薄片的
[计] 工作表

examples.en: She pressed her nose against the sheet of glass.
examples.zh: 她把鼻子贴在玻璃上。

examples.en: Sami was writing on that sheet of paper.
examples.zh: 莎米在那张纸上写字。

examples.en: You put away the sheets, and I'll make the bed.
examples.zh: 你把床单收起来，我整理一下床。

shelf.definition: n. a support that consists of a horizontal surface for holding objects
shelf.translation: n. 架子, 搁板\n[化] 架子

examples.en: She put her CDs in a row on the shelf.
examples.zh: 她把她的CD在书架上排成一排。

examples.en: He put the books on the shelf out of order.
examples.zh: 他胡乱把书本放在架上。

examples.en: Are you sure the book is on this shelf?
examples.zh: 您确定那本书在这个书架上？

shilling.definition: n. an English coin worth one twentieth of a pound

examples.en: He headed to Miami and started shilling for crypto.
Last May we bought twenty-five bulbs of Lilium auratum for a shilling.
I gave a shilling to the boy.
In 2013, Tom Jackson published a book about the history of shipbuilding.
Iron is used in shipbuilding.

shipwreck.definition: n. a wrecked ship (or a part of one)\nn. an irretrievable loss\nn. an accident that destroys a ship at sea
shipwreck.translation: n. 遇难船, 海难\nvt. 遇海难, 毁灭, 使失事

examples.en: The remains of the shipwreck still lie on the sand.
A Bronze Age shipwreck was found in the Mediterranean Sea.
This world is a vast shipwreck: save yourselves whoever can!

shoot.definition:
n. a new branch
n. the act of shooting at targets
v. hit with a missile from a weapon
v. kill by firing a missile
shoot.translation: n. 射击, 狩猎, 芽, 射伤, 发射, 发芽, 急流, 推力, 摄影, 急送, 滑运道, 浪费\nvt. 射击, 射中, 损毁, 拍摄, 喷出, 投射, 挥出, 飞速行进, 挥霍, 给...注射\nvi. 射出, 射击, 发出, 拍电影, 射门, 发芽

examples.en: Don't shoot the devil in the back. You might miss.
examples.zh: 别射撒旦的背部。你可能会射不中。

examples.en: The players made a wall as Lionel Messi went to shoot.
examples.zh: 当里奥梅西射门时，球员们筑起一道人墙。

examples.en: He was scared you would shoot him.
examples.zh: 他害怕你会开枪打他。

shopkeeper.definition: n. a merchant who owns or manages a shop
shopkeeper.translation: n. 零售商, 店主, 老板

examples.en: He couldn't find the restroom, so he had to ask the shopkeeper for directions.
examples.zh: 他找不到洗手间，只好向店员询问方向。

examples.en: Worried, the shopkeeper ran over and kneeled beside Dima, who was breathing heavily - his forehead covered in sweat.
examples.zh: 店主担心地跑过去跪在迪马身旁, 迪马沉重地喘著气, 他的额头覆著一层汗。

examples.en: "You have expensive taste!" the shopkeeper exclaimed. "Are you sure you don't want to look through our cheaper variants first?"
examples.zh: 「您的品味真高！」店员叹道。「不过我们还有一些价钱比较相宜的款式，您真的不要先看一下吗？」

shopping.definition: n. searching for or buying goods or services\nn. the commodities purchased from stores
shopping.translation: n. 买东西, 购物\n[经] 购物, 买东西

examples.en: Did you check all the items on the shopping list?
examples.zh: 你把购物单上的全都检查过了吗？

examples.en: Tom is going to go shopping with Mary tomorrow afternoon.
examples.zh: 汤姆明天下午要和玛莉一起去购物。

examples.en: Then, we will go clothes shopping after five o'clock, alright?
examples.zh: 那，我们五点后去买衣服，好吗？

shortcut.definition: n. a route shorter than the usual one
shortcut.translation: n. 捷径, 最短路线\n[计] 快捷方式

examples.en: This is the shortcut that I usually take to school.
examples.zh: 这通常是我去学校的捷径。

examples.en: I created a shortcut on the desktop.
examples.zh: 我在桌面上建了一个快捷方式。

examples.en: There is no shortcut to success.
examples.zh: 成功是没有捷径的。

shorten.definition: v. make shorter than originally intended; reduce or retrench in length or duration\nv. make short or shorter\nv. become short or shorter
shorten.translation: vt. 弄短, 缩短, 减少\nvi. 缩小, 变短

examples.en: Don't smoke. Smoking can shorten your penis.
examples.zh: 别吸烟。吸烟可能缩短你的阴茎。

examples.en: I daub the venison with shortening.
examples.zh: 我把起酥油涂抹在鹿肉上。

examples.en: I shortened my speeches.
examples.zh: 我精简语言。

shortfall.definition: n the property of being an amount by which something is less than expected or required
shortfall.translation: n. 不足, 不足量\n[经] 缺少, 不足, 亏舱运费

examples.en: A budget deficit will occur because of a revenue shortfall.
What are some of Algeria's technological shortfalls?
The government's elevated debt levels have limited its capacity to finance any shortfalls.

shot.definition:
n. a solid missile discharged from a firearm
n. a chance to do something
n. a person who shoots (usually with respect to their ability to shoot)
n. an aggressive remark directed at a person like a missile and intended to have a telling effect
shot.translation:
n. 发射, 炮弹, 射击, 射手, 投篮, 射门, 子弹, 射程, 拍摄, 注射
vt. 装弹, 使成颗粒状
a. 杂色的, 交织着的, 渗透的, 点焊的, 破旧的
shoot的过去式和过去分词

examples.en: I aimed at a sparrow, but shot down a goose.
examples.zh: 瞄准麻雀, 击中鹅。

examples.en: Tom shot his own dog, thinking it was a wolf.
examples.zh: 汤姆把他的狗认成狼了，所以把它毙了。

examples.en: One morning I shot an elephant in my pyjamas.
examples.zh: 一天早晨我穿着睡衣射了一头大象

shovel.definition:
n. a hand tool for lifting loose material; consists of a curved container or scoop and a handle
n. the quantity a shovel can hold
n. a fire iron consisting of a small shovel used to scoop coals or ashes in a fireplace
v. dig with or as if with a shovel
shovel.translation: n. 铲, 铁铲\nv. 铲

examples.en: I dug a huge pit with my shovel in just one day.
examples.zh: 我只用一天就用铲子挖了一个大坑。

examples.en: Tom is going to shovel the snow off the roof for us.
examples.zh: 汤姆正要为我们铲掉屋顶上的雪。

examples.en: Tom clenched the shovel.
examples.zh: 汤姆握紧了铲子。

shriek.translation: n. 尖锐的响声\nvi. 尖叫, 发尖声\nvt. 尖声发出

examples.en: She shrieked whenever she saw a spider.
examples.zh: 她一看到蜘蛛就尖叫。

shrill.definition: s. having or emitting a high-pitched and sharp tone or tones\ns. of colors that are bright and gaudy
shrill.translation:
n. 尖声
a. 尖锐的, 刺耳的
vt. 尖声说出
vi. 发出刺耳声

examples.en: All at once she began to shout in a shrill voice.
examples.zh: 突然间她开始用尖锐的声音大喊。

examples.en: I was walking along the crowded street when all at once I heard a shrill cry.
examples.zh: 我在人来人往的街道上走著，突然听见一下尖锐的叫声。

shrimp.definition: n. small slender-bodied chiefly marine decapod crustaceans with a long tail and single pair of pincers; many species are edible\nv. fish for shrimp
shrimp.translation: n. 虾, 小虾, 矮子\nvi. 捕小虾

examples.en: Acaraje, a Brazilian food from Africa, is a ball of caupi bean dough, onions, and salt, fried in palm oil and served with shrimp and a spicy sauce.
examples.zh: 阿嗄拉咭是源自非洲的巴西食品，是豇豆面团、洋葱和盐，经棕榈油炸，与虾和辣酱一起食用的食品。

shrine.definition: n. a place of worship hallowed by association with some sacred thing or person
shrine.translation: n. 圣地, 神龛, 庙\nvt. 将...置于神龛内

examples.en: The decay of the shrine is due, in part, to acid rain.
examples.zh: 庙宇的毁坏有一部分要归因于酸雨。

examples.en: On New Year's Day many Japanese go to the shrine to worship.
examples.zh: 很多日本人都会在元旦到神社参拜。

examples.en: Kyoto is famous for its shrines and temples.
examples.zh: 京都以它的祭坛和寺院而闻名。

sickness.translation: n. 疾病, 不健康, 呕吐\n[医] 病

examples.en: She is absent because of sickness.
examples.zh: 她不在是因为病了。

sideways.definition: r. with one side forward or to the front\nr. toward one side
sideways.translation: adv. 向旁边, 向侧面地\na. 旁边的, 向侧面的

examples.en: He looked at me sideways as if I were guilty.
Inmates were forced to sleep in one cell, often sideways.
She gave a titter when his toupee fell sideways.

sift.definition: v. move as if through a sieve\nv. separate by passing through a sieve or other straining device to separate out coarser elements
sift.translation: vt. 筛, 过滤, 撒, 详查\nvi. 筛, 被筛下, 精选

examples.en: Algorithms sift through large data sets to detect unexpected patterns.
Did you sift the flour before you made the cookie batter?
Sift the flour to remove the lumps.

silent.definition:
s. marked by absence of sound
s. implied by or inferred from actions or statements
s. not made to sound
s. having a frequency below or above the range of human audibility
silent.translation: a. 沉默的, 安静的, 无声的, 静止的\n[医] 静止的, 无症状的

examples.en: Since I didn't know what to say, I remained silent.
examples.zh: 因为不知道该说什么，我保持了沉默。

examples.en: Since he didn't know what to say, he remained silent.
examples.zh: 自从他不知道该说什么的时候，便一直沉默着。

examples.en: First of all, power off your cellphones and remain silent.
examples.zh: 首先，关闭手机，保持安静。

similarly.definition: r. in like or similar manner
similarly.translation: adv. 相像地, 类似于

examples.en: All of the men were dressed similarly to Tom.
They think similarly but come to different conclusions.
All of you behave similarly.

simultaneously.translation: adv. 同时发生, 一齐, 同时, 同时存在

examples.en: Ziri got sick with a number of things simultaneously.
The city is simultaneously killing me and reviving me.
The summit talks are to be broadcast simultaneously throughout the world.

sincerity.definition: n. the quality of being open and truthful; not deceitful or hypocritical\nn. a quality of naturalness and simplicity
sincerity.translation: n. 诚实, 真实, 诚心诚意

examples.en: I think we're slowly becoming more comfortable with sincerity again.
He demonstrated to me his sincerity as a friend.
Sami was able to convince people of his sincerity.

singer.definition: n. a person who sings\nn. United States inventor of an improved chain-stitch sewing machine (1811-1875)\nn. United States writer (born in Poland) of Yiddish stories and novels (1904-1991)

examples.en: She's famous as a singer but not as a poet.
examples.zh: 她是一个有名的歌手，但却没有多少人知道她也有写诗。

examples.en: She was by far the best singer in the class.
examples.zh: 她曾是班上唱歌绝对的第一名。

examples.en: Tom isn't the only one here who's a good singer.
examples.zh: 汤姆不是这里唯一的好歌手。

siren.definition:
n. a sea nymph (part woman and part bird) supposed to lure sailors to destruction on the rocks where the nymphs lived
n. a warning signal that is a loud wailing sound
n. an acoustic device producing a loud often wailing sound as a signal or warning
n. eellike aquatic North American salamander with small forelimbs and no hind limbs; have permanent external gills
siren.translation: n. 女海妖, 妖女, 警报器, 汽笛, 迷人的美女\na. 诱惑的\nvi. 响着警报器前进

examples.en: I could hear sirens in the distance.
examples.zh: 我听到远处传来警笛声。

examples.en: She is waiting now in the sitting-room.

situated.definition: v determine or indicate the place, site, or limits of, as if by an instrument or by a survey\nv put (something somewhere) firmly\ns situated in a particular spot or position
situated.translation: a. 位于...的, 坐落在...的, 处于某种境地的\n[法] 坐落...的, 位于...的, 处于某种境地的

examples.en: Switzerland is situated between France, Italy, Austria and Germany.
examples.zh: 瑞士位于法国、意大利、奥地利和德国之间。

examples.en: The town is situated 1,500 meters above sea level.
examples.zh: 这个镇海拔1500米。

examples.en: Japan is situated in Asia.
examples.zh: 日本在亚洲。

sixty.definition: n. the cardinal number that is the product of ten and six\ns. being ten more than fifty

examples.en: Ten, twenty, thirty, forty, fifty, sixty, seventy, eighty, ninety, hundred.
examples.zh: 十、二十、三十、四十、五十、六十、七十、八十、九十、一百。

examples.en: My father will retire at the age of sixty.
examples.zh: 我父亲六十岁就要退休了。

examples.en: An hour has sixty minutes, and a minute has sixty seconds.
examples.zh: 一个小时有六十分钟，一分钟有六十秒。

skate.definition: n. sports equipment that is worn on the feet to enable the wearer to glide along and to be propelled by the alternate actions of the legs\nn. large edible rays having a long snout and thick tail with pectoral fins continuous with the head; swim by undulating the edges of the pectoral fins\nv. move along on skates
skate.translation: n. 溜冰, 冰鞋\nvi. 滑冰, 滑过

examples.en: Is it safe to skate on this lake?
examples.zh: 在这个湖上滑冰安全吗？

examples.en: A winter sport that many people enjoy is ice skating.
examples.zh: 许多人爱好的一个冬季运动是溜冰。

examples.en: Which do you enjoy more, ice skating or roller skating?
examples.zh: 你更喜欢滑冰还是轮滑？

ski.definition: n. narrow wood or metal or plastic runners used in pairs for gliding over snow\nv. move along on skis

examples.en: I want to buy a pair of ski boots.
examples.zh: 我想买一双滑雪靴。

examples.en: It is said that she is an expert in skiing.
examples.zh: 据说她是个滑雪专家 。

examples.en: We went skiing in Shiga Kogen for our school trip.
examples.zh: 修学旅行，我们去了志贺高原滑雪。

skillful.definition: s having or showing knowledge and skill and aptitude\ns done with delicacy and skill
skillful.translation: a. 熟练的, 巧妙的\n[机] 熟练的

examples.en: Bill is skillful in arguing and debating.
examples.zh: 比尔擅长辩论。

skyscraper.definition: n. a very tall building with many stories
skyscraper.translation: n. 摩天楼, 三角形天帆

examples.en: Burj Khalifa is currently the tallest skyscraper in the world.
examples.zh: 哈里发塔是现时世界上最高的摩天大楼。

examples.en: Currently Burj Khalifa is the tallest skyscraper in the world.
examples.zh: 目前哈里发塔是世界上最高的摩天大楼。

examples.en: The elevators in a skyscraper are vital systems.
examples.zh: 摩天大厦里的电梯是至关重要的。

slander.definition: n. words falsely spoken that damage the reputation of another
slander.translation: n. 中伤, 诽谤\nvt. 中伤, 诽谤

examples.en: Don't be quick to slander if you don't know the reason.
Hatred, infamy and slander have not conquered my spirit.
The defenseless lady was exposed to the world's mockery and slander.

slang.definition:
n. informal language consisting of words and expressions that are not considered appropriate for formal occasions; often vituperative or vulgar
n. a characteristic language of a particular group (as among thieves)
v. use slang or vulgar language
v. abuse with coarse language
slang.translation: n. 俚语\nv. 辱骂, 用俚语说

examples.en: It's fun to learn slang words in foreign languages.
examples.zh: 学习外语里的俚语很有趣。

examples.en: I can understand most of what they say, but I don't understand the slang they use (in their speech).
examples.zh: 我大部分能听懂他们说的话，但是听不懂他们说的俗语。

sleepy.translation: a. 困乏的, 欲睡的

examples.en: I was tired and, what is worse, I was sleepy.
examples.zh: 我当时很累，更糟的是我还想睡觉。

examples.en: For some reason, I feel sleepy when I start studying.
examples.zh: 不知道为什么我一开始学习就会犯困。

examples.en: Tom is very sleepy, because he didn't sleep well last night.
examples.zh: Tom很困因为昨天晚上没睡好。

slightly.definition: r. to a small degree or extent
slightly.translation: adv. 些微地, 苗条地

examples.en: Generally speaking, nobles were only very slightly affected by taxes.
examples.zh: 总体来说，贵族受到税收的影响微乎其微。

examples.en: How about we go to a slightly fancier restaurant?
examples.zh: 我们去一家档次再高点儿的餐厅怎么样？

examples.en: The schedule is only slightly affected by this delay.
examples.zh: 日程表只受到了这次延误的轻微影响。

slipper.definition: n. low footwear that can be slipped on and off easily; usually worn indoors
slipper.translation: n. 拖鞋, 制轮器\nvt. 用拖鞋打

examples.en: Your pair of slippers are very cute.
examples.zh: 你的这双拖鞋很萌。

examples.en: Please put on these slippers.
examples.zh: 请穿这双拖鞋。

slit.definition:
n. a long narrow opening
n. a narrow fissure
v. make a clean cut through
v. cut a slit into
slit.translation: n. 裂缝, 投币口, 狭长裂口\nvt. 切开, 扯裂, 使有狭缝\nvi. 纵切, 纵裂

examples.en: Tom slit his own throat.
examples.zh: 汤姆自刎了。

slowly.definition: r. without speed (`slow' is sometimes used informally for `slowly')
slowly.translation: adv. 慢慢地, 迟缓地

examples.en: Time ticks by more slowly around a black hole.
examples.zh: 黑洞周围的时间要流逝得慢得多。

examples.en: Could you please speak a little bit more slowly?
examples.zh: 能否请你说慢一点?

examples.en: Speak more slowly so that we can understand you.
examples.zh: 请讲慢一点，让我们能听懂。

slumber.definition: n. a dormant or quiescent state
slumber.translation: n. 睡眠, 麻木状态\nvi. 微睡, 静止, 麻木\nvt. 睡着度过(时间)

examples.en: Parvati's mother never allowed her to have slumber parties.
Can you still throw a slumber party when you're 25 years old?
He plucked the dreams, tasted them, and then harvested the slumber.

sly.definition: s marked by skill in deception
sly.translation: a. 狡猾的, 诡密的, 俏皮的, 偷偷摸摸的

examples.en: He did it on the sly.
examples.zh: 他偷偷做的。

smog.definition: n. air pollution by a mixture of smoke and fog

examples.en: Smog was very heavy today.
examples.zh: 今门天怎么能么朦。

smoothly.definition: r. with no problems or difficulties\nr. in a smooth and diplomatic manner
smoothly.translation: adv. 平滑地, 流畅地, 流利地

examples.en: This car is running less smoothly than it used to.
examples.zh: 这辆车没有以前跑得那么顺畅了。

examples.en: Our journey went smoothly until we ran into a blizzard.
examples.zh: 我们路上一帆风顺，直到遇上暴风雪。

examples.en: I do hope everything will go smoothly.
examples.zh: 我希望一切都顺利。

snack.definition: n a light informal meal\nv eat a snack; eat lightly
snack.translation: n. 小吃, 点心, 快餐\nvi. 吃零食, 吃快餐

examples.en: Do we have anything I can snack on?
examples.zh: 我们有任何我可以当零食吃的东西吗？

examples.en: The mooncake is a kind of Chinese snack.
examples.zh: 月饼是中国点心的一种。

examples.en: I had instant noodles as a midnight snack.
examples.zh: 我消夜吃了速食面。

sneer.definition:
n. a facial expression of contempt or scorn; the upper lip curls
n. a contemptuous or scornful remark
v. express through a scornful smile
v. smile contemptuously
sneer.translation: n. 冷笑, 嘲笑\nvi. 嘲笑, 冷笑\nvt. 嘲笑着说, 嘲笑得使

examples.en: He turned to his orange juice sullenly, sneering that every little additive would sign him up for experiments he wanted no part in.
examples.zh: 他闷闷不乐地转向了他的橙汁，埋怨著自己不情愿地成了里头每一点添加剂的实验品。

sneeze.definition: n. a symptom consisting of the involuntary expulsion of air from the nose\nv. exhale spasmodically, as when an irritant entered one's nose

examples.en: I've seen our dog sneeze, but not our cat.
examples.zh: 我见过我家的狗打喷嚏，但是从来没见过我家的猫打喷嚏。

examples.en: I think I'm gonna sneeze. Give me a tissue.
examples.zh: 我想我要打喷嚏了。。。给我张纸巾。

examples.en: Cover your mouth when you cough, sneeze, or yawn.
examples.zh: 你咳嗽、打喷嚏或打哈欠的时候要捂住你的嘴。

sniff.definition: n. sensing an odor by inhaling through the nose\nv. perceive by inhaling through the nose\nv. inhale audibly through the nose
sniff.translation: n. 以鼻吸气, 嗅, 气息\nvi. 嗅, 蔑视, 嗤之以鼻\nvt. 闻, 用力吸, 发觉

examples.en: In me the tiger sniffs the rose.
examples.zh: 心有猛虎，细嗅蔷薇。

examples.en: She sniffed out his true intentions, huh.
examples.zh: 她发现了他的真实面目，嗯？

snore.definition: n. the rattling noise produced when snoring\nn. the act of snoring or producing a snoring sound\nv. breathe noisily during one's sleep
snore.translation: n. 鼾声, 打鼾\nvi. 打鼾\nvt. 打鼾度过

examples.en: I must admit that I snore.
examples.zh: 我必须承认我打呼。

examples.en: What should I do if my wife snores?
examples.zh: 老婆打呼噜，我该怎么办？

examples.en: He was snoring loudly while he slept.
examples.zh: 他睡着的时候，打呼声很响。

snowstorm.definition: n a storm with widespread snowfall accompanied by strong winds
snowstorm.translation: n. 暴风雪\n[化] 雪暴

examples.en: Tom shovelled the snow off the roof after the snowstorm.
It seems there is going to be a snowstorm.
I lost my sense of direction in the snowstorm.

snowy.definition: s marked by the presence of snow\ns covered with snow\ns of the white color of snow
snowy.translation: a. 多雪的, 雪的, 被雪所覆盖着的, 下雪的

examples.en: According to the weather forecast, tomorrow will be snowy.
examples.zh: 天气预报说明天会下雪。

soak.definition:
n. the process of becoming softened and saturated as a consequence of being immersed in water (or other liquid)
n. washing something by allowing it to soak
v. submerge in a liquid
v. beat severely
soak.translation: n. 浸, 湿透, 大雨\nvt. 使上下湿透, 浸, 吸入, 吸收, 浸洗掉\nvi. 浸泡, 渗透

examples.en: I got soaked by the rain on the way home.
examples.zh: 我回家路上被雨淋得湿透了。

examples.en: I got soaked with rain on the way home.
examples.zh: 我回家路上被雨淋得湿透了。

examples.en: The rain soaked me on my way home.
examples.zh: 我回家路上被雨淋得湿透了。

sob.definition: n. convulsive gasp made while weeping\nv. weep convulsively
sob.translation: vi. 啜泣, 呜咽\nvt. 哭诉, 哭得使\nn. 啜泣, 呜咽

examples.en: The girl was sobbing in the corner of the schoolroom.
examples.zh: 女孩在教室的角落啜泣。

examples.en: I could hear her sobbing in her bedroom.
examples.zh: 我能听到她在卧室里抽泣。

examples.en: I heard Tom sobbing.
examples.zh: 我听到汤姆在低声啜泣。

socialist.definition: n. a political advocate of socialism
socialist.translation: n. 社会主义者, 社会党党员\n[法] 社会主义的

examples.en: We need to keep Algeria within the socialist framework.
examples.zh: 我们需要让阿尔及利亚保持在社会主义框架内。

examples.en: The Socialist Party only got 18% of the votes.
examples.zh: 社会主义党仅仅获得了百分之18的选票。

examples.en: This politician is a typical champagne socialist.
examples.zh: 这个政客是典型的香槟社会主义者。

sock.definition: n. hosiery consisting of a cloth covering for the foot; worn inside the shoe; reaches to between the ankle and the knee\nv. hit hard
sock.translation:
n. 短袜, 鞋垫, 一击
vt. 重击, 猛投, 给...穿袜
vi. 打击
adv. 正着地, 不偏不倚地
a. 非常成功的

examples.en: Only a shoe knows about a hole in a sock.
examples.zh: 只有鞋子知道袜子的洞。

examples.en: You have your right sock on wrong side out.
examples.zh: 你右边袜子倒转穿了。

examples.en: You've got a big hole in your sock.
examples.zh: 你的袜子上有个大洞。

soda.definition: n a sodium salt of carbonic acid; used in making soap powders and glass and paper\nn a sweet drink containing carbonated water and flavoring
soda.translation: n. 苏打, 碳酸水\n[化] 纯碱; 苏打; 碳酸钠

examples.en: Sami's soda has a lot of sugar in it.
examples.zh: 萨米的苏打水中含有大量糖。

examples.en: Ziri needs baking soda to clean his kitchen sink.
examples.zh: 齐里需要小苏打，用来清洁他的厨房水槽。

examples.en: I want you to get me a soda.
examples.zh: 我想让你帮我买瓶汽水。

sofa.definition: n. an upholstered seat for more than one person

examples.en: I don't want to buy this kind of sofa.
examples.zh: 我不想买这样的沙发。

examples.en: Mary moved closer to Tom on the sofa.
examples.zh: 玛丽在沙发上凑近了汤姆。

examples.en: We would like to buy a sofa.
examples.zh: 我们想买张沙发。

soften.definition: v. make (images or sounds) soft or softer\nv. make soft or softer\nv. become soft or softer

examples.en: You can soften dialysis tubing by soaking it in water.
Knead the clay like bread to soften it before sculpting.
What can cheer up, soften, color everything - a big love.

softly.definition: r. with low volume\nr. in a manner that is pleasing to the senses
softly.translation: adv. 柔和地, 静静地, 温柔地

examples.en: In the distance I hear the sound of softly murmuring roads.
examples.zh: 我听到轻柔的沙沙声从远方的路上传来。

examples.en: You speak so softly that I cannot quite hear what you say.
examples.zh: 你说得太轻了，以至于我没办法听清楚你在说什么。

examples.en: The dog barked softly.
examples.zh: 狗轻轻地叫了。

softness.definition: n. the property of giving little resistance to pressure and being easily cut or molded\nn. a state of declining economic condition\nn. a sound property that is free from loudness or stridency

examples.en: She rested her hand on the bed, feeling its softness.
They enjoyed the softness and sweetness of the buns.
I enjoyed the softness of the steamed bun.

solvable.translation: a. 可以解的, 可以解决的\n[医] 溶解的, 可溶的

examples.en: Food insecurity is a solvable problem.
These problems are all solvable.

sometime.definition: r. at some indefinite or unstated time
sometime.translation: a. 以前的, 某一时间的\nadv. 改天, 来日

examples.en: I hope we'll see each other again sometime.
examples.zh: 我希望我们有时间还可以见面。

examples.en: Perhaps we could get a drink sometime.
examples.zh: 要不我们找时间喝一顿。

examples.en: Write me sometime, OK?
examples.zh: 有时间给我写信，好吗？

soup.definition:
n. liquid food especially of meat or fish or vegetable stock often containing pieces of solid food
n. any composition having a consistency suggestive of soup
n. an unfortunate situation
v. dope (a racehorse)
soup.translation: n. 汤, 马力\nvt. 加速, 增加马力

examples.en: There is a saying: cabbage soup and porridge are our food.
examples.zh: 俗话说：高丽菜汤和粥是我们的食物。

examples.en: In this soup there are carrots, onions, parsley, celery and potatoes.
examples.zh: 这个汤里有胡萝卜、洋葱、欧芹、芹菜和土豆。

examples.en: My grandma just drank a bit of soup.
examples.zh: 我姥姥只喝了点儿汤。

sour.definition:
n. a cocktail made of a liquor (especially whiskey or gin) mixed with lemon or lime juice and sugar
n. the taste experience when vinegar or lemon juice is taken into the mouth
v. go sour or spoil
v. make sour or more sour
sour.translation:
a. 酸的, 酸臭的, 发酵的, 愠怒的, 讨厌的, 拙劣的, 不健全的
vi. 变酸, 发酵, 厌烦, 变坏
vt. 使变酸, 使失望
n. 酸味, 酸饮料

examples.en: Those grapes look sweet, but in fact they're sour.
examples.zh: 那些葡萄看起来很甜，但其实是酸的。

examples.en: The fruit is still too sour to eat.
examples.zh: 这果子还太酸，没法吃。

examples.en: I will eat sweet and sour spareribs tonight.
examples.zh: 今天晚上吃糖醋排骨。

southeast.definition: n. the compass point midway between south and east; at 135 degrees\nn. the southeastern region of the United States\nn. the direction corresponding to the southeastward compass point
southeast.translation: n. 东南, 东南地区\na. 东南的, 向东南的, 来自东南的\nadv. 往东南, 来自东南

examples.en: Languages in the Hmong-Mien language family, also referred to as the Miao-Yao language family, are spoken across Southeast Asia and mountainous areas of southern China.
examples.zh: 苗瑶语系的语言分布于东南亚和中国南方山区。

southern.definition: a. in or characteristic of a region of the United States south of (approximately) the Mason-Dixon line\na. situated in or coming from regions of the south
southern.translation: n. 南方人, 男风\na. 向南方的, 来自南方的

examples.en: In Southern China, the qipao is also known as "changshan".
examples.zh: 在中国南方，旗袍又称“长衫”。

examples.en: Our restaurant is near the southern bus station.
examples.zh: 我们的饭店在汽车南站的附近。

examples.en: Southern men, Northern women.
examples.zh: 南男北女。

southwards.definition: n the cardinal compass point that is at 180 degrees\nr toward the south

examples.en: I told Yaroslav that I took the train southwards from Cairo to Aswan, Egypt.

southwest.definition: n. the compass point midway between south and west; at 225 degrees\nn. the southwestern region of the United States generally including New Mexico, Arizona, Texas, Nevada, California, and sometimes Utah and Colorado\nn. the direction corresponding to the southwestward compass point
southwest.translation: n. 西南, 西南方, 西南地区\na. 西南的, 来自西南方的\nadv. 往西南, 来自西南

examples.en: He went on a road trip through the Algerian southwest.
These panties got two more days on 'em. Thanks, Southwest.
I live in the southwest of the United States.

soy.definition: n. a source of oil; used for forage and soil improvement and as food\nn. erect bushy hairy annual herb having trifoliate leaves and purple to pink flowers; extensively cultivated for food and forage and soil improvement but especially for its nutritious oil-rich seeds; native to Asia\nn. the most highly proteinaceous vegetable known; the fruit of the soybean plant is used in a variety of foods and as fodder (especially as a replacement for animal protein)
soy.translation: n. 酱油, 大豆\n[医] 大豆; 酱油

examples.en: Mix the rice and eggs with soy sauce.
examples.zh: 把米饭和鸡蛋及酱油混一下。

examples.en: Mix the rice, egg and soy sauce.
examples.zh: 把米饭和鸡蛋及酱油混一下。

spaceship.definition: n a spacecraft designed to carry a crew into interstellar space (especially in science fiction)

examples.en: It is rumoured that a spaceship has been seen near Shanghai.
examples.zh: 谣传一架宇宙飞船在上海附近被见到了。

examples.en: They named the spaceship A100.
examples.zh: 他们把太空船命名为 A100。

spade.definition: n. a playing card in the major suit that has one or more black figures on it\nn. a sturdy hand shovel that can be pushed into the earth with the foot\nv. dig (up) with a spade
spade.translation: n. 铲子, 锄, 铲刀, 黑桃\nvt. 以锄掘, 把...弄实抹平\nvi. 铲

examples.en: Jane calls a spade a spade.
examples.zh: 珍是一个有话直说的人。

speaker.definition: n. someone who expresses in language; someone who talks (especially someone who delivers a public speech or someone especially garrulous)\nn. the presiding officer of a deliberative assembly
speaker.translation: n. 说话人, 讲演者, 发言人, 喇叭, 扬声器\n[计] 扬声器

examples.en: I studied English for four years with a native speaker.
examples.zh: 我跟英语母语者学了四年英语。

examples.en: He is a very good speaker of English.
examples.zh: 他英语说得很好。

examples.en: He is a good speaker of English.
examples.zh: 他英语说得很好。

specially.translation: adv. 特别地, 专门地

examples.en: The conference will be held in a specially selected church.
examples.zh: 会议将会在特意安排的礼堂里举行。

examples.en: This is a store that caters specially to students.
examples.zh: 这是一家专门为学生提供服务的商店。

examples.en: The state will build specially made bridges so that koalas and other wildlife can cross roads while avoiding cars and trucks.
examples.zh: 该州将修建特制的桥梁以便考拉和其他野生动物可以在避开汽车和卡车的情况下过马路。

specifically.translation: adv. 特定地, 明确地, 按特性

examples.en: The first time he came to Taipei, he specifically wanted to go shopping in Ximending.
examples.zh: 他第一次来台北，就指名要去西门町逛街。

speech.definition: n. (language) communication by word of mouth\nn. something spoken\nn. the exchange of spoken words
speech.translation: n. 演讲, 说话, 谈话, 言语, 引语, 民族语言\n[医] 言语, 语言

examples.en: Music is well said to be the speech of angels.
examples.zh: 人们说得好，音乐是天使的话语。

examples.en: The best thing in the world is freedom of speech.
examples.zh: 世上最好的事情，就是言论自由。

examples.en: I could hardly follow what Jane said in her speech.
examples.zh: 我几乎完全跟不上 Jane 的演讲内容。

spelling.definition: n. forming words with letters according to the principles underlying accepted usage
spelling.translation: n. 拼, 拼字, 拼法\n[计] 拼写检查

examples.en: You must be more careful about spelling and punctuation.
examples.zh: 你得要更注意拼字和标点符号。

examples.en: Your composition was good except for the spelling.
examples.zh: 你的文章写得很好，但却有很多字拼错了。

examples.en: Her composition is very good except for a few errors in spelling.
examples.zh: 她的作文作得十分好，只不过有几个字拼错了。

spherical.definition: a. of or relating to spheres or resembling a sphere
spherical.translation: a. 球的, 球面的, 球状的, 天体的\n[医] 球形的, 球状的

examples.en: The puck of ice hockey is not spherical.
examples.zh: 冰球的球不是球形的。

spinal.definition: a. of or relating to the spine or spinal cord
spinal.translation: a. 针的, 尖刺的, 尖刺状突起的, 脊骨的\n[医] 棘折; 脊柱的

examples.en: Sami could still walk despite damage to his spinal cord.
As a physiotherapist, Mary leads a group for spinal exercises.
My body became paralyzed as the needle penetrated my spinal cord.

spit.definition:
n. a narrow strip of land that juts out into the sea
n. a skewer for holding meat over a fire
n. the act of spitting (forcefully expelling saliva)
v. expel or eject (saliva or phlegm or sputum) from the mouth
spit.translation: n. 唾液, 唾吐, 小雨, 炙叉, 一铲的深度\nvt. 唾吐, 吐出, 降小雨, 用炙叉穿过\nvi. 吐唾沫, 吐痰, 唾弃, 飘霏霏细雨

examples.en: In Singapore, it is a crime to spit on the ground.
examples.zh: 随地吐痰在新加坡算是犯罪行为。

examples.en: He has the habit of spitting on the ground.
examples.zh: 他有个随地吐痰的习惯。

spoon.definition:
n. a piece of cutlery with a shallow bowl-shaped container and a handle; used to stir or serve or take up food
n. as much as a spoon will hold
n. formerly a golfing wood with an elevated face
v. scoop up or take up with a spoon
spoon.translation: n. 匙, 调羹, 匙形工具\nvt. 以匙舀起, 调情, 使成匙状

examples.en: Donna was born with a silver spoon in her mouth.
examples.zh: Donna是含着金钥匙出生的。

examples.en: Let us repeat: cup, plate, knife, fork, spoon, teaspoon.
examples.zh: 再念一次：杯子、盘子、刀、叉、汤匙、茶匙。

examples.en: Do you ever eat rice with a spoon?
examples.zh: 你用汤匙吃过米饭吗？

springtime.translation: n. 春天, 春季, 初期

examples.en: He still has springtime on the brain.
examples.zh: 他的大脑仍然很活跃。

stadium.definition: n. a large structure for open-air sports or entertainments
stadium.translation: n. 露天大型运动场\n[医] 期, 病期

examples.en: There were a lot of excited fans in the stadium.
examples.zh: 体育场里有很多兴奋的球迷。

examples.en: A stage has been set up in the stadium.
examples.zh: 体育场内已搭建起舞台。

examples.en: There were lots of people in the stadium.
examples.zh: 体育场里人山人海。

stainless.translation: a. 无瑕疵的, 不锈的\n[机] 不绣的, 污染的

examples.en: My mind is as bright and clean as a stainless mirror.
Tom filled his stainless steel coffee mug with coffee.
Most kitchen sinks are made of stainless steel.

stair.definition: n support consisting of a place to rest the foot while ascending or descending a stairway
stair.translation: n. 梯级, 楼梯, 阶梯

examples.en: Tom placed her shoes on the bottom stair.
He sat down on the last stair to wait for his friend.
After the accident, he was physically challenged by even a single stair.

stairway.definition: n. a way of access (upward and downward) consisting of a set of steps

examples.en: In an emergency, use the stairway, not the elevator.
examples.zh: 事故发生时，敬勿使用电梯，请使用楼梯。

examples.en: Mary couldn't believe that Tom had never listened to Stairway to Heaven.
examples.zh: 玛丽难以相信汤姆从来没有听过《通往天堂的阶梯》。

standardize.definition: v. cause to conform to standard or norm\nv. evaluate by comparing with a standard
standardize.translation: vt. 使标准化, 使合于标准, 用标准检验\n[计] 标准化; 规格化

examples.en: It's difficult to standardize language for a multi-ethnic nation.
Hindi and Urdu are standardized varieties of the Hindustani language.
Incentives are given to the students to do well on these standardized tests.

steadily.definition: r. at a steady rate or pace\nr. in a steady manner
steadily.translation: adv. 稳定地, 无变化地, 有规则地

examples.en: Prices have been rising steadily.
examples.zh: 物价一直在稳定上升。

examples.en: The patient is steadily recovering.
examples.zh: 这个病人正在稳定地康复中。

examples.en: Prices have been climbing steadily.
examples.zh: 价格一直在稳定地攀升。

steak.definition: n. a slice of meat cut from the fleshy part of an animal or large fish
steak.translation: n. 牛排, 鱼排, 肉排

examples.en: I thought you'd be full after eating that big steak.
examples.zh: 我觉得吃完那块大牛排你就饱了。

examples.en: Can you give me a kilo of steak?
examples.zh: 能不能请您给我一公斤牛排？

examples.en: He finished the steak, then ordered another portion.
examples.zh: 他吃完排骨又点了一份。

steal.definition:
n. a stolen base; an instance in which a base runner advances safely during the delivery of a pitch (without the help of a hit or walk or passed ball or wild pitch)
v. take without the owner's consent
v. move stealthily
v. steal a base
steal.translation: vt. 剽窃；偷偷地做；偷窃；vi. 窃取；偷偷地行动；[棒球]偷垒；n. [口]偷窃；便宜货；偷垒；[篮球]断球

examples.en: The two men were seen to steal into the house.
examples.zh: 那两个人偷偷溜进了房子里，给人看见了。

examples.en: How can you guys steal someone else's stuff?
examples.zh: 你们怎么可以抢别人的东西？

examples.en: The miser opened the box to find his money stolen.
examples.zh: 这个守财奴打开了盒子，发现他的钱被偷了。

steamer.definition: n. a cooking utensil that can be used to cook food by steaming it\nn. a ship powered by one or more steam engines\nv. travel by means of steam power
steamer.translation: n. 汽船, 蒸汽机\n[化] 蒸汽发生器; 蒸汽机

examples.en: The steamer wound in and out among the islands.
The steamer had sailed away before I could get on it.
Tell me how you will take the steamer from Mwanza to Bukoba.

stew.definition: n. food prepared by stewing especially meat or fish with vegetables\nv. bear a grudge; harbor ill feelings\nv. cook slowly and for a long time in liquid
stew.translation: n. 炖, 烦恼, 热浴, 妓院, 鱼塘\nvi. 炖, 焖, 忧虑\nvt. 炖, 焖, 使焦虑

examples.en: Tom added broccoli to the stew.
examples.zh: 汤姆往炖菜里加了西兰花。

examples.en: The stew smells delicious.
examples.zh: 这锅墩汤闻起来真美味。

stiffen.definition: v. become stiff or stiffer\nv. make stiff or stiffer\nv. restrict
stiffen.translation: vt. 使变硬, 使僵硬, 使顽强, 使严厉\nvi. 变粘, 变硬, 变强烈

examples.en: Dad used spray starch to stiffen his dress shirts.
She felt him stiffen in surprise when he heard the news.
That brand of gel stiffened my hair too much.

stiffness.definition: n. the physical property of being inflexible and hard to bend\nn. the property of moving with pain or difficulty\nn. firm resoluteness in purpose or opinion or action
stiffness.translation: n. 坚硬, 呆板, 刻板\n[医] 强直, 僵硬

examples.en: She stretched to relieve the stiffness in her back.
You need a parameter to capture the stiffness of the metal.
Have you recently felt any unexplained pain or stiffness in your neck?
I find beauty in the stillness of a calm morning.
I find peace in the stillness of the morning light.
My thoughts flow freely in the stillness of the night.

stockholder.definition: n. someone who holds shares of stock in a corporation
stockholder.translation: n. 股东\n[法] 股东, 股票持有者, 股票所有人

examples.en: I'm a stockholder in this company.
The stockholders are making money hand over fist.

stocking.definition: n. close-fitting hosiery to cover the foot and leg; come in matched pairs (usually used in the plural)\nn. the activity of supplying a stock of something
stocking.translation: n. 长袜\n[医] 马足水肿; 长袜

examples.en: There is a pair of worn red stockings in the drawer.
examples.zh: 抽屉里有一双穿过的红色丝袜。

examples.en: She is wearing a pair of white stockings.
examples.zh: 她穿著一双白色丝袜。

examples.en: She bought two pairs of polka dot stockings.
examples.zh: 她买了两双波点丝袜。

stomach.definition:
n. an enlarged and muscular saclike organ of the alimentary canal; the principal organ of digestion
n. an inclination or liking for things involving conflict or difficulty or unpleasantness
n. an appetite for food
v. bear to eat
stomach.translation: n. 胃, 食欲, 欲望, 肚子\nvt. 吃下, 忍受

examples.en: I developed a tumor in my stomach, which required surgery.
examples.zh: 我得了胃肿瘤，必须动手术切除。

examples.en: Don't get an upset stomach by eating too much.
examples.zh: 不要因为吃得太多而扰乱胃的正常消化。

examples.en: The pain is here, right? That's a stomach ache.
examples.zh: 这里疼是吗？那是胃痛。

stony.definition: s abounding in rocks or stones\ns showing unfeeling resistance to tender feelings\ns hard as granite
stony.translation: a. 多石的, 无情的

examples.en: Can you lend me some money? I'm stony broke.
He had a stony face, etched by time.
The stony beach was painful to walk on.

stool.definition:
n. a simple seat without a back or arms
n. (forestry) the stump of a tree that has been felled or headed for the production of saplings
v. lure with a stool, as of wild fowl
v. react to a decoy, of wildfowl
stool.translation: n. 凳子, 大便, 粪便, 厕所\nvi. 长新枝\nvt. 引诱, 诱捕

examples.en: If you stand on this stool, you can reach the top of the closet.
examples.zh: 站在这个凳子上的话，你可以摸到衣柜顶。

storey.definition: n a structure consisting of a room or set of rooms at a single position along a vertical scale
storey.translation: n. 楼, 楼层, 层楼

examples.en: What storey is our room?
examples.zh: 我们的房间在几楼？

stormy.definition: a. (especially of weather) affected or characterized by storms or commotion\ns. characterized by violent emotions or behavior
stormy.translation: a. 暴风雨的, 粗暴的, 激烈的

examples.en: It was a stormy day, and the snow was falling fast.
examples.zh: 这天刮着暴风雪，雪下得很大。

examples.en: I think it's dangerous to climb a mountain on a day when it's stormy.
examples.zh: 我认为在有风暴的时候里登山很危险。

stout.definition: n. a strong very dark heavy-bodied ale made from pale malt and roasted unmalted barley and (often) caramel malt with hops\nn. a garment size for a large or heavy person
stout.translation: a. 结实的；矮胖的；勇敢的；激烈的\nn. 矮胖子；烈性啤酒

examples.en: Irish stout is the best beer.
examples.zh: 啤酒以爱尔兰黑啤酒为最佳。

straighten.definition:
v. straighten up or out; make straight
v. make straight
v. get up from a sitting or slouching position
v. make straight or straighter
straighten.translation: vt. 弄直, 整顿, 清理, 使改正\nvi. 直起来, 改正, 好转

examples.en: Put away the bedsheet, I'll straighten the bed.
examples.zh: 你把床单收起来，我整理一下床。

examples.en: Tom spent most of the morning straightening up his office.
examples.zh: 汤姆花了大半个早晨整理办公室。

examples.en: Meg straightened up her desk.
examples.zh: 玛格摆正书桌。

strait.definition: n. a narrow channel of the sea joining two larger bodies of water\ns. narrow
strait.translation: n. 海峡, 困境\na. 困难的, 窘迫的, 狭窄的

examples.en: The straits were too narrow for the cruise ship.
examples.zh: 这个海峡对游艇来说太窄了。

strangler.definition: n. an epiphytic vine or tree whose aerial roots extend down the trunk of a supporting tree and coalesce around it eventually strangling the tree
strangler.translation: n. 扼杀者, 压制者, (英)阻气门, 阻塞门

strictly.definition: r. restricted to something\nr. in a stringent manner
strictly.translation: adv. 严格地, 确实地

examples.en: The rule of the road must be strictly observed.
examples.zh: 道路法规必须被严格遵守。

examples.en: What I'm about to say is strictly between you and me.
examples.zh: 我要说的只能是你知我知。

examples.en: Strictly speaking, the tomato is not a vegetable. It's a fruit.
examples.zh: 严格来说，蕃茄不是蔬菜，是水果。

strongly.definition: r. with strength or in a strong manner
strongly.translation: adv. 强有力地, 坚强地, 激烈地

examples.en: I also think 'living hell' is putting it too strongly.
examples.zh: 我也觉得说成「人间地狱」是夸张了点。

examples.en: Mariko's parents are strongly opposed to her marrying an American.
examples.zh: 麻理子的父母强烈反对她和美国人结婚。

examples.en: I am strongly opposed to a compromise.
examples.zh: 我强烈反对妥协。

studio.definition: n. workplace for the teaching or practice of an art\nn. workplace consisting of a room or building where movies or television shows or radio programs are produced and recorded
studio.translation: n. 工作室, 画室, 演播室, 电影制片厂

examples.en: The studio is very small, with no place to hide.
Didn't you know Tom used to be a studio musician?
He lived in a little studio apartment in Kabylie, Algeria.

subdivide.definition: v. form into subdivisions\nv. divide into smaller and smaller pieces
subdivide.translation: vt.vi. (把...)再分, (把...)细分\n[法] 再分, 细分

examples.en: There are 64 districts in Bangladesh, each further subdivided into subdistricts.
Biological sex is generally subdivided into genotypic sex, phenotypic sex, and hormonal sex.
The land was sold and subdivided.

subscript.definition: n. a character or symbol set or printed or written beneath or slightly below and to the side of another character\na. written or printed below and to one side of another character
subscript.translation: a. 下标的, 写在底下的\nn. 下标\n[计] 下标

subsidiary.definition: n an assistant subject to the authority or control of another\nn a company that is completely controlled by another company\ns functioning in a supporting capacity
subsidiary.translation: n. 子公司, 附件, 辅助者\na. 辅助的, 次要的, 津贴的

examples.en: It's a wholly-owned subsidiary, but it maintains some independence from its parent company.
The company is our wholly-owned subsidiary.
Overseas subsidiaries are putting out top-of the-line products.

substantially.definition: r. in a strong substantial way
substantially.translation: adv. 实质上, 本质上, 大体上

examples.en: Over the last few decades, Thailand has reduced poverty substantially.
Algeria will benefit substantially from China's Belt and Road Initiative.
Algeria will need to increase its interest rates substantially.

subway.definition: n an electric railway operating below the surface of the ground (usually in a city)\nn an underground tunnel or passage enabling pedestrians to cross a road or railway
subway.translation: n. 地铁, 地道\nvi. 乘地铁

examples.en: Excuse me, which subway line is to the city centre?
examples.zh: 抱歉，地铁几号线去市中心？

examples.en: It is cheap to take the subway in Beijing.
examples.zh: 在北京乘地铁很便宜。

examples.en: Excuse me. Can you direct me to the nearest subway station?
examples.zh: 打扰一下。请问你能告诉我最近的地铁站在哪吗？

successful.definition: a. having succeeded or being marked by a favorable outcome
successful.translation: a. 成功的, 一帆风顺的, 顺利的\n[经] 成功的

examples.en: The launch was successful. We're now leaving the solar system.
examples.zh: 发射成功。我们正在离开太阳系。

examples.en: Their common aim was to make the project successful.
examples.zh: 这些人共同的目标是把这个项目做成功。

examples.en: Tom seems to be a fairly successful businessman.
examples.zh: 汤姆看来是个很成功的商人。

successfully.definition: r. with success; in a successful manner
successfully.translation: adv. 成功, 结果良好, 有成就

examples.en: He was extremely happy at having successfully solved the problem.
examples.zh: 成功地解决了这个问题，对此他感到十分高兴。

examples.en: Actions are successfully achieved with deliberation but ruined by carelessness.
examples.zh: 行成于思，毁于随。

examples.en: With their cooperation, the mission had been successfully finished.
examples.zh: 在他们的默契合作下，任务完美地完成了。

suddenly.translation: adv. 突然, 意外, 忽然, 迅速, 即席作成, 即刻, 急速

examples.en: The bus stopped suddenly in the middle of the street.
examples.zh: 巴士突然在路中心停了下来。

examples.en: Nobody understood why the elephant suddenly turned on its owner.
examples.zh: 没有人明白为什么大象突然攻击了它的主人。

examples.en: I don't know at all why he quit his job suddenly.
examples.zh: 我完全不明白他为甚么会突然辞职。

examples.en: I do not cling to life sufficiently to fear death.
Can you use English sufficiently enough to carry out tasks?
Everything new is something old that’s been sufficiently forgotten.

suitcase.definition: n a portable rectangular container for carrying clothes

examples.en: She put two pairs of sheer tights in the suitcase.
examples.zh: 她在行李箱中放进了两条裤袜。

examples.en: Bob, help me carry his suitcase to the living room.
examples.zh: Bob，帮我把他的行李搬到客厅。

examples.en: Don't you want to see what I have in my suitcase?
examples.zh: 你不想看我的行李箱里有什么吗？

sullen.definition: s showing a brooding ill humor\ns darkened by clouds
sullen.translation: a. 愠怒的, 沉闷的, 阴沉的

examples.en: She had a sullen look on her face.
Mary's sullen husband Tom was kidnapped and hugged every morning by Teletubbies.
He became sullen and grumpy over time.

sulphur.definition: v. treat with sulphur in order to preserve
sulphur.translation: n. 硫, 硫磺\n[化] 硫

examples.en: Sulphur is a chemical element with the symbol S.
Iron has an affinity for sulphur, and so does hydrogen for oxygen.
Healing waters often taste of sulphur.

sunrise.definition: n. atmospheric phenomena accompanying the daily appearance of the sun\nn. the daily event of the sun rising above the horizon\ns. of an industry or technology; new and developing
sunrise.translation: n. 日出, 黎明, 拂晓

examples.en: We woke up very early in order to see the sunrise.
examples.zh: 我们起得很早为了看到日出。

examples.en: The Tequila Sunrise is made with orange juice, tequila, and grenadine.
examples.zh: 龙舌兰日出由柳橙汁、龙舌兰酒和石榴糖浆调制而成。

examples.en: What a beautiful sunrise it is!
examples.zh: 多美的日出啊！

sunshine.definition: n the rays of the sun\nn moderate weather; suitable for outdoor activities\nn the quality of being cheerful and dispelling gloom
sunshine.translation: n. 阳光, 光明, 晴天

examples.en: A day full of sunshine and a heart full of wishes...
examples.zh: 充满阳光的天和充满愿望的心...

examples.en: Cold and dry, splendid sunshine, what beautiful winter weather!
examples.zh: 寒冷干燥，灿烂的阳光，多么美丽的冬日天气!

examples.en: The lake was gleaming in the bright sunshine.
examples.zh: 湖水在耀眼的阳光下闪闪发亮。

super.definition: s. including more than a specified category\ns. extremely large
super.translation: n. 跑龙套角色, 冗员, 特级品, 特大号, 管理人\na. 上等的, 特大的, 超级的, 极好的, 十分的, 过分的\nadv. 非常

examples.en: I only buy super soft toilet paper.
examples.zh: 我只买超柔软的卫生纸。

examples.en: Teachers nowadays are super into testing. It seems that there's another test today.
examples.zh: 现在的老师么，非常迷信考试，据说今天又要考试啦。

examples.en: Sami was super nice to Layla.
examples.zh: 萨米对莱拉非常好。

superficially.translation: adv. 表面, 表面性, 浅层, 不深, 表皮, (贬)肤浅, 一知半解, 浅薄, 平方, 浮面

examples.en: Yet superficially their situation does look completely reversed.
Don't treat such serious subjects so superficially.

supersonic.definition: a. (of speed) greater than the speed of sound in a given medium (especially air)\ns. having frequencies above those of audible sound
supersonic.translation: a. 超声波的\n[医] 超声[波]的

examples.en: The Concorde was capable of reaching supersonic speeds.
The airplane is capable of supersonic speeds.
The aeroplane is capable of supersonic speeds.

surely.definition: r. definitely or positively (`sure' is sometimes used informally for `surely')
surely.translation: adv. 的确地, 安全地\n[经] 保证, 保证人, 保证金

examples.en: It's written abazure (bitch). Surely this must mean a slut?
examples.zh: 上面写的是「abazure (婊子)」。这肯定是指「荡妇」吧？

examples.en: That is a criminal offense, and you will surely be punished!
examples.zh: 那是犯罪行为，你肯定会受到惩罚的!

examples.en: Surely he can not enter a second time into his mother's womb to be born!
examples.zh: 他当然不可能回到娘胎里再出生一次了！

surprising.definition: a. causing surprise or wonder or amazement

examples.en: I've something interesting to tell you that you might find surprising.
examples.zh: 告诉你个好玩的事，能惊你一下。

examples.en: It was all more and more surprising.
examples.zh: 真是惊人至极。

examples.en: The real answer is surprising.
examples.zh: 真正的答案令人惊讶。

surprisingly.translation: adv. 使人惊奇, 出人意外, 惊人, 令人惊讶

examples.en: My method is surprisingly simple, but the impact is big.
Yanni's pitbull was surprisingly friendly and didn't bark at all.
Surprisingly enough, he turned out to be a thief.

swarm.definition: n. a group of many things in the air or on the ground
swarm.translation: n. 群, 大群, 蜂群, 分蜂群\nvi. 分群, 群集, 聚集一块, 云集, 攀\nvt. 挤满, 爬, 攀

examples.en: A swarm of hornets attacked the children.
examples.zh: 一窝黄蜂袭击了孩子们。

examples.en: We were attacked by swarms of bees.
examples.zh: 我们被一大群蜜蜂攻击。

examples.en: St Mark's Square in Venice is always swarming with tourists in the summer.
examples.zh: 威尼斯的圣马可广场在夏季总是挤满了游客。

sweeten.definition: v. make sweeter in taste\nv. make sweeter, more pleasant, or more agreeable
sweeten.translation: vt. 使变甜, 加糖于, 使悦耳, 使温和, 减轻\nvi. 变甜

examples.en: Children sweeten labours, but they make misfortunes more bitter.
I started to sweeten my coffee with honey.
I sweeten coffee with molasses instead of sugar.

sweetness.definition: n. the property of tasting as if it contains sugar
sweetness.translation: n. 甜蜜, 芳香, 美妙

examples.en: Crafting a perfect Mojito can be a challenge. Achieving the right balance of sweetness, mintiness, and lime is an art.
examples.zh: 调制一杯完美的 Mojito 并非易事。要达到甜味、薄荷味和青柠味之间的完美平衡，是一门艺术。

symmetrical.definition: a. having similarity in size, shape, and relative position of corresponding parts
symmetrical.translation: a. 对称的, 匀称的\n[医] 对称的, 均称的

examples.en: Jamin's perfectly symmetrical features give her an ethereal and timeless beauty.
The earth is not symmetrical about the equator.
The layout of the prison was fairly symmetrical.

systematically.definition: r. in a systematic or consistent manner
systematically.translation: adv. 有系统地, 有组织地, 有条理地

examples.en: Oftentimes, the best solution is to systematically attack the problem!
The right-angled, systematically arranged grid of streets is easy to recognise.
Environmentally damaging projects should be abandoned systematically.
